paragraphs.en: Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances and the effects of earlier actions. We introduce S 2 -MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework built on 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data. Its Genese engine separates decisions from state updates, while reusable financial scenarios and application ledgers track consumption, cash, debt and payments. FinL-mlx, a compact decision model trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 in consumer financial-choice scenarios, outperforming Jev 1.13 and GLM-5.3-Flash on both measures. We evaluate eight financial task families and simulate 12 million distinct household agents in paired purchase-funding conditions. Jointly raising purchase goals and approved credit limits increases consumption, with responses differing across age and income groups. Education, employment and household-size differences persist after age–income standardization and mainly reflect transitions from deferral to purchase. Asset and debt groups differ in cash drawdown, repayment and closing debt. A 24-month panel varies purchase goals under a common credit product, with repayment and arrears updating subsequent offers. S 2 -MAS links heterogeneous household decisions to evolving consumption, cash and repayment paths, supporting economic experiments across household groups, population scales and time horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 在社会尺度上模拟经济反应，需要其决策能反映家庭境况以及先前行动影响的智能体。 我们提出 S 2 -MAS，一个社会尺度的多智能体仿真框架，其构建于基于真实调查数据的 5 亿合成家庭画像之上。 其 Genese 引擎将决策与状态更新分离，同时可复用的金融场景与应用台账跟踪消费、现金、债务与还款。 FinL-mlx 是一个紧凑的决策模型，通过 SFT + RLCD 在 293 万样本上训练，在消费者金融选择场景中达到 74.55% 的准确率和 38.37% 的题目级宏平均 F1，在两项指标上均优于 Jev 1.13 和 GLM-5.3-Flash。 我们评估了八个金融任务族，并在成对的购物资金条件下模拟了 1200 万个不同的家庭智能体。 同时提高购物目标与获批信用额度会增加消费，且反应因年龄和收入群体而异。 在年龄—收入标准化之后，教育、就业和家庭规模的差异仍然存在，并主要体现为从延迟到购买的转变。 资产与债务群体在现金支取、还款和期末债务方面存在差异。 一个 24 个月的面板在共同的信用产品下改变购物目标，还款与欠款情况会更新后续的授信方案。 S 2 -MAS 将异质的家庭决策与不断演化的消费、现金和还款路径联系起来，支持跨家庭群体、人口规模和时间跨度的经济实验。

paragraphs.en: Language-model-based multi-agent simulation offers a way to study how heterogeneous populations respond to changing environments and interventions. At society scale, three challenges arise together: decisions must respond to individual circumstances, actions must produce consistent changes in resources and obligations, and inference and execution must remain efficient enough to repeat experiments across conditions. We introduce S 2 -MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework integrating household populations, trainable decision policies and explicit state transitions (Figure 1).
paragraphs.zh: 基于语言模型的多智能体仿真提供了一种研究异质性人群如何响应环境变化与干预措施的方法。 在社会尺度上，三个挑战同时出现：决策必须响应个体情况，行动必须对资源和义务产生一致的变化，且推理与执行必须保持足够高效，以便在不同条件下重复实验。 我们提出 S 2 -MAS，这是一个社会尺度的多智能体仿真框架，整合了家庭人口、可训练的决策策略和显式的状态转移（图 1）。

sents.zh: 基于语言模型的多智能体仿真提供了一种研究异质性人群如何响应环境变化与干预措施的方法。

paragraphs.en: Survey-conditioned agents allow predictions to be evaluated against recorded human responses [26] , [27] . MatrAIx constructs heterogeneous persona populations for simulated-user evaluation [1] , while OneSim and OASIS support large-scale agent execution in social environments [17] , [18] . Economic experiments require these capabilities together: differences among households shape their decisions, and the resulting changes in resources and obligations shape what they can do next.
paragraphs.zh: 基于调查条件化的智能体使预测能够与已记录的人类回答进行比较评估 [26]、[27]。 MatrAIx 为模拟用户评估构建异质性角色群体 [1]，而 OneSim 和 OASIS 支持在社会环境中大规模执行智能体 [17]、[18]。 经济实验需要同时具备这些能力：家庭之间的差异塑造其决策，而由此产生的资源与义务的变化又塑造他们接下来能做什么。

sents.zh: MatrAIx 为模拟用户评估构建异质性角色群体 [1]，而 OneSim 和 OASIS 支持在社会环境中大规模执行智能体 [17]、[18]。

paragraphs.en: Household finance provides observed responses for decision learning and budget rules for calculating the consequences of selected plans. After an income loss, a household may draw on reserves to sustain consumption, reduce spending to preserve cash, or leave payments unmet. Buffer-stock saving, consumption commitments and heterogeneous-household models explain why resources and obligations matter for these adjustments [23] , [24] , [32] . Consumption, cash reserves and payment histories therefore reveal how the same financial condition affects households with different starting positions.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭金融为决策学习提供观测到的响应，并为计算所选方案的后果提供预算规则。 在收入损失之后，家庭可能动用储备以维持消费、削减开支以保全现金，或让应付账款处于未支付状态。 缓冲储备储蓄、消费承诺和异质性家庭模型解释了为什么资源与义务对这些调整十分重要 [23] , [24] , [32] 。 因此，消费、现金储备和支付历史揭示了相同的财务状况如何影响具有不同初始条件的家庭。

paragraphs.en: S 2 -MAS combines 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data, domain-adapted decision models, reusable financial tasks and the Genese execution engine. FinL and FinQ implement encoder and decoder decision policies, respectively. FinL uses 2,925,263 examples for SFT + RLCD; FinL-mlx is its runtime used in the completed financial applications. Genese separates decision proposals from state updates, while independent application ledgers calculate consumption, cash, debt payments and shortfalls. Paired experiments retain the same households and accounting rules across conditions. Monthly experiments carry realized resources, obligations and payment histories into subsequent decisions.
paragraphs.zh: S 2 -MAS 结合了基于真实调查数据构建的 5 亿个合成家庭角色、领域适配的决策模型、可复用的金融任务以及 Genese 执行引擎。 FinL 和 FinQ 分别实现编码器和解码器决策策略。 FinL 使用 2,925,263 个样本进行 SFT + RLCD；FinL-mlx 是其运行时，用于已完成的金融应用中。 Genese 将决策提案与状态更新分离，同时独立的应用程序账本计算消费、现金、债务还款和缺口。 配对实验在各条件下保留相同的家庭和会计规则。 月度实验将已实现的资源、债务和还款历史带入后续决策中。

paragraphs.en: Component evaluation measures the contribution of household information, policy substitution and execution efficiency. In consumer financial-choice scenarios, FinL-mlx achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1. Its accuracy exceeds Jev 1.13 by 9.30 percentage points and GLM-5.3-Flash by 5.68 points. In a controlled 1,000-agent benchmark with the same model allocation, Genese completes accepted decisions and state writeback faster than OneSim and OASIS (Section 5.5).
paragraphs.zh: 组件评估衡量了家庭信息、政策替代和执行效率的贡献。 在消费者金融选择场景中，FinL-mlx 达到了 74.55% 的准确率和 38.37% 的题目-宏观 F1。 其准确率超过 Jev 1.13 达 9.30 个百分点，超过 GLM-5.3-Flash 达 5.68 个百分点。 在一个采用相同模型配置的受控 1,000 个智能体基准测试中，Genese 比 OneSim 和 OASIS 更快地完成被接受的决策和状态回写（第 5.5 节）。

sents.zh: 在一个采用相同模型配置的受控 1,000 个智能体基准测试中，Genese 比 OneSim 和 OASIS 更快地完成被接受的决策和状态回写（第 5.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: FinL-mlx runs eight financial task families. A paired one-shot purchase-funding experiment with 12 million distinct synthetic households shows that jointly raising purchase goals and approved limits increases consumption. Responses differ by age and income; education, employment and household-size differences persist after standardization to a common age–income distribution. Much of this variation reflects transitions from deferral to purchase. Asset and debt groups differ in cash drawdown, repayment and closing debt. A 24-month extension follows the same 10,000-household panel across five shock paths and an unshocked reference, comparing higher and lower purchase goals under the same credit product and offer rules. Repayment and arrears update subsequent credit offers. Persistent income loss erodes cash buffers and narrows the consumption gap between the goals, while sustained income gains widen it.
paragraphs.zh: FinL-mlx 运行八个金融任务族。 一项针对 1200 万个不同合成家庭进行的配对一次性购房融资实验表明，同时提高购房目标和获批额度会增加消费。 反应因年龄和收入而异；在标准化到统一的年龄—收入分布后，教育、就业和家庭规模方面的差异依然存在。 这种差异很大程度上反映了从推迟到购买的转变。 资产和债务群体在现金提取、还款和期末债务方面有所不同。 24 个月的扩展实验跟踪同一个 10000 家庭面板，跨越五条冲击路径和一个未受冲击的参照组，在同一信贷产品和报价规则下比较较高与较低的购房目标。 还款和拖欠情况会更新后续的信贷报价。 持续的收入损失会侵蚀现金缓冲并缩小两个目标之间的消费差距，而持续的收入增长则会扩大这一差距。

paragraphs.en: Survey-conditioned agents connect language modeling to empirical response distributions. Argyle et al. condition GPT-3 on sociodemographic backstories and compare generated subpopulation responses with survey samples [26] . Park et al. construct interview- and survey-grounded agents for 1,052 Americans and evaluate held-out responses against the represented individuals’ test–retest consistency [27] . FinL learns direct decisions from observed consumer survey responses. Question-majority and matched-profile controls measure the contribution of respondent information to held-out answer prediction. The application ledger calculates the financial consequences of selected plans.
paragraphs.zh: 调查条件化的智能体将语言建模与经验性回答分布联系起来。 Argyle 等人将 GPT-3 条件化于社会人口统计背景故事，并将生成的子群体回答与调查样本进行比较 [26] 。 Park 等人构建了基于访谈和调查的智能体，覆盖 1,052 名美国人，并将留出的回答与所代表个体的重测一致性进行评估 [27] 。 FinL 从观察到的消费者调查回答中学习直接决策。 问题多数和匹配画像的对照实验衡量受访者信息对留出答案预测的贡献。 应用账本计算所选方案的财务后果。

paragraphs.en: Published MatrAIx AI–human within-one agreement is 93.8% for Claude and 79.2% for GPT on its own 100-persona cohort [1] . Its protocol provides methodological background for comparing a judge with a human reference; the present study evaluates its judges on the processed-field cohort described in Supplementary Methods M7.
paragraphs.zh: 已发表的 MatrAIx 智能体–人类一致性数据为：在其自有的 100 个人设队列上，Claude 为 93.8%，GPT 为 79.2% [1]。 其方案为将评判者与人类参照进行比较提供了方法学背景；本研究在补充方法 M7 所述的经处理字段队列上评估其评判者。

paragraphs.en: Direct decision models score named alternatives or return structured probabilities without generating a prose answer. Jev’s official introduction names RLCD as its training approach and its API defines typed outputs [36] , [12] . Kev-4B publishes option-classification CE for its LoRA/pointer adapter; Laya’s open trainer combines noisy-logit proper-reward policy gradients with soft CE [38] , [37] . Encoder interfaces include Laya and Von; decoder decision readouts include Kev, Clef and Nimble [3] – [5] , [9] , [10] . S 2 -MAS adapts Laya’s existing option-scoring interface to recorded household answers and coded states. Supplementary Methods M5 compares available interfaces on the same held-out consumer questions.
paragraphs.zh: 直接决策模型对给定的备选项打分或返回结构化概率，而不生成散文式回答。 Jev的官方介绍指明RLCD是其训练方法，其API定义了类型化输出 [36] , [12] 。 Kev-4B为其LoRA/指针适配器公布了选项分类交叉熵；Laya的开源训练器将带噪声logit的恰当奖励策略梯度与软交叉熵相结合 [38] , [37] 。 编码器接口包括Laya和Von；解码器决策读出包括Kev、Clef和Nimble [3] – [5] , [9] , [10] 。 S 2 -MAS将Laya现有的选项打分接口适配到录制的家庭回答与编码状态。 补充方法M5在相同的留存消费者问题上比较可用的接口。

paragraphs.en: Financial language adaptation spans large-corpus pretraining, instruction tuning and expert numerical QA. BloombergGPT uses 363B financial tokens plus 345B general tokens for pretraining [13] . PIXIU’s NeurIPS 2023 FIT release contains 128,640 instruction samples for financial NLP and prediction [14] . FinGPT distributes task-specific instruction sets, including 76.8K sentiment, 82.2K headline and 17.1K financial-QA training rows [15] . FinQA targets expert-written numerical reasoning over financial reports [16] . These resources measure document interpretation, linguistic tasks and market prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 金融语言适配涵盖大规模语料预训练、指令微调与专家数值问答。 BloombergGPT 使用 3630 亿金融词元加上 3450 亿通用词元进行预训练 [13]。 PIXIU 在 NeurIPS 2023 发布的 FIT 包含 128,640 条面向金融自然语言处理与预测的指令样本 [14]。 FinGPT 发布了面向特定任务的指令数据集，包括 76.8K 条情感、82.2K 条标题和 17.1K 条金融问答训练数据 [15]。 FinQA 针对由专家撰写的、基于金融报告的数值推理 [16]。 这些资源用于衡量文档解读、语言任务与市场预测能力。

sents.en: Financial language adaptation spans large-corpus pretraining, instruction tuning and expert numerical QA.
sents.zh: 金融语言适配涵盖大规模语料预训练、指令微调与专家数值问答。

sents.zh: FinGPT 发布了面向特定任务的指令数据集，包括 76.8K 条情感、82.2K 条标题和 17.1K 条金融问答训练数据 [15]。

paragraphs.en: Financial Laya checkpoints adapt the same direct-decision interface to narrower tasks. The public Laya-Finance card lists financial sentiment, topics, central-bank text, headlines and terminology [28] . A Banking77 adaptation trains typed decision heads on 7,994 customer-service messages while keeping its encoder frozen [29] . FinL updates its encoder and decision head with observed household and respondent survey targets. Supplementary Methods M5 evaluates the external Laya-Finance checkpoint on the same held-out consumer questions.
paragraphs.zh: Financial Laya 检查点将同样的直接决策接口适配到更窄的任务上。 公开的 Laya-Finance 卡片列出了金融情感、主题、央行文本、新闻标题与术语 [28]。 一项 Banking77 适配在 7,994 条客服消息上训练带类型的决策头，同时保持其编码器冻结 [29]。 FinL 使用观察到的家庭与受访者调查目标来更新其编码器和决策头。 补充方法 M5 在同样的留存消费者问题上评估外部的 Laya-Finance 检查点。

sents.en: Financial Laya checkpoints adapt the same direct-decision interface to narrower tasks.
sents.zh: Financial Laya 检查点将同样的直接决策接口适配到更窄的任务上。

sents.en: The public Laya-Finance card lists financial sentiment, topics, central-bank text, headlines and terminology [28] .
sents.zh: 公开的 Laya-Finance 卡片列出了金融情感、主题、央行文本、新闻标题与术语 [28]。

sents.zh: FinL 使用观察到的家庭与受访者调查目标来更新其编码器和决策头。

sents.zh: 补充方法 M5 在同样的留存消费者问题上评估外部的 Laya-Finance 检查点。

paragraphs.en: Laya-Fintiment uses 61,017 gradient-training examples for three-class financial sentiment [33] . The Ariadne-Laya finance-topic model trains a 1,049,600-parameter interface over a frozen 421M base for twenty news topics [34] . Household survey supervision adds income, spending, wealth, debt, product participation and attitudes to the decision target, connecting the model’s inputs to a consumer’s economic circumstances.
paragraphs.zh: Laya-Fintiment 使用 61,017 个梯度训练样本进行三分类金融情感分析 [33]。 Ariadne-Laya 金融主题模型在冻结的 421M 基础模型之上训练一个 1,049,600 参数的接口，用于二十个新闻主题 [34]。 家庭调查监督将收入、支出、财富、债务、产品参与和态度加入决策目标，将模型的输入与消费者的经济状况联系起来。

sents.en: Laya-Fintiment uses 61,017 gradient-training examples for three-class financial sentiment [33] .
sents.zh: Laya-Fintiment 使用 61,017 个梯度训练样本进行三分类金融情感分析 [33]。

paragraphs.en: The training corpus combines recorded financial answers with coded household-state, education and occupation targets. Its 2,925,263 training examples correspond to approximately 48 times Laya-Fintiment’s 61,017 examples and 122 times Chinese-Jev Finance’s 24,000 decisions [33] , [35] .
paragraphs.zh: 训练语料库由录制的财务问答与经过编码的家庭状态、教育和职业目标组合而成。 其 2,925,263 条训练样本约是 Laya-Fintiment 61,017 条样本的 48 倍，以及 Chinese-Jev Finance 24,000 条决策的 122 倍 [33], [35]。

sents.en: The training corpus combines recorded financial answers with coded household-state, education and occupation targets.
sents.zh: 训练语料库由录制的财务问答与经过编码的家庭状态、教育和职业目标组合而成。

paragraphs.en: OneSim, OASIS, AgentSociety and Generative Agents study multi-agent activity at different population sizes and interaction depths [17] – [20] . Their published workloads use environment populations, events, calls or trials (Table S9). S 2 -MAS connects a completed 12M-agent purchase-funding application with a 24-month extension of the purchase task across five shock paths and an unshocked reference.
paragraphs.zh: OneSim、OASIS、AgentSociety 和 Generative Agents 在不同的群体规模和交互深度下研究多智能体活动 [17] – [20]。 它们已发表的工作负载使用环境群体、事件、调用或试验（表 S9）。 S²-MAS 将一个已完成的 1200 万智能体购买融资应用与购买任务在五条冲击路径以及一条无冲击参考路径下的 24 个月延展相连接。

sents.zh: 它们已发表的工作负载使用环境群体、事件、调用或试验（表 S9）。

sents.en: S 2 -MAS connects a completed 12M-agent purchase-funding application with a 24-month extension of the purchase task across five shock paths and an unshocked reference.

paragraphs.en: Household-finance research studies consumption responses through the distribution of resources and obligations. Kaplan, Moll and Violante’s HANK framework links uninsured income risk and assets with different liquidity to heterogeneous consumption responses [32] . S 2 -MAS represents income, spending, assets and debt jointly and evaluates how those states change the executable response to a shared financial condition.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭金融研究通过资源与义务的分布来考察消费反应。 Kaplan、Moll 和 Violante 的 HANK 框架将未保险的收入风险与不同流动性的资产同异质性的消费反应联系起来 [32]。 S2-MAS 联合表示收入、支出、资产与债务，并评估这些状态如何改变对共享金融状况的可执行反应。

sents.zh: 家庭金融研究通过资源与义务的分布来考察消费反应。

paragraphs.en: Population counts in Table S10 distinguish the S 2 -MAS resources and executed cohorts beside aggregate and banking-study sample sizes. A real-survey aggregate reference reports 494,157,423 family households [2]. Wheat and Eckerd analyze account inflows covering 10 million U.S. households [30] . The JPMorgan Chase Institute healthcare study uses a two-million-family framing and 2.3 million core customers aged 18–64 over 2013–2016 [31] .
paragraphs.zh: 表S10中的人口计数在总体与银行研究样本规模之外，还区分了S²-MAS资源与已执行队列。 一项真实调查的总体参考报告了494,157,423个家庭住户[2]。 Wheat和Eckerd分析了覆盖1000万美国家庭的账户流入[30]。 摩根大通研究所的医疗研究采用200万户家庭的框架，以及2013–2016年间年龄在18–64岁之间的230万核心客户[31]。

sents.zh: 一项真实调查的总体参考报告了494,157,423个家庭住户[2]。

paragraphs.en: An experiment in S 2 -MAS specifies four inputs: a population, a policy adapter, a task and condition specification, and state-transition rules. The population supplies whole-agent attributes. The task converts current state and available information into a question with explicit alternatives. The adapter returns an option and its probabilities; the execution layer applies the registered consequence and records the resulting state. Ordinary agent, condition and task IDs connect these stages across partitions and retries.
paragraphs.zh: S²-MAS 中的实验规定了四项输入：一个种群、一个策略适配器、一项任务与条件规范，以及状态转移规则。 种群提供完整的智能体级别的属性。 任务将当前状态和可用信息转换为带有明确备选项的问题。 适配器返回一个选项及其概率；执行层应用已注册的后果并记录所产生的状态。 普通的智能体、条件和任务 ID 在跨分区和重试时连接这些阶段。

sents.en: Ordinary agent, condition and task IDs connect these stages across partitions and retries.
sents.zh: 普通的智能体、条件和任务 ID 在跨分区和重试时连接这些阶段。

paragraphs.en: A static episode evaluates a selected plan through its horizon. A stateful episode builds the next observation from the previous transition, retaining dated obligations, realized payments and unmet quantities. FinQ and FinL provide two trainable policy routes within the same contract. Changing a policy or designated condition preserves the other inputs and the same-household pairing. Policy proposals and their feasible execution remain separately observable.
paragraphs.zh: 静态回合在整个时间范围内评估选定的计划。 有状态回合根据上一次转移构建下一个观测，保留带日期的义务、已实现的付款和未满足的数量。 FinQ 与 FinL 在同一合约内提供两条可训练的策略路线。 更换策略或指定条件时，其余输入以及同一家庭配对保持不变。 策略提案及其可行的执行仍可分别观测。

sents.zh: 有状态回合根据上一次转移构建下一个观测，保留带日期的义务、已实现的付款和未满足的数量。

sents.zh: FinQ 与 FinL 在同一合约内提供两条可训练的策略路线。

sents.zh: 策略提案及其可行的执行仍可分别观测。

paragraphs.en: The financial task library instantiates this contract across eight families (Table 1). A medical-bill task changes the outflow to be funded; a loan-term task changes payment dates; an asset-sale task changes when proceeds enter cash. Each task defines its alternatives and action-to-ledger mapping while retaining the population and choice interfaces. Outputs link selected actions to monthly consumption, cash, debt and shortfalls.
paragraphs.zh: 金融任务库在八大类任务中实例化了该契约（表1）。 医疗账单任务改变需要筹资的支出；贷款期限任务改变还款日期；资产出售任务改变收益进入现金的时间。 每个任务在保留人口与选择接口的同时，定义其备选方案及动作到账本的映射。 输出将所选动作与月度消费、现金、债务及缺口联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 — Population-scale and repeated household decisions in S 2 -MAS. a, Real-survey data support 36 coded household attributes. The constructed 500M persona resource supplies the 12M execution cohort, selected without replacement before inference; PCA summarizes economic structure using 14 ordinal fields. b, Real-survey supervision supports trainable policies. FinQ is the selected Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA-plus-head route, while FinL is the full-data Laya encoder adaptation. The fixed-budget study contains five native Laya and five Qwen adaptations, including FinQ; full-data FinL is a separate system reference. Genese World/ECS exchanges requests and intents with Brain and applies registered effects to state. The application ledger executes financial plans. c, Eight financial task families share the choice interface. FinL-mlx supplies the completed task, population and monthly applications. A fixed 10,000-household panel covers initial response patterns in the 12M cohort and is retained across shock paths and purchase goals for 24 months. Joint outcomes trace consumption, closing cash, debt payments and shortfalls.
paragraphs.zh: 图1 — S²-MAS 中的总体规模与重复家庭决策。a，真实调查数据支持 36 个编码家庭属性。 构建的 5 亿角色资源提供 1200 万执行队列，在推理前无放回地选取；PCA 使用 14 个序数字段总结经济结构。b，真实调查监督支持可训练策略。 FinQ 是选定的 Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA-plus-head 路线，而 FinL 是全量数据 Laya 编码器适配。 固定预算研究包含五个原生 Laya 适配与五个 Qwen 适配（含 FinQ）；全量数据的 FinL 是单独的系统参照。 Genese World/ECS 与 Brain 交换请求与意图，并将注册的效果应用到状态上。 应用账本执行财务计划。c，八个金融任务族共享同一选择接口。 FinL-mlx 提供已完成的任务、总体以及月度应用。 一个固定的 10,000 户面板覆盖 1200 万队列中的初始反应模式，并在 24 个月内跨冲击路径与购买目标保留。 联合结果追踪消费、期末现金、债务偿还与缺口。

paragraphs.en: The static task suite contains 45,473 cases per language, including 22,736 baseline/intervention pairs and one additional case. Task specifications separate model-visible information from execution-only realizations and provide 147,787 conditional option paths over twelve months. The completed suite uses FinL-mlx and the original Laya reference. The population-scale application fixes one T3 contrast; its monthly extension reselects from evolving state under common bank rules. Survey QA tests prediction of recorded answers and coded targets.

paragraphs.en: Consider a synthetic household assigned CNY 6,000 monthly income, CNY 3,000 opening cash, CNY 3,500 essential and CNY 1,800 usual adjustable spending, and no opening debt. A CNY 20,000 purchase goal offers deferral, half financing or full financing at 5% nominal annual interest over 24 installments. Selecting full financing buys CNY 20,000 immediately and records the dated purchase contract. Month-0 cash is 3,000 + 6,000 + 20,000 - 20,000 - 3,500 - 1,800 = CNY 3,700, with repayment beginning in month 1. A later observation contains this closing cash, the remaining purchase need and the next dated obligation. The supplied CPU saved-action example executes these transitions without model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 假设一个合成家庭被分配了每月人民币 6,000 元的收入、人民币 3,000 元的期初现金、人民币 3,500 元的必要支出和人民币 1,800 元的常规可调支出，并且没有期初债务。 一个人民币 20,000 元的购买目标提供延期、半额贷款或全额贷款三种选择，名义年利率为 5%，分 24 期偿还。 选择全额贷款会立即购买人民币 20,000 元的商品，并记录带日期的购买合同。 第 0 个月的现金为 3,000 + 6,000 + 20,000 - 20,000 - 3,500 - 1,800 = 人民币 3,700 元，还款从第 1 个月开始。 后续的观测包含该期末现金、剩余的购买需求和下一个带日期的义务。 所提供的 CPU 保存动作示例无需调用模型即可执行这些状态转换。

paragraphs.en: Real-survey data support the household attributes, recorded responses and coded financial states used here. Cleaning, translation and statistical harmonization produce a common 36-field representation of demographics, household structure, income, expenditure, assets, debt and attitudes. Conditional construction preserves the dependence of financial attributes on household characteristics, and statistical calibration aligns selected population margins. Numeric codes support population operations, while decoded fields form model-visible personas. PCA summarizes joint economic structure after construction (Supplementary Methods M1–M3).
paragraphs.zh: 实际调查数据支持本文所使用的家庭属性、记录的回答以及编码后的财务状态。 通过清洗、转换和统计协调，生成一个包含人口统计、家庭结构、收入、支出、资产、债务和态度的统一的36字段表示。 条件式构建保留了财务属性对家庭特征的依赖关系，统计校准则对齐了选定的人口边际。 数值编码支持人口规模操作，而解码后的字段则构成模型可见的人物画像。 主成分分析（PCA）在构建之后概括了联合经济结构（补充方法 M1–M3）。

paragraphs.en: The same preparation produces supervision for policy learning. The 4,172,421 underlying QA observations have aligned bilingual views, retaining wording, alternatives and monetary units. Target-related fields are omitted from the input, and all questions and language copies for a respondent group share a split. The grouped training partition contains 2,925,263 examples per language. FinL uses the full training partition; the matched downstream comparisons use nested 50k/200k training sets, including the selected 200k FinQ route (Appendix S10).
paragraphs.zh: 同样的准备工作可生成用于策略学习的监督信号。 4,172,421 条底层问答观测具有对齐的双语视图，保留了措辞、备选项和货币单位。 目标相关字段从输入中省略，且同一受访者组的所有问题和语言副本共享同一个划分。 分组训练分区在每个语言上包含 2,925,263 个样本。 FinL 使用完整训练分区；匹配的下游比较使用嵌套的 50k/200k 训练集，包括选定的 200k FinQ 路线（附录 S10）。

paragraphs.en: Genese separates decision proposals from authoritative state updates (Figure 2). World stores numeric state in entity–component–system arrays indexed by entity ID. Brain receives bounded decision partitions, reuses model connections and returns policy intents. World validates these intents, resolves registered effects and applies updates. Production PostgreSQL commits world state, the event outbox and command result together; a failed pre-commit transition restores the tick snapshot. An outbox relay publishes committed events asynchronously.
paragraphs.zh: Genese 将决策提案与权威状态更新分离（图 2）。 World 以实体 ID 为索引，将数值状态存储在实体–组件–系统数组中。 Brain 接收有界的决策分区，复用模型连接并返回策略意图。 World 校验这些意图，解析已注册的效果并应用更新。 生产环境的 PostgreSQL 将世界状态、事件发件箱和命令结果一起提交；提交前的转换失败会恢复到该 tick 的快照。 发件箱中继异步发布已提交的事件。

sents.en: Genese separates decision proposals from authoritative state updates (Figure 2).
sents.zh: Genese 将决策提案与权威状态更新分离（图 2）。

sents.en: World stores numeric state in entity–component–system arrays indexed by entity ID.
sents.zh: World 以实体 ID 为索引，将数值状态存储在实体–组件–系统数组中。

sents.en: Brain receives bounded decision partitions, reuses model connections and returns policy intents.
sents.zh: Brain 接收有界的决策分区，复用模型连接并返回策略意图。

sents.en: World validates these intents, resolves registered effects and applies updates.
sents.zh: World 校验这些意图，解析已注册的效果并应用更新。

sents.en: Production PostgreSQL commits world state, the event outbox and command result together; a failed pre-commit transition restores the tick snapshot.
sents.zh: 生产环境的 PostgreSQL 将世界状态、事件发件箱和命令结果一起提交；提交前的转换失败会恢复到该 tick 的快照。

sents.en: An outbox relay publishes committed events asynchronously.
sents.zh: 发件箱中继异步发布已提交的事件。

paragraphs.en: The household application evaluates financial consequences in a separate monthly ledger. Input preparation, decision inference and ledger calculation overlap across partitions, while household and condition IDs retain the pairing. Integer-cent accounting applies income, selected financing, consumption priorities and scheduled debt payments in a fixed order. The resulting paths record funded amounts and shortfalls.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭应用在单独的月度账本中评估财务后果。 输入准备、决策推断和账本计算在各分区之间重叠，同时家庭与条件 ID 保持配对关系。 以整数分为单位的记账按固定顺序应用收入、选定的融资方式、消费优先级和计划中的债务还款。 所得路径记录已提供的金额与缺口。

sents.zh: 家庭应用在单独的月度账本中评估财务后果。

paragraphs.en: The controlled engine benchmarks measure accepted decisions and writeback. The 12M application measures the asynchronous policy-to-ledger runner, and the monthly application adds evolving household states and a synchronization point for bank feedback. Section 5.5 reports the workloads and measurements for each execution setting.
paragraphs.zh: 受控引擎基准测试衡量已接受的决策与回写。 1200万应用衡量异步的策略到账本执行器，而月度应用则加入不断演变的企业/家庭状态以及一个用于银行反馈的同步点。 第5.5节报告每种执行设置的工作负载与测量结果。

paragraphs.en: FinQ and FinL learn choices from household states and task alternatives. FinQ combines a decoder backbone with LoRA and a learned decision head; FinL adapts a compact encoder and option-marker head. Existing approaches include Jev’s RLCD [36] , Kev’s option cross-entropy [38] and Laya’s encoder-based SFT and RLCD [3] , [37] . Figure 3 groups the benchmarked interfaces into six routes. The fixed-budget study contains ten trained versions: five native Laya adaptations and five Qwen head-only or LoRA adaptations, including FinQ. Full-data FinL is reported separately.
paragraphs.zh: FinQ 和 FinL 从家庭状态与任务备选项中学习选择。 FinQ 将解码器主干与 LoRA 以及一个可学习的决策头相结合；FinL 则适配一个紧凑的编码器和选项标记头。 现有方法包括 Jev 的 RLCD [36]、Kev 的选项交叉熵 [38] 以及 Laya 基于编码器的 SFT 和 RLCD [3]、[37]。 图 3 将被评测的接口归为六条路线。 固定预算研究包含十个训练版本：五个 Laya 原生适配版本和五个 Qwen 仅头部或 LoRA 适配版本，其中包括 FinQ。 全量数据的 FinL 将单独报告。

sents.en: FinQ and FinL learn choices from household states and task alternatives.
sents.zh: FinQ 和 FinL 从家庭状态与任务备选项中学习选择。

sents.zh: 现有方法包括 Jev 的 RLCD [36]、Kev 的选项交叉熵 [38] 以及 Laya 基于编码器的 SFT 和 RLCD [3]、[37]。

sents.zh: 图 3 将被评测的接口归为六条路线。

sents.zh: 全量数据的 FinL 将单独报告。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 — Decision interfaces and training routes. a, Twelve benchmarked models are grouped into six architecture or interface routes; all receive text inputs in this benchmark. b, Ten fixed-budget trained versions compare encoder adaptation, repeated CE training, low-rank adaptation and larger backbones. FinQ is the selected Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA-plus-head checkpoint at the 200k budget. Qwen candidates are encoded separately, L2-normalized and scored by a shared scalar head; head-only training freezes the backbone. Native continuations start from the matching SFT development-best checkpoint, and native RLCD combines CE with a proper-score policy-gradient term over noisy logits. Full development data (412,873 records) compare the two 200k 4B methods; the dashed arrow applies the selected method to an independently initialized 9B backbone. Each run uses fixed 20k development data for checkpoint selection. All ten trained versions and the zero-new-training native reference share the held-out test. Full-data FinL is the principal encoder route and a separate system reference. CE, cross-entropy.
paragraphs.zh: 图3 — 决策界面与训练路线。a，十二个被评测的模型被划分为六种架构或界面路线；在本基准中它们均接收文本输入。b，十个固定预算的训练版本比较了编码器适配、重复CE训练、低秩适配与更大的骨干网络。 FinQ 是在200k预算下选定的 Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA加头部 检查点。 Qwen候选智能体分别进行编码、L2归一化，并由共享的标量头打分；仅训练头部时会冻结骨干网络。 原生延续路线从匹配的SFT开发集最优检查点出发，原生RLCD则将CE与基于含噪logits的适当评分策略梯度项相结合。 全量开发数据（412,873条记录）用于比较两种200k预算的4B方法；虚线箭头表示将选定的方法应用于独立初始化的9B骨干网络。 每次运行均使用固定的20k开发数据进行检查点选择。 全部十个训练版本以及零新增训练的原生参照共享同一留出测试集。 全量数据的 FinL 是主要编码器路线，同时也是一个独立的系统参照。CE，交叉熵。

sents.en: Figure 3 — Decision interfaces and training routes. a, Twelve benchmarked models are grouped into six architecture or interface routes; all receive text inputs in this benchmark. b, Ten fixed-budget trained versions compare encoder adaptation, repeated CE training, low-rank adaptation and larger backbones.
sents.zh: 图3 — 决策界面与训练路线。a，十二个被评测的模型被划分为六种架构或界面路线；在本基准中它们均接收文本输入。b，十个固定预算的训练版本比较了编码器适配、重复CE训练、低秩适配与更大的骨干网络。

sents.en: Full development data (412,873 records) compare the two 200k 4B methods; the dashed arrow applies the selected method to an independently initialized 9B backbone.

paragraphs.en: FinQ is the selected Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA-plus-decision-head checkpoint trained on 200,000 unique examples. Candidate contexts independently encode the state, question and alternatives with the evaluated candidate marked. The final nonpadding representation is L2-normalized and scored by a shared scalar head. LoRA updates the backbone adapters together with that head [39] . The fixed 20k development set selects the checkpoint; the complete 412,873-example development partition compares the two 200k 4B methods before the corresponding Qwen3.5-9B run.
paragraphs.zh: FinQ 是选定的 Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA 加决策头检查点，基于 200,000 条独立样本训练而成。 候选上下文独立编码状态、问题和备选项，并标记出被评估的候选项。 最终的非填充表示经 L2 归一化，并由共享的标量头打分。 LoRA 与该头一起更新骨干网络的适配器 [39]。 固定的 2 万条开发集用于选择检查点；在运行对应的 Qwen3.5-9B 之前，使用完整的 412,873 条开发集划分来比较两种 20 万规模的 4B 方法。

sents.en: FinQ is the selected Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA-plus-decision-head checkpoint trained on 200,000 unique examples.
sents.zh: FinQ 是选定的 Qwen3.5-4B-Base LoRA 加决策头检查点，基于 200,000 条独立样本训练而成。

sents.zh: 候选上下文独立编码状态、问题和备选项，并标记出被评估的候选项。

paragraphs.en: FinL is the full-data, six-round financial adaptation of Laya’s 421M-parameter encoder and option-marker head [3] . Two SFT stages and native RLCD produce the three-round FinL-family policy. A further SFT and RLCD continuation broadens task coverage over 2.93M examples. Checkpoints are selected on development data, and probability temperatures are fitted on independent calibration data (Supplementary Methods M4–M6). FinL-mlx denotes execution of this full-data checkpoint through MLX; FinL-bilingual is the separate multilingual-base adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: FinL 是对 Laya 的 421M 参数编码器与选项标记头 [3] 进行全数据、六轮次的金融领域适配。 两个 SFT 阶段加上原生 RLCD 产生了三轮次的 FinL 家族策略。 进一步的 SFT 和 RLCD 延续训练在 2.93M 样本上扩展了任务覆盖范围。 检查点在开发数据上选择，概率温度在独立的校准数据上拟合（补充方法 M4–M6）。 FinL-mlx 表示该全数据检查点通过 MLX 执行；FinL-bilingual 是单独的多语言基础适配。

sents.en: FinL is the full-data, six-round financial adaptation of Laya’s 421M-parameter encoder and option-marker head [3] .
sents.zh: FinL 是对 Laya 的 421M 参数编码器与选项标记头 [3] 进行全数据、六轮次的金融领域适配。

sents.zh: 两个 SFT 阶段加上原生 RLCD 产生了三轮次的 FinL 家族策略。

paragraphs.en: The controls retain nested 50k/200k Qwen4B head-only and LoRA routes, the selected 200k Qwen9B LoRA route, and native Laya SFT on the same example sets. Additional native RLCD and CE-continuation controls start from the same SFT parent and share an added full-pass budget and development rule. Unique examples, repeated exposures, selected checkpoints and allocated GPU-hours are reported in Appendix S10.
paragraphs.zh: 对照组保留了嵌套的 50k/200k Qwen4B 仅头部微调与 LoRA 路线、选定的 200k Qwen9B LoRA 路线，以及在相同示例集上的原生 Laya SFT。 额外的原生 RLCD 和 CE 续训对照从同一个 SFT 父模型出发，并共享新增的完整轮次预算和开发规则。 独特示例、重复曝光次数、选定的检查点以及分配的 GPU 小时数见附录 S10。

sents.zh: 独特示例、重复曝光次数、选定的检查点以及分配的 GPU 小时数见附录 S10。

paragraphs.en: All adapters preserve the state, question and semantic alternatives while translating the policy’s scoring interface. The final 240,458-record test evaluates every fixed trained version and the original native reference after method and budget selection.
paragraphs.zh: 所有适配器在转换策略评分接口的同时，均保留状态、问题和语义备选项。 最终的240,458条记录测试集在完成方法和预算选择后，对每个固定的已训练版本以及原始原生参考版本进行评估。

sents.en: All adapters preserve the state, question and semantic alternatives while translating the policy’s scoring interface.
sents.zh: 所有适配器在转换策略评分接口的同时，均保留状态、问题和语义备选项。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate household information, decision-policy training and substitution, and action execution. FinQ and FinL provide the two principal training routes; matched controls compare adaptation choices, and execution benchmarks time accepted choices and state updates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估家庭信息、决策策略训练与替换，以及动作执行。 FinQ 和 FinL 提供了两条主要的训练路径；匹配的对照组比较适配选择，而执行基准测试则对已接受的选择和状态更新进行计时。

sents.en: We evaluate household information, decision-policy training and substitution, and action execution.
sents.zh: 我们评估家庭信息、决策策略训练与替换，以及动作执行。

sents.en: FinQ and FinL provide the two principal training routes; matched controls compare adaptation choices, and execution benchmarks time accepted choices and state updates.
sents.zh: FinQ 和 FinL 提供了两条主要的训练路径；匹配的对照组比较适配选择，而执行基准测试则对已接受的选择和状态更新进行计时。

paragraphs.en: PCA summarizes 14 standardized ordinal attributes in the constructed 10M bank. Among 7,227,206 complete records, PC1 explains 32.8904% of variance and PC2 explains 11.5234%. Income, spending, assets and debt load positively on the main axis, while age loads negatively. The 500M resource separately has a shard-mean PC1 explained variance of 32.62%, with loading standard deviations at most 0.0003. Tables S17–S18 report the bank analysis, and M2–M3 give the descriptive protocol. The independent synthetic companion supplies a reusable population with assigned financial states: Figures S1 and S4 describe its 2M personas, including the income, liquidity and obligation dimensions that enter the scenario interface.
paragraphs.zh: PCA 在所构建的 10M 银行数据集中对 14 个标准化序数属性进行了总结。 在 7,227,206 条完整记录中，PC1 解释了 32.8904% 的方差，PC2 解释了 11.5234%。 收入、支出、资产和债务在主轴上呈正载荷，而年龄呈负载荷。 500M 资源单独来看，其各分片的 PC1 平均解释方差为 32.62%，载荷标准差最大不超过 0.0003。 表 S17–S18 报告了银行数据分析，M2–M3 给出了描述性协议。 独立的合成伴生数据集提供了一个可复用、且被赋予金融状态的人群：图 S1 和 S4 描述了其 2M 个虚拟人物，包括进入场景接口的收入、流动性和债务维度。

sents.en: PCA summarizes 14 standardized ordinal attributes in the constructed 10M bank.
sents.zh: PCA 在所构建的 10M 银行数据集中对 14 个标准化序数属性进行了总结。

sents.en: Among 7,227,206 complete records, PC1 explains 32.8904% of variance and PC2 explains 11.5234%.
sents.zh: 在 7,227,206 条完整记录中，PC1 解释了 32.8904% 的方差，PC2 解释了 11.5234%。

sents.en: Income, spending, assets and debt load positively on the main axis, while age loads negatively.
sents.zh: 收入、支出、资产和债务在主轴上呈正载荷，而年龄呈负载荷。

sents.en: The 500M resource separately has a shard-mean PC1 explained variance of 32.62%, with loading standard deviations at most 0.0003.
sents.zh: 500M 资源单独来看，其各分片的 PC1 平均解释方差为 32.62%，载荷标准差最大不超过 0.0003。

sents.en: Tables S17–S18 report the bank analysis, and M2–M3 give the descriptive protocol.
sents.zh: 表 S17–S18 报告了银行数据分析，M2–M3 给出了描述性协议。

sents.en: The independent synthetic companion supplies a reusable population with assigned financial states: Figures S1 and S4 describe its 2M personas, including the income, liquidity and obligation dimensions that enter the scenario interface.
sents.zh: 独立的合成伴生数据集提供了一个可复用、且被赋予金融状态的人群：图 S1 和 S4 描述了其 2M 个虚拟人物，包括进入场景接口的收入、流动性和债务维度。

paragraphs.en: Rendered-persona evaluation finds high field coverage and uneven sensitivity to reconstruction errors (Figure 4). Six human raters score 100 personas against processed reference fields, with a pooled mean of 4.570/5. DeepSeek and GLM agree within one point of the human mean on 94.0% of persona-dimension comparisons, while giving higher scores for avoidance of unsupported inference and overall fidelity. Their omission sensitivity differs: GLM detects 24 of 24 valid omitted-target pairs, compared with 2 of 24 for DeepSeek. M7 describes the rendering, scoring and perturbation design.
paragraphs.zh: 渲染画像评估发现字段覆盖率较高，但对重构错误的敏感度不均衡（图4）。 六位人类评分者依据处理后的参考字段对100个画像进行评分，合并均值为4.570/5。 DeepSeek与GLM在94.0%的画像-维度比较中与人类均值相差不超过1分，同时在避免无依据推断和整体忠实度上给出更高分数。 二者对遗漏的敏感度不同：GLM检测出24个有效遗漏目标对中的24个，而DeepSeek仅检测出24个中的2个。 M7描述了渲染、评分与扰动设计。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 — Human persona fidelity, judge bias and known-error detection. a, Six raters score five dimensions for 100 processed survey-derived personas rendered from 44 processed fields, producing 600 ratings per dimension and 3,000 in total. Points show mean human scores on the five-point scale; pooled mean is 4.570. M2 measures avoidance of unsupported inference, so a higher score indicates fewer unsupported inferences. b, Mean AI score minus the six-rater mean for each dimension, based on 100 persona-level comparisons per judge. Both judges agree within one point on 470/500 comparisons (94.0%), while giving higher M2 and M5 scores. c, The proportion of valid original–perturbed pairs with a target-dimension decline of at least one score point after a known error is injected. Labels give detected/valid pairs; valid denominators vary from 23 to 25 per judge and error type. DeepSeek detects 2/24 omitted targets, compared with 24/24 for GLM. Supplementary Figure S3 shows the full human-score distributions and Table S16 reports scoring thresholds and non-target specificity.
paragraphs.zh: 图4 — 人物画像保真度、评审偏差与已知错误检测。a，六位评分者对由44个处理后字段渲染出的100个处理后调查来源人物画像在五个维度上进行评分，每个维度产生600个评分，总计3,000个评分。 各点显示五分制下的平均人类评分；合并均值为4.570。 M2衡量对无依据推断的回避程度，因此得分越高表示无依据推断越少。b，AI平均得分减去六位评分者均值，按每个维度计算，基于每位评审100个人物画像层面的比较。 两位评审在470/500次比较（94.0%）中分歧在一分以内，同时给出更高的M2和M5得分。c，注入已知错误后，目标维度下降至少一个分值的有效原始—扰动配对的比例。 标签给出检测到/有效的配对数；有效分母因评审和错误类型而异，范围为23至25。 DeepSeek检测到2/24个被遗漏的目标，而GLM为24/24。 补充图S3展示了完整的人类评分分布，补充表S16报告了评分阈值与非目标特异性。

paragraphs.en: Financial supervision improves shared-question prediction in the FinL family (Figure 5). The three-round policy raises native BF16 accuracy from 60.2080% to 74.5336% and question-macro F1 from 29.5574% to 38.0164%. Full-data FinL maintains shared-question accuracy at 74.5586% while extending supervised task coverage: accuracy on the expanded test rises from 56.3657% to 67.2728%. The auxiliary FinL-bilingual policy evaluated in Chinese gains 21.61 accuracy points and 10.60 F1 points over its multilingual base.
paragraphs.zh: 金融监督提升了 FinL 系列在共享问题预测上的表现（图 5）。 三轮策略将原生 BF16 准确率从 60.2080% 提升至 74.5336%，问题宏 F1 从 29.5574% 提升至 38.0164%。 全量数据的 FinL 在扩展监督任务覆盖面的同时，将共享问题准确率保持在 74.5586%：扩展测试集上的准确率从 56.3657% 提升至 67.2728%。 以中文评估的辅助 FinL-bilingual 策略相比其多语言基座，准确率提升 21.61 个百分点，F1 提升 10.60 个百分点。

sents.zh: 金融监督提升了 FinL 系列在共享问题预测上的表现（图 5）。

sents.en: The three-round policy raises native BF16 accuracy from 60.2080% to 74.5336% and question-macro F1 from 29.5574% to 38.0164%.
Full-data FinL maintains shared-question accuracy at 74.5586% while extending supervised task coverage: accuracy on the expanded test rises from 56.3657% to 67.2728%.
sents.zh: 全量数据的 FinL 在扩展监督任务覆盖面的同时，将共享问题准确率保持在 74.5586%：扩展测试集上的准确率从 56.3657% 提升至 67.2728%。

sents.zh: 以中文评估的辅助 FinL-bilingual 策略相比其多语言基座，准确率提升 21.61 个百分点，F1 提升 10.60 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 — Financial training improves shared-question prediction in the FinL family. a, The three-round FinL-family policy uses financial-question supervision; full-data FinL adds expanded financial supervision through another SFT and RLCD stage. FinL-bilingual derives from multilingual Laya and remains an initial-supervision adaptation. b, Accuracy gains over the corresponding base are 14.33 and 14.35 percentage points for the native variants and 21.61 points for FinL-bilingual evaluated in Chinese. c, Question-macro F1 rises by 8.46, 8.84 and 10.60 points. Comparisons use 240,458 shared financial-question QA observations, 119 question versions and PyTorch BF16. Connectors pair adaptations with their corresponding base; labels show scores and percentage-point differences. Accuracy weights observations equally; F1 averages candidate-class F1 within version, then weights supported versions equally.
paragraphs.zh: 图5 — 金融训练提升了 FinL 系列在共享问题上的预测表现。a，三轮 FinL 系列策略使用金融问题监督；全数据 FinL 通过另一个 SFT 和 RLCD 阶段加入了扩展的金融监督。 FinL-bilingual 源自多语言 Laya，仍属于初始监督的适配。b，相对于对应基座，本地变体的准确率分别提升 14.33 和 14.35 个百分点，而以中文评测的 FinL-bilingual 提升 21.61 个百分点。c，问题宏 F1 分别提升 8.46、8.84 和 10.60 个百分点。 比较基于 240,458 条共享金融问题问答观测、119 个问题版本以及 PyTorch BF16。 连接线将各适配与其对应基座配对；标签展示分数与百分点差异。 准确率对所有观测等权计算；F1 先在每个版本内对候选类别 F1 取平均，再对有支持的版本等权平均。

paragraphs.en: Respondent information also improves prediction when the trained policy and questions remain fixed (Figure 6; Table 3). On the matched 20,000-QA panel, full profiles add 6.2475 question-macro F1 points over empty profiles (95% interval 5.4958–6.7267) and 3.6047 points over another respondent’s profile for the same question (2.7977–4.3155). Full profiles outperform both the question-only and training-majority controls, showing that household attributes contribute information beyond the question’s answer distribution. The gain appears in financial knowledge, risk and investment attitudes, and saving and credit products.
paragraphs.zh: 当训练策略和问题保持固定时，受访者信息同样能提升预测效果（图6；表3）。 在匹配的2万个问答面板上，完整画像比空画像高出6.2475个问题宏观F1百分点（95%区间为5.4958–6.7267），比同一问题的另一受访者的画像高出3.6047个百分点（2.7977–4.3155）。 完整画像优于仅问题和训练多数两个对照组，表明家庭属性提供了超出问题答案分布的信息。 这一提升体现在金融知识、风险与投资态度以及储蓄和信贷产品方面。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 — Respondent information improves survey-answer prediction. a, Question-macro F1 of full-profile FinL minus each labelled comparator, in percentage points; zero indicates equal scores and positive values favour full-profile FinL. Points show paired differences on 20,000 QA; lines show 95% bootstrap intervals from 2,000 resamples of 6,752 household/respondent groups. The wrong-profile control supplies another respondent’s information for the same question. b, FinL scores with full profiles (teal) and no respondent information (grey), grouped by financial question family. paragraphs.en: The adaptation controls distinguish the training choices supported by the common interface (Tables 2 and 5). FinQ is the selected 200k Qwen4B LoRA-plus-head route; updating the backbone is more effective than training only its head. The evaluated FinQ and Qwen9B LoRA200 routes reach similar accuracy under the common downstream protocol. Native Laya controls show that supervised adaptation supplies most of the encoder’s predictive gain. Additional RLCD raises accuracy slightly over SFT, whereas CE continuation yields higher question-macro F1 than RLCD. Table 2 retains every fixed-budget version, and Appendix S10 reports development selection, repeated exposures, training cost and paired intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 适配控制区分了公共接口所支持的训练选择（表2和表5）。 FinQ 是选定的 200k Qwen4B LoRA 加头部路线；更新主干网络比仅训练其头部更有效。 所评估的 FinQ 和 Qwen9B LoRA200 路线在公共下游协议下达到相近的准确率。 原生 Laya 控制实验表明，有监督适配贡献了编码器的大部分预测增益。 额外的 RLCD 相比 SFT 略微提升准确率，而 CE 续训比 RLCD 带来更高的问题宏平均 F1。 表2保留了每个固定预算版本，附录 S10 报告了开发集选择、重复曝光、训练成本和配对区间。

paragraphs.en: shared test: 240,458 records, 119 question versions and 8,275 respondent groups; invalid decisions count as incorrect. All ten trained versions use their development-best checkpoint. Exposures count downstream example presentations in this experiment, including the SFT parent for continued native models. paragraphs.en: Fixed-upstream comparisons hold the task and model allocation common, timing one accepted choice and writeback per agent. At 1,000 agents with one T4 replica, Genese takes 6.17 seconds, versus 7.45 for OASIS and 7.70 for OneSim. These local adapters use a memory-backed SQLite WAL state–event store; production uses PostgreSQL.

paragraphs.en: The 12M purchase-funding run tests the preparation–inference–ledger pipeline at population scale using FinL-mlx. The shock application uses the same full-data checkpoint and runtime, extending the purchase task to monthly re-selection, evolving contracts and lagged bank feedback over 24 months (Sections 6.4–6.6). Household states advance through accepted transitions; each monthly world closes before its aggregate repayment feedback sets the next month’s offers.
paragraphs.zh: 1200 万的购房资金运行使用 FinL-mlx 在人口规模上测试「准备–推理–账本」流水线。 冲击应用使用相同的全量数据检查点和运行时，将购房任务扩展为按月重选、演化的合同以及 24 个月内的滞后银行反馈（第 6.4–6.6 节）。 家庭状态通过被接受的转移向前推进；每个月度世界在其总体还款反馈设定下一个月的报价之前关闭。

paragraphs.en: The 12M-household application executes 24M one-shot choices and 288M monthly ledger states through the asynchronous HTTP policy–ledger runner. A total of 14 GPUs (eight H100 and six A100) complete the common end-to-end interval in 3 h 59 min 17 s, sustaining 1,671.66 choices/s with full private tracing (Figure 8a). The runner overlaps input preparation, direct option scoring, ledgers and compressed writes across 2,400 work units, using service batches of at most sixteen requests. Supplementary Methods M9 defines the measured interval, token accounting and completed-result recovery.

paragraphs.en: The three FinL-mlx application groups comprise an eight-task suite, the 12M purchase-funding experiment and a monthly extension with evolving household histories and bank feedback (Table 7). paragraphs.en: In that sixteen-month task, a 2,000-household comparison holds households, the available menu and the ledger fixed. FinL selects fully funded plans for 87.00% of households, compared with 79.30% for original Laya and 88.05% for the fixed restrained-consumption plan C0. Relative to C0, FinL executes CNY 1,146.60 more consumption and retains CNY 1,115.34 less cash. Information and menu controls separate changes in what agents are told from changes in the available plans (Appendix S13).
paragraphs.zh: 在那项为期十六个月的任务中，一个包含 2,000 户家庭的对照将家庭、可选菜单和账本固定不变。 FinL 为 87.00% 的家庭选择了全额资金计划，相比之下，原始 Laya 为 79.30%，固定约束消费计划 C0 为 88.05%。 相对于 C0，FinL 多执行了 1,146.60 元人民币的消费，并少保留了 1,115.34 元人民币的现金。 信息与菜单控制将智能体被告知内容的变化与可用计划的变化分离开来（附录 S13）。

paragraphs.en: FinL-mlx and original Laya completed 181,892 one-shot choices across the eight-task suite in English and Chinese: 181,888 choices in complete condition pairs and four supplemental T1 choices. Each task contains 2,842 pairs from its eligible financial parents within a 207-parent pool. Table S27 specifies the income, medical-bill, purchase, loan-rate, return, payment-budget and asset-value changes, together with their action consequences. Task-specific parent counts define the response intervals. In the exploratory T3 grid, raising the purchase goal and tied approved limit by 50% raised FinL-mlx’s consumption by CNY 17,148.49 (95% interval 14,818.58–19,601.23), versus 1,194.03 with Chinese inputs (638.59–1,825.40). These intervals resampled the 207 parents. Both input languages use the same English-base checkpoints with identical financial specifications. The input-language difference accompanied changes in payments, debt and unmet routine needs (Appendix S11).
paragraphs.zh: FinL-mlx 与原始 Laya 在八项任务的英文和中文测试套件中完成了 181,892 次单次选择：其中 181,888 次选择来自完整的条件对，另有四次补充性的 T1 选择。 每项任务包含来自 207 个符合条件的财务父项池中其合格财务父项的 2,842 个条件对。 表 S27 规定了收入、医疗账单、购买、贷款利率、收益、还款预算和资产价值的变化，以及它们对应的行为后果。 各任务特定的父项数量决定了响应区间。 在探索性的 T3 网格中，将购买目标和与之挂钩的已批准额度提高 50%，使 FinL-mlx 的消费增加了人民币 17,148.49（95% 区间为 14,818.58–19,601.23），而中文输入下为 1,194.03（区间 638.59–1,825.40）。 这些区间对 207 个父项进行了重抽样。 两种输入语言使用相同的以英文为基础的检查点，且财务设定完全一致。 输入语言的差异伴随着还款、债务和未满足的日常需求的变化（附录 S11）。

paragraphs.en: The purchase-funding application uses one fixed T3 comparison for 12M distinct synthetic household agents, with English inputs and frozen FinL-mlx: the full-data English-base FinL checkpoint in MLX CUDA FP16. Each household faced a deferrable purchase goal and tied approved limit of CNY 20,000 or 30,000, with alternatives to defer, finance half, or finance the full purchase at an assigned 5% annual rate over 24 months. The bounded HTTP decision service returned one selection per condition, which the independent accounting path carried through a twelve-month ledger (Figure 8a; Table S33).
paragraphs.zh: 购买融资应用对 12M 个不同的合成家庭智能体使用一个固定的 T3 对比，输入为英文，并使用冻结的 FinL-mlx：即 MLX CUDA FP16 格式的全数据英文基础版 FinL 检查点。 每个家庭都面临一个可推迟的购买目标和与之绑定的 2 万元或 3 万元已批准额度，可选方案为推迟购买、融资一半，或以指定的 5% 年利率分 24 期融资全款购买。 有界的 HTTP 决策服务为每个条件返回一个选择，独立的记账路径将该选择贯穿到为期十二个月的账本中（图 8a；表 S33）。

paragraphs.en: Executed purchase spending rose by CNY 2,890.97 per household; a CNY 3.79 reduction in routine consumption yielded a CNY 2,887.18 increase in total twelve-month consumption. Closing cash fell by CNY 928.76 and closing debt rose by CNY 2,072.45; actual debt payments and accrued interest also increased. Unfunded routine needs rose by CNY 3.79, and simulated default rose by 1.6663 percentage points (Figure 8b–c). The ledger followed the first twelve months of the twenty-four-month financing contract (Tables S32–S33).
paragraphs.zh: 已执行的购买支出每户增加人民币2,890.97元；日常消费减少3.79元，使十二个月总消费增加2,887.18元。 期末现金减少人民币928.76元，期末债务增加人民币2,072.45元；实际债务偿付和应计利息也增加了。 未获资金支持的日常需求增加人民币3.79元，模拟违约率上升1.6663个百分点（图8b–c）。 账本记录了二十四个月融资合同的前十二个月（表S32–S33）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 — Population-scale execution and paired financial outcomes. a, FinL-mlx FP16 executes two frozen T3 conditions for 12M synthetic household agents, producing 24M one-shot choices and 288M monthly ledger states. Each selected action is executed through twelve accounting months. b, Full-panel paired mean changes, with total consumption comprising purchase and routine spending, when the deferrable purchase goal and tied approved limit rise from CNY 20,000 to 30,000, with an assigned 5% annual rate and 24-month loan. c, Simulated default over the twelve-month ledger horizon rises from 17.35% to 19.01%. paragraphs.en: Consumption increases most among households with decision makers aged 25–34, with larger age–income-standardized responses also among the employed, college-educated and three-person households. In the 24-month panel, households earning below CNY 20,000 a year most often exhaust cash and enter simulated default by month 3, while the CNY 50,000–100,000 income group contributes over half of the additional repayment-and-arrears pressure entering the bank rule under persistent income loss (Table S48).
paragraphs.zh: 消费增长在决策者年龄为25–34岁的家庭中最为显著，年龄–收入标准化后的反应在就业家庭、受过大学教育的家庭以及三人家庭中也更大。 在24个月的面板中，年收入低于2万元的家庭最常在第3个月耗尽现金并进入模拟违约状态，而在持续收入损失的情况下进入银行规则时，5万–10万元收入群体贡献了超过一半的额外还款与欠款压力（表S48）。

sents.zh: 消费增长在决策者年龄为25–34岁的家庭中最为显著，年龄–收入标准化后的反应在就业家庭、受过大学教育的家庭以及三人家庭中也更大。

sents.en: In the 24-month panel, households earning below CNY 20,000 a year most often exhaust cash and enter simulated default by month 3, while the CNY 50,000–100,000 income group contributes over half of the additional repayment-and-arrears pressure entering the bank rule under persistent income loss (Table S48).

paragraphs.en: Households whose decision makers are aged 25–34 show a consumption increment of CNY 9,161.69, compared with 12.88 at ages 55–64 and zero at ages 65 and above. Reweighting each age group to the full panel’s income distribution preserves the contrast: the 25–34 mean becomes 9,181.62 and the age-65+ mean remains zero. Across annual-income groups, the mean increment rises from CNY 1,059.67 below 20,000 to 6,052.72 at 500,000 or above. Within ages 25–34, the income pattern is nonmonotonic, linking the marginal gradient to the joint household profile (Tables S41–S43). All 2,364,307 households with decision makers aged 65+ deferred the purchase in both conditions. At ages 55–64, 99.96% also deferred in both; 859 switched from deferral to the full purchase, 36 kept the full-purchase option and two switched to deferral, producing the CNY 12.88 mean increment.
paragraphs.zh: 决策者年龄在25–34岁之间的家庭消费增量为9,161.69元，而55–64岁年龄组为12.88，65岁及以上年龄组为零。 将各年龄组重新加权至整个面板的收入分布后，这一对比仍然存在：25–34岁年龄组的均值变为9,181.62，而65岁及以上年龄组的均值仍为零。 在各年收入组中，平均增量从年收入低于20,000的1,059.67元上升至年收入500,000及以上的6,052.72。 在25–34岁年龄组内部，收入模式呈非单调性，将这一边际梯度与家庭的联合特征联系起来（表S41–S43）。 在两种条件下，所有2,364,307个决策者年龄在65岁及以上的家庭均推迟了购买。 在55–64岁年龄组中，99.96%的家庭在两种条件下也均推迟了购买；859个家庭从推迟购买转为全额购买，36个家庭保持全额购买选项，2个家庭转为推迟购买，由此产生12.88的平均增量。

paragraphs.en: The ledger connects these selected purchases to subsequent resources and payments (Figure 9c). The lowest income bracket increases purchase spending by CNY 1,061.72 and reduces routine spending by 2.04; the highest bracket increases purchases by 6,052.72 with routine spending unchanged. Their additional actual debt payments are 60.45 and 2,877.92, respectively. T3 purchases are fully financed at origination; subsequent cash use and repayment determine the debt carried through the horizon. With income and opening resources fixed within each pair, Δ ​ C = Δ ​ D − Δ ​ K − Δ ​ I \Delta C=\Delta D-\Delta K-\Delta I links additional consumption to additional closing debt, cash drawdown and accrued interest.

paragraphs.en: Education, employment and household size also distinguish purchase responses under the same age–income mixture. The consumption increment is CNY 398.12 for decision makers with primary education or below and 3,820.99 for the college-educated group; it is 1,406.09 for those not working and 3,437.93 for the employed. One-person households show an increment of 1,666.17, compared with 3,797.16 for three-person households. Each group contains all 42 age–income cells (Table S47).
paragraphs.zh: 在相同的年龄—收入组合下，教育程度、就业状况和家庭规模也会区分出不同的购买反应。 小学及以下学历决策者的消费增量为398.12元，大学学历群体为3,820.99元；无工作人员为1,406.09元，有工作者为3,437.93元。 一人户的增量为1,666.17，而三人户为3,797.16。 每个组均包含全部42个年龄—收入单元格（表S47）。

sents.zh: 在相同的年龄—收入组合下，教育程度、就业状况和家庭规模也会区分出不同的购买反应。

paragraphs.en: The choice transitions explain most of these differences. Of the CNY 3,427.57 difference in purchase response between the college-educated and primary-or-below groups, 3,183.17 comes from switching from deferral to a purchase and 234.46 from expanding the amount under the same half- or full-purchase choice. The routine-spending difference is − 4.70 -4.70 , giving a consumption-response difference of 3,422.87. This difference accompanies 1,004.78 more cash drawdown, 1,009.48 more actual debt payments and 2,555.05 more closing debt. Employment and household-size contrasts follow the same dominant deferral-to-purchase channel. Risk preference and housing tenure add only 0.13 and 0.07 percentage points, respectively, to the consumption variation explained by age–income groups (Table S46).
paragraphs.zh: 选择之间的转换解释了这些差异的大部分。 在大学及以上学历组与小学及以下组之间 3,427.57 元的购买响应差异中，3,183.17 来自从推迟转为购买，234.46 来自在相同的半额或全额购买选择下扩大购买金额。 日常消费差异为 −4.70，由此得到的消费响应差异为 3,422.87。 这一差异伴随着多 1,004.78 的现金支出、多 1,009.48 的实际债务偿还和多 2,555.05 的期末债务。 就业与家庭规模的对比也遵循同样的以从推迟转为购买为主的渠道。 风险偏好与住房产权仅使年龄—收入组别所解释的消费变异增加 0.13 和 0.07 个百分点（表 S46）。

sents.en: The choice transitions explain most of these differences.
sents.zh: 选择之间的转换解释了这些差异的大部分。

paragraphs.en: Financial assets distinguish consumption size from the way households carry the obligation. The raw consumption increment is CNY 2,580.88 for financial assets below 10,000 and 3,054.60 for assets of 1–2 million. Reweighting both asset groups to the same age–income distribution reverses that ordering to 3,014.26 and 2,361.25. The higher-asset group nevertheless makes more additional actual payments (1,137.87 versus 905.61), uses more cash (1,136.28 versus 905.61) and retains less additional closing debt (1,311.52 versus 2,229.04). Higher financial-asset stock therefore accompanies a larger cash-and-payment contribution to a smaller consumption increment under the common profile mixture (Table S44).
paragraphs.zh: 金融资产将消费规模与家庭承担该义务的方式区分开来。 对于金融资产低于10,000元的家庭，原始消费增量为人民币2,580.88元；对于资产在100万至200万元之间的家庭，为3,054.60元。 将两组资产家庭重新加权至相同的年龄–收入分布后，该排序发生逆转，变为3,014.26元和2,361.25元。 然而，较高资产组仍做出更多的额外实际支付（1,137.87元对905.61元），使用更多的现金（1,136.28元对905.61元），并保留更少的额外期末债务（1,311.52元对2,229.04元）。 因此，在共同的画像混合下，更高的金融资产存量伴随着对更小消费增量的更大的现金与支付贡献（表S44）。

sents.zh: 金融资产将消费规模与家庭承担该义务的方式区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Opening debt reveals a different adjustment. Under the same age–income mixture, households without old debt increase consumption by CNY 2,864.61 and actual payments by 1,063.72. Households with CNY 2–5 million of opening debt increase consumption by 1,811.13 and actual payments by 44.31; their cash drawdown is 43.97 and closing-debt increment 1,848.23. The high-debt group’s additional consumption is carried predominantly as debt through the twelve-month window. Adding debt stock to age–income groups increases the between-group share of consumption-response variation by 1.40 percentage points and payment-response variation by 2.15 points (Tables S44–S45).
paragraphs.zh: 期初债务揭示出一种不同的调整方式。 在相同的年龄–收入构成下，没有旧债务的家庭消费增加2,864.61元，实际支付增加1,063.72元。 期初债务为200–500万元的家庭消费增加1,811.13元，实际支付增加44.31元；其现金支取为43.97元，期末债务增量为1,848.23元。 高债务群体的额外消费在十二个月的观察期内主要以债务形式承担。 在年龄–收入分组中加入债务存量后，消费反应变异的组间份额提高1.40个百分点，支付反应变异提高2.15个百分点（表S44–S45）。

sents.en: Opening debt reveals a different adjustment.
sents.zh: 期初债务揭示出一种不同的调整方式。

sents.en: Households with CNY 2–5 million of opening debt increase consumption by 1,811.13 and actual payments by 44.31; their cash drawdown is 43.97 and closing-debt increment 1,848.23.
sents.zh: 期初债务为200–500万元的家庭消费增加1,811.13元，实际支付增加44.31元；其现金支取为43.97元，期末债务增量为1,848.23元。

sents.en: The high-debt group’s additional consumption is carried predominantly as debt through the twelve-month window.
sents.zh: 高债务群体的额外消费在十二个月的观察期内主要以债务形式承担。

sents.en: Adding debt stock to age–income groups increases the between-group share of consumption-response variation by 1.40 percentage points and payment-response variation by 2.15 points (Tables S44–S45).
sents.zh: 在年龄–收入分组中加入债务存量后，消费反应变异的组间份额提高1.40个百分点，支付反应变异提高2.15个百分点（表S44–S45）。

paragraphs.en: The monthly application retains the purchase task and adds changing income, spending needs and bank offers (Figure 10). It uses English state descriptions, instructions and alternatives with the same frozen FinL-mlx policy, the full-data English-base FinL checkpoint in MLX CUDA FP16. The same 10,000-household panel faces CNY 20,000 and 30,000 deferrable purchase goals for 24 months under each of five shock paths and an unshocked reference. Temporary and persistent income losses, a one-time necessary expense, their combination and sustained income gains probe different resource channels. Both goal conditions use the same bank product: a CNY 30,000 ceiling on outstanding new principal, 5% annual interest, 24 installments and zero fees. This extension changes only the purchase goal; the 12M one-shot application jointly changes the goal and tied approved limit.
paragraphs.zh: 该月度应用保留购买任务，并增加变化的收入、支出需求和银行优惠（图 10）。 它使用英文状态描述、指令和备选项，配合相同的冻结 FinL-mlx 策略，即 MLX CUDA FP16 下的全量数据英文基础版 FinL 检查点。 同一 10,000 户家庭面板在五条冲击路径及一条无冲击参考路径下，各自面对为期 24 个月的 20,000 元和 30,000 元可延期购买目标。 暂时性和持久性收入损失、一次性必要支出、二者的组合以及持续的收入增长，用于探测不同的资源渠道。 两个目标条件使用同一银行产品：新增未偿本金上限 30,000 元，年利率 5%，24 期分期，零费用。 该扩展仅改变购买目标；12M 一次性应用则同时改变目标和关联的已批准额度。

sents.en: The monthly application retains the purchase task and adds changing income, spending needs and bank offers (Figure 10).
sents.zh: 该月度应用保留购买任务，并增加变化的收入、支出需求和银行优惠（图 10）。

sents.en: It uses English state descriptions, instructions and alternatives with the same frozen FinL-mlx policy, the full-data English-base FinL checkpoint in MLX CUDA FP16.
sents.zh: 它使用英文状态描述、指令和备选项，配合相同的冻结 FinL-mlx 策略，即 MLX CUDA FP16 下的全量数据英文基础版 FinL 检查点。

sents.en: The same 10,000-household panel faces CNY 20,000 and 30,000 deferrable purchase goals for 24 months under each of five shock paths and an unshocked reference.
sents.zh: 同一 10,000 户家庭面板在五条冲击路径及一条无冲击参考路径下，各自面对为期 24 个月的 20,000 元和 30,000 元可延期购买目标。

sents.en: Temporary and persistent income losses, a one-time necessary expense, their combination and sustained income gains probe different resource channels.
sents.zh: 暂时性和持久性收入损失、一次性必要支出、二者的组合以及持续的收入增长，用于探测不同的资源渠道。

sents.en: Both goal conditions use the same bank product: a CNY 30,000 ceiling on outstanding new principal, 5% annual interest, 24 installments and zero fees.
sents.zh: 两个目标条件使用同一银行产品：新增未偿本金上限 30,000 元，年利率 5%，24 期分期，零费用。

sents.en: This extension changes only the purchase goal; the 12M one-shot application jointly changes the goal and tied approved limit.
sents.zh: 该扩展仅改变购买目标；12M 一次性应用则同时改变目标和关联的已批准额度。

paragraphs.en: Each month the policy sees the full household profile, current resources, remaining purchase need, all executed monthly history and dated contracts. It chooses adjustable consumption and whether to wait, buy with cash or finance a partial/full purchase. Purchases reduce the remaining goal, so another monthly decision does not replenish demand. Income and necessary spending enter the ledger, and actual repayments and arrears update the following month’s offers. A route-specific portfolio factor combines lagged repayment coverage and material thirty-day arrears with individual affordability. The same policy rules apply in all twelve worlds (M11).
paragraphs.zh: 每个月，策略可以看到完整的家庭画像、当前资源、剩余购买需求、所有已执行的月度历史以及带日期的合同。 它会选择可调节的消费水平，并决定是等待、用现金购买，还是通过融资进行部分或全额购买。 购买会减少剩余目标，因此后续的月度决策不会重新产生需求。 收入和必要支出记入账本，实际还款和欠款会更新下一个月的报价。 一个针对路径的投资组合因子将滞后的还款覆盖率和实际的三十天欠款与个人可负担能力相结合。 相同的策略规则适用于全部十二个世界（M11）。

sents.en: Each month the policy sees the full household profile, current resources, remaining purchase need, all executed monthly history and dated contracts.
sents.zh: 每个月，策略可以看到完整的家庭画像、当前资源、剩余购买需求、所有已执行的月度历史以及带日期的合同。

sents.en: It chooses adjustable consumption and whether to wait, buy with cash or finance a partial/full purchase.
sents.zh: 它会选择可调节的消费水平，并决定是等待、用现金购买，还是通过融资进行部分或全额购买。

sents.en: Purchases reduce the remaining goal, so another monthly decision does not replenish demand.
sents.zh: 购买会减少剩余目标，因此后续的月度决策不会重新产生需求。

sents.en: Income and necessary spending enter the ledger, and actual repayments and arrears update the following month’s offers.
sents.zh: 收入和必要支出记入账本，实际还款和欠款会更新下一个月的报价。

sents.en: A route-specific portfolio factor combines lagged repayment coverage and material thirty-day arrears with individual affordability.
sents.zh: 一个针对路径的投资组合因子将滞后的还款覆盖率和实际的三十天欠款与个人可负担能力相结合。

sents.en: The same policy rules apply in all twelve worlds (M11).
sents.zh: 相同的策略规则适用于全部十二个世界（M11）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 10 — Five shock paths extend the purchase task to a stateful financial environment. Income is relative to the original household income; the necessary-expense shock adds 90% of one original month’s income in month 10. R0 supplies the unshocked reference. The same 10,000 households face both purchase goals in every path. Monthly choices update cash, purchases and dated obligations; completed repayment and arrears records update next-month bank offers under a common rule.
paragraphs.zh: 图10 —— 五条冲击路径将购买任务扩展至一个有状态的金融环境。 收入相对于原始家庭收入而言；必要支出冲击在第10个月加入相当于原始一个月收入90%的支出。 R0 提供未受冲击的参照。 同样的10,000个家庭在每条路径中面对两个购买目标。 每月的选择更新现金、购买和带日期的债务；已完成的还款和欠款记录按照共同规则更新下个月的银行报价。

sents.en: Figure 10 — Five shock paths extend the purchase task to a stateful financial environment.
sents.zh: 图10 —— 五条冲击路径将购买任务扩展至一个有状态的金融环境。

sents.en: Income is relative to the original household income; the necessary-expense shock adds 90% of one original month’s income in month 10.
sents.zh: 收入相对于原始家庭收入而言；必要支出冲击在第10个月加入相当于原始一个月收入90%的支出。

sents.en: R0 supplies the unshocked reference.
sents.zh: R0 提供未受冲击的参照。

sents.en: The same 10,000 households face both purchase goals in every path.
sents.zh: 同样的10,000个家庭在每条路径中面对两个购买目标。

sents.en: Monthly choices update cash, purchases and dated obligations; completed repayment and arrears records update next-month bank offers under a common rule.
sents.zh: 每月的选择更新现金、购买和带日期的债务；已完成的还款和欠款记录按照共同规则更新下个月的银行报价。

paragraphs.en: At a fixed CNY 20,000 purchase goal, sustained income gains support more purchases and cash accumulation, while persistent income loss reduces both (Table 8). Cumulative routine consumption varies by about CNY 1,016 across routes, compared with 91,085 in closing cash. Base necessary needs are mostly unchanged and paid before debt service; cash and purchases absorb more of the adjustment. Available offers respond to lagged income, scheduled payments and portfolio repayment stress.
paragraphs.zh: 在固定的2万元购买目标下，持续的收入的增加支持更多的购买和现金积累，而持续的收入的减少则使两者都下降（表8）。 累计日常消费在不同路线之间相差约1,016元，而期末现金为91,085元。 基本必要需求基本不变，并在偿债之前支付；现金和购买吸收了更多的调整。 可用报价对滞后收入、计划付款和组合还款压力作出反应。

sents.en: At a fixed CNY 20,000 purchase goal, sustained income gains support more purchases and cash accumulation, while persistent income loss reduces both (Table 8).
sents.zh: 在固定的2万元购买目标下，持续的收入的增加支持更多的购买和现金积累，而持续的收入的减少则使两者都下降（表8）。

sents.en: Cumulative routine consumption varies by about CNY 1,016 across routes, compared with 91,085 in closing cash.
sents.zh: 累计日常消费在不同路线之间相差约1,016元，而期末现金为91,085元。

sents.en: Base necessary needs are mostly unchanged and paid before debt service; cash and purchases absorb more of the adjustment.
sents.zh: 基本必要需求基本不变，并在偿债之前支付；现金和购买吸收了更多的调整。

sents.en: Available offers respond to lagged income, scheduled payments and portfolio repayment stress.
sents.zh: 可用报价对滞后收入、计划付款和组合还款压力作出反应。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 — Month-24 household outcomes under a fixed CNY 20k purchase goal
paragraphs.zh: 表 8 — 固定 2 万元人民币购买目标下第 24 个月的家庭结果

paragraphs.en: CNY per household, rounded to the nearest yuan, for the same 10,000-household panel and fixed CNY 20,000 purchase goal. Purchases and routine consumption accumulate through month 24; cash is the closing stock and offers are quoted at the month-24 decision using months 21–23. Routine consumption comprises executed base necessary and adjustable spending, excluding the added shock expense. R1 applies temporary income loss in months 7–9; R2 retains the reduced income level after month 9; R3 adds one necessary expense in month 10; R4 combines R1 and R3; R5 retains the higher income level after month 9. All paths share the CNY 30k ceiling on outstanding new principal, 5% annual interest and 24 installments. Figure 10 and M11 specify the paths and financial rules.
paragraphs.zh: 单位为每户人民币，四舍五入到最接近的元，针对同样的1万户固定样本组与固定的人民币20,000元购买目标。 购买与日常消费累计至第24个月；现金为期末存量，且报价在第24个月决策时基于第21至23个月给出。 日常消费包括已执行的基础必要支出和可调整支出，不包括新增的冲击性支出。 R1在第7至9个月施加临时收入损失；R2在第9个月后保持降低后的收入水平；R3在第10个月增加一笔必要支出；R4合并R1与R3；R5在第9个月后保持较高的收入水平。 所有路径共享未偿新增本金人民币3万元上限、5%年利率以及24期分期还款。 图10与M11规定了这些路径与财务规则。

sents.en: CNY per household, rounded to the nearest yuan, for the same 10,000-household panel and fixed CNY 20,000 purchase goal.
sents.zh: 单位为每户人民币，四舍五入到最接近的元，针对同样的1万户固定样本组与固定的人民币20,000元购买目标。

sents.en: Purchases and routine consumption accumulate through month 24; cash is the closing stock and offers are quoted at the month-24 decision using months 21–23.
sents.zh: 购买与日常消费累计至第24个月；现金为期末存量，且报价在第24个月决策时基于第21至23个月给出。

sents.en: Routine consumption comprises executed base necessary and adjustable spending, excluding the added shock expense.
sents.zh: 日常消费包括已执行的基础必要支出和可调整支出，不包括新增的冲击性支出。

sents.en: R1 applies temporary income loss in months 7–9; R2 retains the reduced income level after month 9; R3 adds one necessary expense in month 10; R4 combines R1 and R3; R5 retains the higher income level after month 9.
sents.zh: R1在第7至9个月施加临时收入损失；R2在第9个月后保持降低后的收入水平；R3在第10个月增加一笔必要支出；R4合并R1与R3；R5在第9个月后保持较高的收入水平。

sents.en: All paths share the CNY 30k ceiling on outstanding new principal, 5% annual interest and 24 installments.
sents.zh: 所有路径共享未偿新增本金人民币3万元上限、5%年利率以及24期分期还款。

sents.en: Figure 10 and M11 specify the paths and financial rules.
sents.zh: 图10与M11规定了这些路径与财务规则。

paragraphs.en: Relative to the same-goal unshocked path, temporary income loss reduces cumulative purchases by CNY 376.57/1,033.50 per household and closing cash by 8,052.79/7,369.20 (20k/30k goals). Income recovers in month 10, but the earlier resource loss remains visible at month 24. Persistent income loss produces larger purchase reductions of 1,869.92/2,644.34 and cash reductions of 39,894.13/39,118.74. Its income loss continues through month 24, whereas the compound route combines a temporary loss with a single expense. The longer loss therefore removes more cash than the compound shock (Figure 11; Table 9).
paragraphs.zh: 相对于相同目标且无冲击的路径，暂时性收入损失使每户累计购买量减少 376.57/1,033.50 元，期末现金减少 8,052.79/7,369.20 元（2 万/3 万目标）。 收入在第 10 个月恢复，但此前的资源损失在第 24 个月仍然可见。 持续性收入损失导致更大的购买减少量 1,869.92/2,644.34 和现金减少量 39,894.13/39,118.74。 其收入损失一直持续到第 24 个月，而复合路径则是将暂时性损失与一次性支出相结合。 因此，更长的损失期比复合冲击移除了更多的现金（图 11；表 9）。

sents.en: Relative to the same-goal unshocked path, temporary income loss reduces cumulative purchases by CNY 376.57/1,033.50 per household and closing cash by 8,052.79/7,369.20 (20k/30k goals).
sents.zh: 相对于相同目标且无冲击的路径，暂时性收入损失使每户累计购买量减少 376.57/1,033.50 元，期末现金减少 8,052.79/7,369.20 元（2 万/3 万目标）。

sents.en: Income recovers in month 10, but the earlier resource loss remains visible at month 24.
sents.zh: 收入在第 10 个月恢复，但此前的资源损失在第 24 个月仍然可见。

sents.en: Persistent income loss produces larger purchase reductions of 1,869.92/2,644.34 and cash reductions of 39,894.13/39,118.74.
Its income loss continues through month 24, whereas the compound route combines a temporary loss with a single expense.
sents.zh: 其收入损失一直持续到第 24 个月，而复合路径则是将暂时性损失与一次性支出相结合。

sents.en: The longer loss therefore removes more cash than the compound shock (Figure 11; Table 9).
sents.zh: 因此，更长的损失期比复合冲击移除了更多的现金（图 11；表 9）。

paragraphs.en: The expense shock primarily uses reserves. Additional executed necessary spending is CNY 8,407.09/8,406.47; purchases fall by 203.21/322.33 and closing cash by 8,110.85/8,009.13. Combining this expense with temporary income loss reduces purchases by 658.55/1,373.97 and increases necessary-spending shortfalls by 518.89/574.08. The higher expenditure total in these routes records the additional need being paid. Sustained income gains raise purchases by 1,137.62/1,764.62 and cash by 51,190.89/50,665.33.
paragraphs.zh: 费用冲击主要使用储备。 新增的已执行必要支出为 8,407.09/8,406.47 元；购买减少 203.21/322.33，期末现金减少 8,110.85/8,009.13。 将该费用与暂时性收入损失相结合，购买减少 658.55/1,373.97，必要支出缺口增加 518.89/574.08。 这些路径中较高的支出总额记录了额外需求被支付的情况。 持续的收入增长使购买增加 1,137.62/1,764.62，现金增加 51,190.89/50,665.33。

sents.en: The expense shock primarily uses reserves.
sents.zh: 费用冲击主要使用储备。

sents.en: Additional executed necessary spending is CNY 8,407.09/8,406.47; purchases fall by 203.21/322.33 and closing cash by 8,110.85/8,009.13.
Combining this expense with temporary income loss reduces purchases by 658.55/1,373.97 and increases necessary-spending shortfalls by 518.89/574.08.
sents.zh: 将该费用与暂时性收入损失相结合，购买减少 658.55/1,373.97，必要支出缺口增加 518.89/574.08。

sents.en: The higher expenditure total in these routes records the additional need being paid.
sents.zh: 这些路径中较高的支出总额记录了额外需求被支付的情况。

sents.en: Sustained income gains raise purchases by 1,137.62/1,764.62 and cash by 51,190.89/50,665.33.

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 — Household adjustments relative to the unshocked path. Each point subtracts the same-goal R0 mean from a shock-route mean at month 24 for the same 10,000 households. The two symbols distinguish goal conditions; Table 9 gives their values. Figure 13 separately compares the goals within each route.
paragraphs.zh: 图11 — 相对于未受冲击路径的家庭调整情况。 每个点表示在第24个月时，对于相同的10,000户家庭，冲击路径均值减去相同目标下R0均值的结果。 实心圆和空心菱形分别表示2万元和3万元的购置目标。a，累计购置额。b，期末现金。c，累计实际债务还款。 金额单位为每户千元人民币。 两种符号用于区分目标条件；表9给出了它们的数值。 图13分别在各路径内对两个目标进行了比较。

sents.zh: 图11 — 相对于未受冲击路径的家庭调整情况。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 — Five shocks relative to the same-goal unshocked reference

paragraphs.en: Average reserves coexist with liquidity exhaustion. Under persistent income loss, the month-24 zero-cash share reaches 17.60%/18.28%, compared with 7.54%/7.74% in R0. paragraphs.en: Shock effects compare each route with R0 at a fixed purchase goal (Figure 12, left). Goal effects compare the CNY 30k and 20k goals within the same route (Figure 12, right; Figure 13). Total consumption is routine consumption plus purchases and the additional shock expense; debt payments enter the cash budget separately. Income changes occur in months 7–9 and the additional expense in month 10.

paragraphs.en: All routes coincide in months 1–6, before the shocks are announced. The larger goal changes allocation in month 1: purchases are CNY 1,989.84/2,938.88 and adjustable spending 25.04/8.10 for the 20k/30k goals. Base necessary spending is identical, so the initial routine gap of − 16.94 -16.94 comes entirely from adjustable spending. By month 6, monthly adjustable spending is 13.88/18.94: the higher-goal world’s 5.06 advantage that month narrows its cumulative routine gap, which remains negative at − 37.37 -37.37 . The month-1 offer gap is zero because offers are quoted before these choices.
paragraphs.zh: 所有路径在前 6 个月（冲击公布之前）完全一致。 更大的目标在第 1 个月就改变了资金分配：对于 2 万/3 万的目标，购买额分别为 1,989.84/2,938.88 元，可调整支出分别为 25.04/8.10 元。 基础必要支出完全相同，因此初始的例行差距 −16.94 完全来自可调整支出。 到第 6 个月，每月可调整支出为 13.88/18.94：目标较高的情形当月 5.06 的优势缩小了其累计例行差距，但该差距仍为 −37.37。 第 1 个月的优惠差距为零，因为优惠是在这些选择做出之前报价的。

paragraphs.en: Cumulative purchases are higher under the 30k goal in every route and month (Figure 13a). At month 24, shocks R1–R4 lower purchases relative to the same-goal R0 reference, while R5 raises them (Figure 12, left). The slope of the cumulative goal gap is the difference in that month’s purchases, so the gap falls when the lower-goal world catches up. In month 12 under the combined shock, purchases average CNY 571.65 for the 20k goal and 288.68 for the 30k goal, reducing the cumulative gap by 282.97; the gap rises again in month 13. Completed purchases reduce the remaining, nonreplenishing goal, slowing later growth. By month 24 the purchase gap is largest under sustained income gains (CNY 7,103.53) and smaller under persistent income loss (5,702.11; Table S34).
paragraphs.zh: 在每条路径和每个月中，30k 目标下的累计购买量都更高（图 13a）。 在第 24 个月，冲击 R1–R4 使购买量相对于同目标的 R0 参照有所降低，而 R5 则使其提高（图 12，左）。 累计目标缺口的斜率等于当月购买量之差，因此当低目标情境追上时，缺口会缩小。 在第 12 个月，组合冲击下 20k 目标的购买量平均为 571.65 元，30k 目标为 288.68 元，使累计缺口减少 282.97；缺口在第 13 个月再次扩大。 已完成的购买会减少剩余的、不补充的目标，从而放缓后续增长。 到第 24 个月，购买缺口在持续性收入增长下最大（7,103.53 元），在持续性收入损失下较小（5,702.11；表 S34）。

sents.en: Cumulative purchases are higher under the 30k goal in every route and month (Figure 13a).
sents.zh: 在每条路径和每个月中，30k 目标下的累计购买量都更高（图 13a）。

sents.en: At month 24, shocks R1–R4 lower purchases relative to the same-goal R0 reference, while R5 raises them (Figure 12, left).
sents.zh: 在第 24 个月，冲击 R1–R4 使购买量相对于同目标的 R0 参照有所降低，而 R5 则使其提高（图 12，左）。
