sents.zh: 累计目标缺口的斜率等于当月购买量之差，因此当低目标情境追上时，缺口会缩小。

sents.en: In month 12 under the combined shock, purchases average CNY 571.65 for the 20k goal and 288.68 for the 30k goal, reducing the cumulative gap by 282.97; the gap rises again in month 13.
sents.zh: 在第 12 个月，组合冲击下 20k 目标的购买量平均为 571.65 元，30k 目标为 288.68 元，使累计缺口减少 282.97；缺口在第 13 个月再次扩大。

sents.en: Completed purchases reduce the remaining, nonreplenishing goal, slowing later growth.
sents.zh: 已完成的购买会减少剩余的、不补充的目标，从而放缓后续增长。

sents.en: By month 24 the purchase gap is largest under sustained income gains (CNY 7,103.53) and smaller under persistent income loss (5,702.11; Table S34).
sents.zh: 到第 24 个月，购买缺口在持续性收入增长下最大（7,103.53 元），在持续性收入损失下较小（5,702.11；表 S34）。

paragraphs.en: The 30k goal produces less cumulative routine consumption in every route and month, mainly through lower adjustable spending (Figure 13b). Under persistent income loss, routine consumption falls by CNY 400.36/366.50 relative to R0 (20k/30k). Executed base necessary spending falls by 349.68 in both goals, while adjustable spending falls by 50.68/16.83. The larger fall in the lower-goal world narrows the goal gap from − 112.77 -112.77 in R0 to − 78.91 -78.91 in R2, even as both routine-consumption levels fall.
paragraphs.zh: 30k 目标在所有路线和月份中产生的累计日常消费更低，主要通过更少的可调节支出实现（图 13b）。 在持续收入损失下，日常消费相对 R0（20k/30k）下降 400.36/366.50 元。 已执行的基础必要支出在两个目标下均下降 349.68，而可调节支出分别下降 50.68/16.83。 较低目标情形下更大的降幅使目标差距从 R0 的 −112.77 缩小到 R2 的 −78.91，尽管两种日常消费水平都在下降。

sents.en: The 30k goal produces less cumulative routine consumption in every route and month, mainly through lower adjustable spending (Figure 13b).
sents.zh: 30k 目标在所有路线和月份中产生的累计日常消费更低，主要通过更少的可调节支出实现（图 13b）。

sents.en: Under persistent income loss, routine consumption falls by CNY 400.36/366.50 relative to R0 (20k/30k).
sents.zh: 在持续收入损失下，日常消费相对 R0（20k/30k）下降 400.36/366.50 元。

sents.en: Executed base necessary spending falls by 349.68 in both goals, while adjustable spending falls by 50.68/16.83.
sents.zh: 已执行的基础必要支出在两个目标下均下降 349.68，而可调节支出分别下降 50.68/16.83。

sents.en: The larger fall in the lower-goal world narrows the goal gap from − 112.77 -112.77 in R0 to − 78.91 -78.91 in R2, even as both routine-consumption levels fall.
sents.zh: 较低目标情形下更大的降幅使目标差距从 R0 的 −112.77 缩小到 R2 的 −78.91，尽管两种日常消费水平都在下降。

paragraphs.en: After the one-time necessary expense, cumulative routine spending at month 24 is virtually unchanged under the 20k goal and CNY 12.27 higher under the 30k goal than in R0; the goal gap narrows to − 100.50 -100.50 . The temporary and combined shocks change routine spending by + 15.25 / − 21.24 +15.25/-21.24 and + 16.01 / − 18.57 +16.01/-18.57 for the two goals. These households maintain routine spending while reducing purchases and cash reserves.
paragraphs.zh: 在一次性必要支出之后，到第24个月，20k目标下的累计日常支出与R0相比几乎不变，30k目标下比R0高12.27元；目标差距缩小至−100.50。 暂时性冲击和组合冲击使两种目标下的日常支出分别变化+15.25/−21.24和+16.01/−18.57。 这些智能体家庭在维持日常支出的同时减少购买和现金储备。

sents.en: After the one-time necessary expense, cumulative routine spending at month 24 is virtually unchanged under the 20k goal and CNY 12.27 higher under the 30k goal than in R0; the goal gap narrows to − 100.50 -100.50 .
sents.zh: 在一次性必要支出之后，到第24个月，20k目标下的累计日常支出与R0相比几乎不变，30k目标下比R0高12.27元；目标差距缩小至−100.50。

sents.en: The temporary and combined shocks change routine spending by + 15.25 / − 21.24 +15.25/-21.24 and + 16.01 / − 18.57 +16.01/-18.57 for the two goals.
sents.zh: 暂时性冲击和组合冲击使两种目标下的日常支出分别变化+15.25/−21.24和+16.01/−18.57。

sents.en: These households maintain routine spending while reducing purchases and cash reserves.
sents.zh: 这些智能体家庭在维持日常支出的同时减少购买和现金储备。

paragraphs.en: Sustained income gains increase routine consumption by CNY 615.15/604.92 relative to R0, while increasing purchases by 1,137.62/1,764.62. The lower-goal world retains 10.24 more of the routine-spending increase, widening the negative goal gap to − 123.00 -123.00 . Under R5 the 30k goal thus produces 7,103.53 more purchases and 123.00 less routine consumption than the 20k goal. The green income-gain curve crosses below the gold expense curve in month 18, when their monthly adjustable-spending gaps are − 18.30 -18.30 and − 3.49 -3.49 . Their cumulative routine gaps reach − 95.33 -95.33 and − 84.72 -84.72 that month (Table S49).
paragraphs.zh: 持续的收入增长使常规消费相对于 R0 增加 615.15/604.92 元，同时使购买额增加 1,137.62/1,764.62 元。 较低目标的世界保留了 10.24 更多常规消费增量，使负目标差距扩大至 −123.00 -123.00。 在 R5 下，30k 目标因此比 20k 目标产生 7,103.53 元更多的购买额和 123.00 元更少的常规消费。 绿色的收入增长曲线在第 18 个月跌破金色的支出曲线，此时二者的月度可调节支出差距分别为 −18.30 -18.30 和 −3.49 -3.49。 当月二者的累计常规差距达到 −95.33 -95.33 和 −84.72 -84.72（表 S49）。

sents.en: Sustained income gains increase routine consumption by CNY 615.15/604.92 relative to R0, while increasing purchases by 1,137.62/1,764.62.
sents.zh: 持续的收入增长使常规消费相对于 R0 增加 615.15/604.92 元，同时使购买额增加 1,137.62/1,764.62 元。

sents.en: The lower-goal world retains 10.24 more of the routine-spending increase, widening the negative goal gap to − 123.00 -123.00 .
sents.zh: 较低目标的世界保留了 10.24 更多常规消费增量，使负目标差距扩大至 −123.00 -123.00。

sents.en: Under R5 the 30k goal thus produces 7,103.53 more purchases and 123.00 less routine consumption than the 20k goal.
sents.zh: 在 R5 下，30k 目标因此比 20k 目标产生 7,103.53 元更多的购买额和 123.00 元更少的常规消费。

sents.en: The green income-gain curve crosses below the gold expense curve in month 18, when their monthly adjustable-spending gaps are − 18.30 -18.30 and − 3.49 -3.49 .
sents.zh: 绿色的收入增长曲线在第 18 个月跌破金色的支出曲线，此时二者的月度可调节支出差距分别为 −18.30 -18.30 和 −3.49 -3.49。

sents.en: Their cumulative routine gaps reach − 95.33 -95.33 and − 84.72 -84.72 that month (Table S49).

paragraphs.en: Equal opening cash and income across the two goals imply Δ ​ K t = ∑ m ≤ t ( Δ ​ B m − Δ ​ C m − Δ ​ P m ) \Delta K_{t}=\sum_{m\leq t}(\Delta B_{m}-\Delta C_{m}-\Delta P_{m}) , where B B is new principal received, C C executed consumption and P P actual debt payments. Sustained income gains raise closing cash relative to the same-goal unshocked world by CNY 51,190.89/50,665.33 (20k/30k). They also make the goal difference more negative: − 6,764.79 -6,764.79 versus − 6,239.23 -6,239.23 in R0. Relative to R0, the higher-goal contrast adds 616.76 in consumption and 95.57 in debt payments, with only 186.78 more credit inflow; the balance is 525.56 more cash drawdown. In R4, the month-12 purchase catch-up in the lower-goal world temporarily narrows the cash gap by CNY 206.28, producing the upward cash bend in Figure 13c.
paragraphs.zh: 两个目标的期初现金和收入相等意味着 ΔK_t = ∑_{m≤t}(ΔB_m − ΔC_m − ΔP_m)，其中 B 为新收到的本金，C 为已执行消费，P 为实际债务还款。 相对于同一目标下未受冲击的世界，持续的收入提升使期末现金增加 51,190.89/50,665.33 元（2万/3万）。 它们还使目标差更加为负：−6,764.79，而 R0 中为 −6,239.23。 相对于 R0，更高目标的对比增加了 616.76 的消费和 95.57 的债务还款，而信贷流入仅多出 186.78；差额体现为现金消耗多出 525.56。 在 R4 中，低目标情形下第 12 个月的补购使现金差距暂时缩小 206.28 元，形成了图 13c 中现金曲线的上折。

sents.en: Equal opening cash and income across the two goals imply Δ ​ K t = ∑ m ≤ t ( Δ ​ B m − Δ ​ C m − Δ ​ P m ) \Delta K_{t}=\sum_{m\leq t}(\Delta B_{m}-\Delta C_{m}-\Delta P_{m}) , where B B is new principal received, C C executed consumption and P P actual debt payments.
sents.zh: 两个目标的期初现金和收入相等意味着 ΔK_t = ∑_{m≤t}(ΔB_m − ΔC_m − ΔP_m)，其中 B 为新收到的本金，C 为已执行消费，P 为实际债务还款。

sents.en: Sustained income gains raise closing cash relative to the same-goal unshocked world by CNY 51,190.89/50,665.33 (20k/30k).

paragraphs.en: Bank offers combine individual affordability with a portfolio multiplier (Figure 13d). The offer contrast starts at zero; financing the larger goal then uses more principal headroom and adds installments, reducing subsequent individual capacity. The rule is g = min ⁡ ( 1 , max ⁡ ( 0.25 , 1 − 0.5 ​ ( 1 − c ) − 2 ​ d ) ) g=\min(1,\max(0.25,1-0.5(1-c)-2d)) , where c c is repayment coverage and d d the thirty-day-arrears share over the preceding three completed months. The assigned 0.25 floor caps the portfolio-wide reduction at 75% of individually affordable principal. For example, CNY 20,000 of individual capacity becomes a CNY 5,000 offer at the floor; a household frozen by recent arrears still receives zero. Existing contracts retain their dated terms. A one-percentage-point fall in coverage reduces the multiplier by 0.005, while a one-point rise in the arrears share reduces it by 0.02, until the floor binds.
paragraphs.zh: 银行报价将个体可负担性与组合乘数相结合（图 13d）。 报价对比从零开始；为较大的目标融资会占用更多本金空间并增加分期还款额，从而降低后续的个体容量。 规则为 g = min ⁡ ( 1 , max ⁡ ( 0.25 , 1 − 0.5 ​ ( 1 − c ) − 2 ​ d ) ) g=\min(1,\max(0.25,1-0.5(1-c)-2d))，其中 c c 为还款覆盖率，d d 为此前三个完整月份的三十天逾期欠款占比。 设定的 0.25 下限将组合层面的削减上限限制为个体可负担本金的 75%。 例如，个体容量为 20,000 元人民币时，在下限处的报价为 5,000 元人民币；因近期欠款而被冻结的家庭仍获得零额度。 现有合同保留其原有日期条款。 在下限生效之前，覆盖率每下降一个百分点，乘数减少 0.005；欠款占比每上升一个百分点，乘数减少 0.02。

sents.zh: 例如，个体容量为 20,000 元人民币时，在下限处的报价为 5,000 元人民币；因近期欠款而被冻结的家庭仍获得零额度。

paragraphs.en: Persistent income loss is the only route in which the portfolio factor reaches 0.25. Income remains at 72.9% of its original level from month 9, while contractual payments continue and unpaid amounts enter later payable obligations. Repayment coverage falls from 49.97%/52.27% in the month-12 offer window to 16.92%/18.10% in month 24. Coverage is higher in the 30k world within each window, while deteriorating over time in both worlds. Between months 12 and 15, the offer gap narrows from CNY − 193.12 -193.12 to − 36.13 -36.13 , while offers fall from 6,081.26/5,888.14 to 3,475.76/3,439.63. The negative individual-capacity contribution shrinks from − 515.37 -515.37 to − 273.29 -273.29 , outweighing a fall in the positive factor contribution from 322.24 to 237.28 (Table S50).
paragraphs.zh: 持续性收入损失是投资组合因子达到 0.25 的唯一情形。 从第 9 个月起，收入维持在原有水平的 72.9%，同时合同性付款继续进行，未支付金额进入后续的应付义务。 偿付覆盖率从第 12 个月要约窗口的 49.97%/52.27% 降至第 24 个月的 16.92%/18.10%。 在每个窗口内，30k 情形下的覆盖率更高，但两种情形下覆盖率都随时间恶化。 在第 12 至 15 个月之间，要约差距从人民币 −193.12 -193.12 缩小到 −36.13 -36.13，同时要约金额从 6,081.26/5,888.14 降至 3,475.76/3,439.63。 负的个体能力贡献从 −515.37 -515.37 缩小到 −273.29 -273.29，超过了正向因子贡献从 322.24 到 237.28 的下降（表 S50）。

sents.zh: 持续性收入损失是投资组合因子达到 0.25 的唯一情形。

The negative individual-capacity contribution shrinks from − 515.37 -515.37 to − 273.29 -273.29 , outweighing a fall in the positive factor contribution from 322.24 to 237.28 (Table S50).

paragraphs.en: In R2, the offer gap falls in months 16–17 as the two goal conditions reach the floor at different times. Their factors are 0.2737/0.2931 in month 15, 0.25/0.2580 in month 16 and 0.25/0.25 from month 17. The larger goal’s positive factor contribution falls from CNY 237.28 to 98.13 and then zero. The offer gap falls from − 36.13 -36.13 to − 142.40 -142.40 and − 232.43 -232.43 , even as the individual-capacity penalty becomes smaller. Once both factors equal 0.25, the remaining negative gap mainly reflects the higher goal’s outstanding principal and scheduled payments; amortization gradually releases principal headroom, easing the gap to − 206.78 -206.78 by month 24 (Table S50).
paragraphs.zh: 在 R2 中，报价差距在第 16–17 个月下降，因为两个目标条件在不同时间到达下限。 它们的系数在第 15 个月为 0.2737/0.2931，第 16 个月为 0.25/0.2580，从第 17 个月起为 0.25/0.25。 较大目标的正系数贡献从 237.28 元降至 98.13 元，随后降为零。 报价差距从 − 36.13 -36.13 降至 − 142.40 -142.40 和 − 232.43 -232.43，即使个体容量罚项变得更小。 一旦两个系数都等于 0.25，剩余的负差距主要反映较高目标的未偿本金和计划还款；摊销逐渐释放本金余量，使差距在第 24 个月缓解至 − 206.78 -206.78（表 S50）。

paragraphs.en: The other curves turn positive when a higher portfolio factor outweighs the larger goal’s lower individual capacity. This occurs first in R4 at month 14, then R1 at 16, R3 at 17 with a brief reversal at 18, R0 at 20 and R5 at 22. In R4 at month 14, repayment coverage is 45.21%/47.33% and the thirty-day-arrears share 15.69%/14.72%, producing factors of 0.4122/0.4423. The higher-goal world has 17,522 active borrower-months and 2,579 in thirty-day arrears, compared with 16,574 and 2,601 under the lower goal. Better coverage and the larger active-borrower denominator raise the factor enough to add CNY 533.71 to the offer gap, outweighing a 454.67 individual-capacity penalty. Rolling windows also delay the response: month-12 income capacity uses months 9–11, temporary-loss income fully leaves that window in month 13, and the month-10 expense leaves the portfolio window in month 14 (M11; Table S50).
paragraphs.zh: 当较高的组合因子抵消了较高目标下较低的个体容量时，其余曲线转为正值。 这一情况最早出现在 R4 的第 14 个月，随后是 R1 的第 16 个月、R3 的第 17 个月（第 18 个月出现短暂反转）、R0 的第 20 个月以及 R5 的第 22 个月。 在 R4 的第 14 个月，还款覆盖率为 45.21%/47.33%，三十天逾期占比为 15.69%/14.72%，产生的因子为 0.4122/0.4423。 较高目标的情形下有 17,522 个活跃借款人月和 2,579 个三十天逾期的借款人月，而较低目标的情形下分别为 16,574 和 2,601。 更好的覆盖率以及更大的活跃借款人分母足以抬高因子，使报价缺口增加 533.71 元，超过了 454.67 的个体容量扣减。 滚动窗口也会延迟响应：第 12 个月的收入容量使用第 9–11 个月的数据，临时损失的收入在第 13 个月完全离开该窗口，而第 10 个月的支出在第 14 个月离开组合窗口（M11；表 S50）。

In the opening-debt partition, households owing more than CNY 10,000 and up to 100,000 contribute 72.09%/69.70% of the persistent-loss path’s pressure while comprising 36.59% of the panel (Table S48).

The applications cover task families, a population-scale paired comparison and repeated monthly choices.

paragraphs.en: The household results distinguish the decision to purchase from the resources used to carry that purchase through time. Age and income organize different purchase responses. Education, employment and household size retain distinct responses under a common age–income mixture, largely through transitions from deferral to purchase. Assets and existing debt then distinguish cash drawdown, actual payments and the obligation remaining at the horizon. Standardizing the profile mixture reverses the ordering of the illustrated asset groups’ consumption increments while preserving differences in cash use and payments. The high-debt group carries much of its added consumption as closing debt. Risk preference and housing tenure add less variation in this application.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭层面的结果将购买决策与用于将该购买延续到未来的资源区分开来。 年龄和收入组织起不同的购买反应。 在共同的年龄—收入混合之下，教育、就业和家庭规模仍保留各自不同的反应，主要通过从推迟到购买的转变体现。 资产和既有债务则进一步区分现金动用、实际支付以及期限内剩余的债务义务。 对画像混合进行标准化后，图示资产组群的消费增量的排序发生逆转，但现金使用和支付的差异得以保留。 高债务组将其新增消费的很大一部分以期末债务的形式承担。 在本应用中，风险偏好和住房产权带来的变异较少。

paragraphs.en: The age profile also identifies a boundary of the current FinL-mlx policy and purchase menu. All 2,364,307 households with decision makers aged 65 or above selected deferral in both conditions, comprising 19.70% of the panel and contributing zero to its consumption increment. Income standardization retains this behavior. Its correspondence to observed lifecycle demand remains untested.
paragraphs.zh: 年龄特征还划定了当前 FinL-mlx 政策与购买菜单的边界。 所有 2,364,307 户决策者年龄在 65 岁及以上的家庭在两种条件下都选择了延期，占面板的 19.70%，且对消费增量贡献为零。 收入标准化保留了这一行为。 其与所观察到的生命周期需求的对应关系仍未得到检验。

paragraphs.en: The monthly extension separates resource adjustment from sensitivity to the purchase goal. Persistent income loss removes more cash than a temporary loss plus one expense because the loss continues longer. Sustained gains support purchases and larger reserve accumulation, while insufficient buffers leave some households with exhausted liquidity. These resource paths narrow or widen the consumption difference between purchase goals under common financing rules.
paragraphs.zh: 月度扩展将资源调整与对购房目标的敏感性分离开来。 持续性收入损失比一次性损失加上一笔支出扣除的现金更多，因为损失持续的时间更长。 持续的收益支持购房和更大的储备积累，而缓冲不足则使一些家庭的流动性耗尽。 在共同的融资规则下，这些资源路径缩小或扩大了购房目标之间的消费差异。

sents.zh: 月度扩展将资源调整与对购房目标的敏感性分离开来。

sents.en: Persistent income loss removes more cash than a temporary loss plus one expense because the loss continues longer.
sents.zh: 持续性收入损失比一次性损失加上一笔支出扣除的现金更多，因为损失持续的时间更长。

sents.en: Sustained gains support purchases and larger reserve accumulation, while insufficient buffers leave some households with exhausted liquidity.

paragraphs.en: Under the assigned accounting order, purchases and routine spending use resources before dated debt is serviced. Realized payments, arrears and contracts enter the next household observation, and the common bank rule converts recent repayment histories into subsequent offers. The simulated paths reflect both FinL-mlx choices and these financial rules. Financial diaries, contract schedules and bank-offer histories would provide targets for estimating the behavioral and institutional responses represented by those rules.
paragraphs.zh: 在指定的记账顺序下，采购和日常开支先于偿还到期债务使用资源。 已实现的付款、欠款和合同进入下一次家庭观测，而通用的银行规则将近期的还款历史转化为后续的报价。 模拟路径既反映了 FinL-mlx 的选择，也反映了这些金融规则。 金融日记账、合同时间表和银行报价历史将为估计这些规则所代表的行为性和制度性响应提供目标。

sents.zh: 在指定的记账顺序下，采购和日常开支先于偿还到期债务使用资源。

paragraphs.en: FinQ and FinL demonstrate two trainable policy routes within the shared interface. FinQ uses LoRA and a decision head on Qwen3.5-4B-Base; FinL uses full-data encoder adaptation and is deployed through FinL-mlx in the completed financial applications. The matched controls show the value of LoRA over head-only adaptation and of supervised adaptation for native Laya; the evaluated 4B and 9B routes reach similar accuracy. Full-data FinL-mlx exceeds GLM-5.3-Flash in accuracy and question-macro F1 on the common financial questions. Task-level financial responses also vary by model and input language (Appendix S11).
paragraphs.zh: FinQ 和 FinL 展示了共享接口内两条可训练的策略路线。 FinQ 在 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 上使用 LoRA 和决策头；FinL 使用全量数据编码器适配，并通过 FinL-mlx 部署到已完成的金融应用中。 匹配的对照实验显示了 LoRA 相对于仅训练决策头适配的价值，以及对原生 Laya 进行有监督适配的价值；被评估的 4B 和 9B 路线达到了相近的准确率。 在常见金融问题上，全量数据的 FinL-mlx 在准确率和问题级宏 F1 上均超过 GLM-5.3-Flash。 任务级金融回答也因模型和输入语言而异（附录 S11）。

sents.en: FinQ and FinL demonstrate two trainable policy routes within the shared interface.
sents.zh: FinQ 和 FinL 展示了共享接口内两条可训练的策略路线。

sents.en: FinQ uses LoRA and a decision head on Qwen3.5-4B-Base; FinL uses full-data encoder adaptation and is deployed through FinL-mlx in the completed financial applications.

sents.en: The matched controls show the value of LoRA over head-only adaptation and of supervised adaptation for native Laya; the evaluated 4B and 9B routes reach similar accuracy.
sents.zh: 匹配的对照实验显示了 LoRA 相对于仅训练决策头适配的价值，以及对原生 Laya 进行有监督适配的价值；被评估的 4B 和 9B 路线达到了相近的准确率。

sents.en: Full-data FinL-mlx exceeds GLM-5.3-Flash in accuracy and question-macro F1 on the common financial questions.
sents.zh: 在常见金融问题上，全量数据的 FinL-mlx 在准确率和问题级宏 F1 上均超过 GLM-5.3-Flash。

sents.en: Task-level financial responses also vary by model and input language (Appendix S11).
sents.zh: 任务级金融回答也因模型和输入语言而异（附录 S11）。

paragraphs.en: Controlled Genese benchmarks time decision execution and writeback; the large applications measure policy-to-ledger workloads. The monthly application adds state histories and a synchronization point for aggregate bank feedback. Further applications could add asset repricing through changes in holding values and liquidation proceeds, and represent employment transitions and transfers as additional resource channels.
paragraphs.zh: 受控 Genese 基准测试用于测量决策执行与回写的时间开销；大型应用则用于测量从策略到账本的工作负载。 月度应用增加了状态历史以及一个用于汇总银行反馈的同步点。 进一步的应用可以通过持有价值的变化和清算所得来增加资产重估，并将就业变动和转移作为额外的资源渠道加以表示。

sents.zh: 受控 Genese 基准测试用于测量决策执行与回写的时间开销；大型应用则用于测量从策略到账本的工作负载。

sents.zh: 月度应用增加了状态历史以及一个用于汇总银行反馈的同步点。

sents.en: Further applications could add asset repricing through changes in holding values and liquidation proceeds, and represent employment transitions and transfers as additional resource channels.
sents.zh: 进一步的应用可以通过持有价值的变化和清算所得来增加资产重估，并将就业变动和转移作为额外的资源渠道加以表示。

paragraphs.en: S 2 -MAS combines household personas, trainable decision policies and financial state updates. FinQ and FinL provide two training routes; completed FinL-mlx applications cover eight task families, a twelve-million-household paired one-shot experiment and a 24-month panel under five shock paths and an unshocked reference. Purchase responses differ across household groups, largely through transitions from deferral to purchase. Cash drawdown, repayments and closing debt show how households fund those purchases. In the monthly panel, income losses narrow the consumption gap between purchase goals and sustained gains widen it, while repayment histories update subsequent offers.
paragraphs.zh: S 2 -MAS 将家庭画像、可训练的决策策略和财务状态更新结合在一起。 FinQ 和 FinL 提供两条训练路线；已完成的 FinL-mlx 应用涵盖八个任务族、一项一千二百万家庭的配对单次实验，以及在五种冲击路径和一个无冲击参照下的二十四个月面板数据。 购买反应在不同家庭群体之间存在差异，主要由从推迟购买到实施购买的转变所致。 现金消耗、还款和结清债务显示了家庭如何为这些购买提供资金。 在月度面板中，收入损失会缩小购买目标之间的消费差距，而持续的收益则会扩大这一差距，同时还款记录会更新后续的报价。

sents.zh: S 2 -MAS 将家庭画像、可训练的决策策略和财务状态更新结合在一起。

The model catalog identifies the ten trained release versions and additional checkpoints and runtime formats. Project model releases use noncommercial research terms prohibiting redistribution and reverse engineering. Survey-derived decision QA, study-cohort records and individual trajectories remain under restricted access.

paragraphs.en: A companion resource contains 2M independently constructed financial household personas and 32,000 unlabelled task inputs from 2,000 households, eight authored task families and two conditions. Its resource entry provides generation code, schema, component terms and the data-archive entry. A separate CC0 Wikidata component contains 38 entities and 66 relations. These companion records are separate from the populations used in model training and reported simulation. The public scientific code provides aggregate figure reproduction, decision-model training and evaluation interfaces, and independent companion generation. The GENESE/MAS engine implementation remains private.
paragraphs.zh: 一个配套资源包含200万个独立构建的金融家庭画像，以及来自2,000个家庭的32,000条无标签任务输入，涵盖八个编写的任务族和两种条件。 其资源条目提供生成代码、模式、组件术语和数据存档条目。 一个单独的CC0 Wikidata组件包含38个实体和66个关系。 这些配套记录与用于模型训练和已报告仿真的总体是分开的。 公开的科学代码提供汇总图表复现、决策模型训练与评估接口，以及独立的配套资源生成。 GENESE/MAS引擎的实现仍保持私有。

paragraphs.en: Real-survey data provide 4,172,421 underlying QA observations with aligned Chinese and English views. The corpus contains 1,211 question or task versions and 142,647 operational household/respondent groups. Repeated questions and both languages remain together within an operational group; changing identifiers remain separate unless an established identity bridge is available.
paragraphs.zh: 真实调查数据提供了 4,172,421 条底层问答观测，并带有对应的中文和英文视角。 该语料库包含 1,211 个问题或任务版本，以及 142,647 个可操作的家庭/受访者组。 重复的问题和两种语言保留在同一个可操作组内；更改标识符则保持独立，除非存在已确立的身份桥接。

paragraphs.en: Income tasks remove income inputs; spending tasks remove total and component expenditure; debt tasks remove amount and type. Housing, occupation and education tasks similarly exclude target-related fields. Missing, skipped, refused and undefined targets are excluded, while questionnaire-defined do-not-know alternatives remain eligible. Development chooses checkpoints; a separate calibration partition fits probability temperatures. The financial task rules define conditions and execution independently of these observed-answer targets.
paragraphs.zh: 收入类任务会移除收入输入；支出类任务会移除总支出及各分项支出；债务类任务会移除金额和类型。 住房、职业和教育类任务同样会排除与目标相关的字段。 缺失、跳过、拒绝和未定义的目标会被排除，而问卷中定义的“不知道”选项仍符合条件。 开发过程选择检查点；一个单独的校准分区用于拟合概率温度。 金融任务规则独立于这些观测到的答案目标来定义条件和执行。

sents.en: Income tasks remove income inputs; spending tasks remove total and component expenditure; debt tasks remove amount and type.
sents.zh: 收入类任务会移除收入输入；支出类任务会移除总支出及各分项支出；债务类任务会移除金额和类型。

sents.en: Housing, occupation and education tasks similarly exclude target-related fields.
sents.zh: 住房、职业和教育类任务同样会排除与目标相关的字段。

sents.en: Missing, skipped, refused and undefined targets are excluded, while questionnaire-defined do-not-know alternatives remain eligible.
sents.zh: 缺失、跳过、拒绝和未定义的目标会被排除，而问卷中定义的“不知道”选项仍符合条件。

sents.en: Development chooses checkpoints; a separate calibration partition fits probability temperatures.
sents.zh: 开发过程选择检查点；一个单独的校准分区用于拟合概率温度。

sents.en: The financial task rules define conditions and execution independently of these observed-answer targets.
sents.zh: 金融任务规则独立于这些观测到的答案目标来定义条件和执行。

paragraphs.en: The population resource contains 500 million constructed household financial decision-maker records in 50 Parquet shards of 10 million rows. Real-survey data inform a common household representation. Financial attributes are sampled jointly conditional on age, household income and total spending, while eligibility constraints maintain coherent category combinations. Unknown categories remain explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 人口资源包含5亿条已构建的家庭财务决策者记录，分为50个Parquet分片，每片1000万行。 真实调查数据支撑一种通用的家庭表示。 金融属性在以年龄、家庭收入和总支出为条件的情况下进行联合抽样，同时资格约束保持类别组合的连贯性。 未知类别保持显式。

sents.en: The population resource contains 500 million constructed household financial decision-maker records in 50 Parquet shards of 10 million rows.
sents.zh: 人口资源包含5亿条已构建的家庭财务决策者记录，分为50个Parquet分片，每片1000万行。

sents.en: Real-survey data inform a common household representation.
sents.zh: 真实调查数据支撑一种通用的家庭表示。

sents.en: Financial attributes are sampled jointly conditional on age, household income and total spending, while eligibility constraints maintain coherent category combinations.
sents.zh: 金融属性在以年龄、家庭收入和总支出为条件的情况下进行联合抽样，同时资格约束保持类别组合的连贯性。

sents.en: Unknown categories remain explicit.
sents.zh: 未知类别保持显式。

paragraphs.en: The 500M expansion calibrates household size in five bins from one person to five or more, together with selected debt, homeownership and financial-asset margins; rural debt retains its sampled distribution. It also refines upper monetary categories. The 10M consumer bank uses its specified 36-field representation and five income, spending and asset brackets. Population operations use numeric codes; the policy receives decoded text.
paragraphs.zh: 5亿（500M）扩展在从一人到五人及以上的五个区间中校准家庭规模，并连同选定的债务、住房所有权和金融资产边际进行调整；农村债务保持其抽样分布。 它还细化了较高的货币类别。 1000万（10M）消费者银行使用其指定的36个字段表示法以及收入、支出和资产的五个档次。 人口操作使用数字代码；政策接收解码后的文本。

sents.en: The 500M expansion calibrates household size in five bins from one person to five or more, together with selected debt, homeownership and financial-asset margins; rural debt retains its sampled distribution.
sents.zh: 5亿（500M）扩展在从一人到五人及以上的五个区间中校准家庭规模，并连同选定的债务、住房所有权和金融资产边际进行调整；农村债务保持其抽样分布。

sents.en: It also refines upper monetary categories.
sents.zh: 它还细化了较高的货币类别。

sents.en: The 10M consumer bank uses its specified 36-field representation and five income, spending and asset brackets.
sents.zh: 1000万（10M）消费者银行使用其指定的36个字段表示法以及收入、支出和资产的五个档次。

sents.en: Population operations use numeric codes; the policy receives decoded text.
sents.zh: 人口操作使用数字代码；政策接收解码后的文本。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Methods M3 defines the descriptive bank and the 12M execution cohort.
paragraphs.zh: 补充方法 M3 定义了描述性库和 12 个月执行队列。

paragraphs.en: PCA evaluates standardized ordinal attributes in the completed constructed records. In the 10M bank, 7,227,206 rows have all 14 fields known. The analysis forms their correlation matrix, extracts its eigenvectors and orients PC1 toward positive total spending. PC1 explains 32.8904% of variance and PC2 11.5234%.
paragraphs.zh: PCA 对已完成构建记录中的标准化序数属性进行评估。 在 1000 万条银行数据中，有 7,227,206 行的全部 14 个字段均为已知。 该分析构建它们的相关矩阵，提取其特征向量，并将 PC1 的方向定为正的总消费额。 PC1 解释了 32.8904% 的方差，PC2 解释了 11.5234%。

sents.en: PCA evaluates standardized ordinal attributes in the completed constructed records.
sents.zh: PCA 对已完成构建记录中的标准化序数属性进行评估。

sents.en: In the 10M bank, 7,227,206 rows have all 14 fields known.
sents.zh: 在 1000 万条银行数据中，有 7,227,206 行的全部 14 个字段均为已知。

sents.en: The analysis forms their correlation matrix, extracts its eigenvectors and orients PC1 toward positive total spending.
sents.zh: 该分析构建它们的相关矩阵，提取其特征向量，并将 PC1 的方向定为正的总消费额。

sents.en: PC1 explains 32.8904% of variance and PC2 11.5234%.

paragraphs.en: The separate 500M resource has approximately 4.626 million complete records per shard for the same analysis. Its shard-mean PC1 explains 32.62% of variance, with across-shard loading standard deviations at most 0.0003 (Table S15). The independent companion contains 2M separately constructed synthetic personas with assigned household and financial states. Figure S1 summarizes its full distributions. Figure S4 applies PCA to household size and seven financial variables after log transformation of CNY amounts and standardization. All 2M records are complete for these variables; PC1 and PC2 explain 45.6450% and 18.0043% of variance. The companion’s schema and generation code accompany the resource entry.
paragraphs.zh: 独立的 500M 资源在同一分析下每个分片包含约 462.6 万条完整记录。 其分片均值的 PC1 解释了 32.62% 的方差，跨分片的载荷标准差最多为 0.0003（表 S15）。 该独立配套资源包含 200 万个单独构建的合成人物画像，并分配了家庭与财务状态。 图 S1 概括了其完整的分布情况。 图 S4 在对人民币金额进行对数变换和标准化处理后，对家庭规模和七个财务变量应用了主成分分析（PCA）。 所有 200 万条记录在这些变量上均完整；PC1 和 PC2 分别解释了 45.6450% 和 18.0043% 的方差。 该配套资源的模式与生成代码随资源条目一并提供。

sents.en: The separate 500M resource has approximately 4.626 million complete records per shard for the same analysis.
sents.zh: 独立的 500M 资源在同一分析下每个分片包含约 462.6 万条完整记录。

sents.en: Its shard-mean PC1 explains 32.62% of variance, with across-shard loading standard deviations at most 0.0003 (Table S15).
sents.zh: 其分片均值的 PC1 解释了 32.62% 的方差，跨分片的载荷标准差最多为 0.0003（表 S15）。

sents.en: The independent companion contains 2M separately constructed synthetic personas with assigned household and financial states.
sents.zh: 该独立配套资源包含 200 万个单独构建的合成人物画像，并分配了家庭与财务状态。

sents.en: Figure S1 summarizes its full distributions.
sents.zh: 图 S1 概括了其完整的分布情况。

sents.en: Figure S4 applies PCA to household size and seven financial variables after log transformation of CNY amounts and standardization.
sents.zh: 图 S4 在对人民币金额进行对数变换和标准化处理后，对家庭规模和七个财务变量应用了主成分分析（PCA）。

sents.en: All 2M records are complete for these variables; PC1 and PC2 explain 45.6450% and 18.0043% of variance.
sents.zh: 所有 200 万条记录在这些变量上均完整；PC1 和 PC2 分别解释了 45.6450% 和 18.0043% 的方差。

sents.en: The companion’s schema and generation code accompany the resource entry.
sents.zh: 该配套资源的模式与生成代码随资源条目一并提供。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure S1 — Composition of the independent synthetic persona companion. All 2,000,000 constructed households contribute to each distribution. a, Assigned household size. b, Monthly household income in CNY; k denotes thousands, and finite income intervals include their lower endpoint and exclude their upper endpoint. c, Opening cash divided by monthly income. d, Opening debt principal divided by monthly income. Heights and labels give the percentage of households; the ratio panels group the assigned integer income multiples. The companion provides reusable scenario inputs, separate from the 12M purchase-funding execution cohort and its monthly follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 S1 —— 独立合成角色智能体的构成。 全部 2,000,000 个构建的家庭均计入每个分布。a，分配的家庭规模。b，以人民币计的月家庭收入；k 表示千，有限收入区间包含其下端点、不包含其上端点。c，期初现金除以月收入。d，期初债务本金除以月收入。 高度和标签给出家庭百分比；比率面板按分配的整数收入倍数分组。 该智能体提供可复用的情景输入，与 1200 万购车资金执行队列及其月度随访相互独立。

sents.en: Supplementary Figure S1 — Composition of the independent synthetic persona companion.
sents.zh: 补充图 S1 —— 独立合成角色智能体的构成。

sents.en: All 2,000,000 constructed households contribute to each distribution. a, Assigned household size. b, Monthly household income in CNY; k denotes thousands, and finite income intervals include their lower endpoint and exclude their upper endpoint. c, Opening cash divided by monthly income. d, Opening debt principal divided by monthly income.
sents.zh: 全部 2,000,000 个构建的家庭均计入每个分布。a，分配的家庭规模。b，以人民币计的月家庭收入；k 表示千，有限收入区间包含其下端点、不包含其上端点。c，期初现金除以月收入。d，期初债务本金除以月收入。

sents.zh: 高度和标签给出家庭百分比；比率面板按分配的整数收入倍数分组。

sents.zh: 该智能体提供可复用的情景输入，与 1200 万购车资金执行队列及其月度随访相互独立。

paragraphs.en: The 500M resource supports population construction; the 10M bank supports descriptive analysis of the representation; the separate 12M cohort executes the purchase-funding application. The monthly extension uses a separate matched panel with full histories and explicit shock paths (M11).
paragraphs.zh: 5 亿资源支持总体构建；1000 万银行支持对表征的描述性分析；单独的 1200 万队列执行购买资金申请。 月度扩展使用一个单独的匹配面板，包含完整历史记录和明确的冲击路径（M11）。

sents.en: The 500M resource supports population construction; the 10M bank supports descriptive analysis of the representation; the separate 12M cohort executes the purchase-funding application.
sents.zh: 5 亿资源支持总体构建；1000 万银行支持对表征的描述性分析；单独的 1200 万队列执行购买资金申请。

sents.en: The monthly extension uses a separate matched panel with full histories and explicit shock paths (M11).
sents.zh: 月度扩展使用一个单独的匹配面板，包含完整历史记录和明确的冲击路径（M11）。

paragraphs.en: The 10M consumer bank contains constructed, survey-derived records. Its delivered selection retains the first 10,000,000 distinct eligible rows in shard order from the documented 100M parent; eligible records have known financial assets, debt amount and type, investment activity and trust.
paragraphs.zh: 该 1000 万消费者银行数据集包含经过构建的、来源于调查的记录。 其交付的选集保留了文档记载的 1 亿父数据集中按分片顺序排列的前 10,000,000 条互不相同的合格行；合格记录须具有已知的金融资产、债务金额与类型、投资活动以及信托。

sents.en: The 10M consumer bank contains constructed, survey-derived records.
sents.zh: 该 1000 万消费者银行数据集包含经过构建的、来源于调查的记录。

sents.en: Its delivered selection retains the first 10,000,000 distinct eligible rows in shard order from the documented 100M parent; eligible records have known financial assets, debt amount and type, investment activity and trust.
sents.zh: 其交付的选集保留了文档记载的 1 亿父数据集中按分片顺序排列的前 10,000,000 条互不相同的合格行；合格记录须具有已知的金融资产、债务金额与类型、投资活动以及信托。

paragraphs.en: The 14-field PCA uses complete cases from the delivered 10M bank; loading and completeness summaries appear in Tables S17–S18.
paragraphs.zh: 14字段PCA使用了已交付的1000万银行数据中的完整个案；载荷与完整性汇总见表S17–S18。

paragraphs.en: For the 12M purchase-funding application, two staged shards contain 20M distinct constructed records from the 500M resource. Seed 20261018, finite-pool inclusion caps and randomized cell-count rounding select whole rows without replacement before inference; uniform row draws operate within the selected cells. The 12M panel retains each selected profile, including 2,818,405 households with assigned baseline deficits and 543,327 with debt above CNY 500,000. The 35,000-household pilot is a nested subset whose completed choices are retained in the full run. Equal household weights define the reported fixed-panel means. The separate monthly panel is retained across all shock paths and goals (M11).
paragraphs.zh: 对于1200万购房资金申请，两个分阶段分片包含来自5亿资源的2000万条互不相同的构造记录。 种子20261018、有限池纳入上限与随机的单元格计数取整在推断前进行无放回的整行抽取；均匀行抽取在所选单元格内进行。 1200万面板保留每个被抽中的画像，包括2,818,405个已分配基线赤字的住户，以及543,327个负债超过50万元人民币的住户。 35,000住户试点是一个嵌套子集，其已完成的choice保留在全量运行中。 相等的住户权重用于定义所报告的固定面板均值。 单独的月度面板在所有冲击路径与目标（M11）下均被保留。

sents.en: For the 12M purchase-funding application, two staged shards contain 20M distinct constructed records from the 500M resource.
sents.zh: 对于1200万购房资金申请，两个分阶段分片包含来自5亿资源的2000万条互不相同的构造记录。

sents.en: Seed 20261018, finite-pool inclusion caps and randomized cell-count rounding select whole rows without replacement before inference; uniform row draws operate within the selected cells.
sents.zh: 种子20261018、有限池纳入上限与随机的单元格计数取整在推断前进行无放回的整行抽取；均匀行抽取在所选单元格内进行。

sents.en: The 12M panel retains each selected profile, including 2,818,405 households with assigned baseline deficits and 543,327 with debt above CNY 500,000.
sents.zh: 1200万面板保留每个被抽中的画像，包括2,818,405个已分配基线赤字的住户，以及543,327个负债超过50万元人民币的住户。

sents.en: The 35,000-household pilot is a nested subset whose completed choices are retained in the full run.
sents.zh: 35,000住户试点是一个嵌套子集，其已完成的choice保留在全量运行中。

sents.en: Equal household weights define the reported fixed-panel means.
sents.zh: 相等的住户权重用于定义所报告的固定面板均值。

sents.en: The separate monthly panel is retained across all shock paths and goals (M11).
sents.zh: 单独的月度面板在所有冲击路径与目标（M11）下均被保留。

paragraphs.en: FinL receives a household description, question and named alternatives through Laya’s existing option-scoring interface. We evaluate 3-round, 6-round and bilingual variants against their corresponding Laya bases. Laya uses ModernBERT-large with 421M parameters; the multilingual base uses mmBERT with 322M [3] . Native PyTorch and MLX implementations support training and deployment.
paragraphs.zh: FinL 通过 Laya 现有的选项评分接口接收家庭描述、问题以及命名选项。 我们将 3 轮、6 轮以及双语变体与其对应的 Laya 基线进行对比评估。 Laya 使用具有 421M 参数的 ModernBERT-large；多语言基线使用具有 322M 参数的 mmBERT [3]。 原生 PyTorch 和 MLX 实现支持训练与部署。

sents.en: FinL receives a household description, question and named alternatives through Laya’s existing option-scoring interface.
sents.zh: FinL 通过 Laya 现有的选项评分接口接收家庭描述、问题以及命名选项。

sents.en: We evaluate 3-round, 6-round and bilingual variants against their corresponding Laya bases.
sents.zh: 我们将 3 轮、6 轮以及双语变体与其对应的 Laya 基线进行对比评估。

sents.en: Laya uses ModernBERT-large with 421M parameters; the multilingual base uses mmBERT with 322M [3] .
sents.zh: Laya 使用具有 421M 参数的 ModernBERT-large；多语言基线使用具有 322M 参数的 mmBERT [3]。

sents.en: Native PyTorch and MLX implementations support training and deployment.
sents.zh: 原生 PyTorch 和 MLX 实现支持训练与部署。

paragraphs.en: The serialized input places the question and candidate descriptions before the respondent state, with a marker for each candidate. The encoder and choice head score those markers; inference returns the semantic option with the highest calibrated probability. SFT and native Laya RLCD adapt the model to observed answers or coded household targets. The reused RLCD objective adds a normalized-advantage policy-gradient term over Gaussian-perturbed option logits to soft cross-entropy; the perturbations are scored against target distributions by proper rewards [37] .
paragraphs.zh: 序列化输入将问题和候选描述置于被访者状态之前，并为每个候选设置一个标记。 编码器和选择头对这些标记进行打分；推理返回校准概率最高的语义选项。 SFT 与原生 Laya RLCD 使模型适配观测到的答案或编码后的家庭目标。 复用的 RLCD 目标在高斯扰动的选项 logits 上，在软交叉熵之外增加一个归一化优势策略梯度项；扰动通过恰当奖励依据目标分布进行打分 [37]。

sents.en: The serialized input places the question and candidate descriptions before the respondent state, with a marker for each candidate.
sents.zh: 序列化输入将问题和候选描述置于被访者状态之前，并为每个候选设置一个标记。

sents.en: The encoder and choice head score those markers; inference returns the semantic option with the highest calibrated probability.
sents.zh: 编码器和选择头对这些标记进行打分；推理返回校准概率最高的语义选项。

sents.en: SFT and native Laya RLCD adapt the model to observed answers or coded household targets.
sents.zh: SFT 与原生 Laya RLCD 使模型适配观测到的答案或编码后的家庭目标。

sents.en: The reused RLCD objective adds a normalized-advantage policy-gradient term over Gaussian-perturbed option logits to soft cross-entropy; the perturbations are scored against target distributions by proper rewards [37] .
sents.zh: 复用的 RLCD 目标在高斯扰动的选项 logits 上，在软交叉熵之外增加一个归一化优势策略梯度项；扰动通过恰当奖励依据目标分布进行打分 [37]。

paragraphs.en: The primary comparison uses 240,458 shared financial-question test records and 119 question versions in PyTorch BF16. Accuracy pools correct choices across records. Question-macro F1 averages candidate-class F1 within each question version and then weights versions equally; classes with zero denominators receive zero (Figure 5).
paragraphs.zh: 主要对比使用 240,458 条共享金融问题测试记录和 119 个问题版本，均在 PyTorch BF16 下进行。 准确率在各记录间汇总正确选项。 问题宏平均 F1 先在每个问题版本内对候选类别 F1 取平均，再对各版本等权平均；分母为零的类别记为零（图 5）。

sents.en: The primary comparison uses 240,458 shared financial-question test records and 119 question versions in PyTorch BF16.
sents.zh: 主要对比使用 240,458 条共享金融问题测试记录和 119 个问题版本，均在 PyTorch BF16 下进行。

sents.en: Accuracy pools correct choices across records.
sents.zh: 准确率在各记录间汇总正确选项。

sents.en: Question-macro F1 averages candidate-class F1 within each question version and then weights versions equally; classes with zero denominators receive zero (Figure 5).
sents.zh: 问题宏平均 F1 先在每个问题版本内对候选类别 F1 取平均，再对各版本等权平均；分母为零的类别记为零（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 reports the shared-question native and bilingual predictions. On the expanded-supervision test, native question-macro F1 rises from 19.2395% for FinL 3-round to 27.8355% for FinL 6-round. Appendix S3 reports the shared- and expanded-test results in MLX.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 报告了共享问题的原生（native）与双语（bilingual）预测结果。 在扩展监督测试上，原生问题宏 F1 从 FinL 3 轮的 19.2395% 提升到 FinL 6 轮的 27.8355%。 附录 S3 报告了 MLX 中共享测试与扩展测试的结果。

sents.en: Figure 5 reports the shared-question native and bilingual predictions.
sents.zh: 图 5 报告了共享问题的原生（native）与双语（bilingual）预测结果。

paragraphs.en: Matched information controls use 20,000 held-out QA drawn proportionally within all 119 question versions, with at least one record per version and seed 20261014. Wrong-profile requests use another held-out respondent’s profile for the same question; questions, candidate meanings and gold answers remain fixed. paragraphs.en: On the complete shared test, FinL exceeds the training-majority F1 in 80 of 119 question versions, falls below it in two and ties in 37. The equal-version gain is 6.2058 percentage points (95% interval 5.8711–6.4951); weighting those same version-level F1 scores by test frequency gives 7.4109 points (7.2111–7.6073). The two versions with fewer than 30 responses contain 22 QA and contribute -0.2489 points to the overall equal-version gain. Financial-knowledge, risk-attitude and saving/credit families each improve over majority (Table S2).
paragraphs.zh: 在完整的共享测试中，FinL 在 119 个问题版本中的 80 个上超过了训练集多数基线的 F1，在 2 个上低于它，在 37 个上持平。 等版本增益为 6.2058 个百分点（95% 区间 5.8711–6.4951）；按测试频率对相同的版本级 F1 分数加权则得到 7.4109 个百分点（7.2111–7.6073）。 响应数少于 30 的两个版本包含 22 个问答，对总体等版本增益的贡献为 -0.2489 个百分点。 金融知识、风险态度以及储蓄/信贷三类问题族均优于多数基线（表 S2）。

Official model adapters map their returned choices back to the original candidate IDs. Table 4 reports all models, backends, valid-decision counts and scores. Paired differences use 1,000 whole-group bootstrap resamples across 8,275 household/respondent groups, carrying all question records from a selected group together. paragraphs.en: QA caps are 512 input and 256 head tokens for Fin/base MLX, 512/192 for Laya-Finance, and 2,048 input tokens for OpenDecider. Decoder adapters preserve their released longer windows. CPU replay of the evaluated MLX input preparation finds no profile truncation on the full test or any matched information-control condition; full-profile inputs average 159.75 tokens and reach at most 230. The supplementary training procedure specifies the separate complete-context budgets used for financial deployment.

paragraphs.en: FinL 6-round has the highest answer accuracy in the complete comparison. Clef Flash 9B obtains 38.5193% question-macro F1 versus FinL’s 38.3746%. The paired FinL-minus-Clef difference is -0.1447 F1 points (95% interval -0.6208 to 0.4380), alongside a 10.9054-point accuracy gain (10.6636–11.1576). The external Laya-Finance checkpoint obtains 59.8317% accuracy and 28.7871% F1; FinL’s paired gains are 14.7227 points (14.5391–14.9281) and 9.5874 points (9.2879–9.8604).
paragraphs.zh: FinL 6-round 在完整对比中拥有最高的答案准确率。 Clef Flash 9B 获得了 38.5193% 的 question-macro F1，而 FinL 为 38.3746%。 FinL 相对 Clef 的配对差值为 -0.1447 F1 分（95% 区间为 -0.6208 至 0.4380），同时准确率提升 10.9054 分（10.6636–11.1576）。 外部 Laya-Finance 检查点获得了 59.8317% 的准确率和 28.7871% 的 F1；FinL 的配对提升分别为 14.7227 分（14.5391–14.9281）和 9.5874 分（9.2879–9.8604）。

sents.en: FinL 6-round has the highest answer accuracy in the complete comparison.
sents.zh: FinL 6-round 在完整对比中拥有最高的答案准确率。

sents.en: Clef Flash 9B obtains 38.5193% question-macro F1 versus FinL’s 38.3746%.
sents.zh: Clef Flash 9B 获得了 38.5193% 的 question-macro F1，而 FinL 为 38.3746%。

paragraphs.en: The training sequence is original-base → \rightarrow sft-1 → \rightarrow sft-2 → \rightarrow rlcd-1 → \rightarrow sft-3 → \rightarrow rlcd-2. Two SFT stages and one RLCD stage on financial questions produce the 3-round model from 1,721,623 training observations per language. The continuation for FinL 6-round adds expanded financial supervision through one SFT epoch and one native RLCD epoch over all 2,925,263 training examples, using BF16 on six A100 GPUs. The continuation updates encoder and choice-head parameters. FinL-bilingual uses two SFT stages and one RLCD stage on initial-supervision material. Household or respondent groups and their language copies stay together within each split.
paragraphs.zh: 训练序列为原始基座 → \rightarrow sft-1 → \rightarrow sft-2 → \rightarrow rlcd-1 → \rightarrow sft-3 → \rightarrow rlcd-2。 在金融问题上进行两个 SFT 阶段和一个 RLCD 阶段，每种语言使用 1,721,623 条训练观测，得到 3 轮模型。 FinL 6 轮的延续通过一个 SFT 轮次和一个原生 RLCD 轮次，在全部 2,925,263 条训练样本上加入扩展的金融监督，并使用六块 A100 GPU 上的 BF16 进行训练。 延续阶段会更新编码器和选择头的参数。 FinL-bilingual 在初始监督材料上使用两个 SFT 阶段和一个 RLCD 阶段。 家庭或受访者群体及其语言副本在每个划分中保持在一起。

paragraphs.en: Two independent full continuation replicas repeat the 6-round recipe from the same completed 3-round initialization, each with one SFT pass and one RLCD pass over 2,925,263 training QA. All three runs use stage-specific calibration temperatures and evaluate the same 119-version, 240,458-QA financial-question test with RLCD fixed as the final stage.
paragraphs.zh: 两个独立的完整续训副本从同一个已完成的 3 轮初始化开始，重复 6 轮的流程，各自对 2,925,263 条训练问答数据进行一轮 SFT 和一轮 RLCD。 全部三次运行都使用针对各阶段校准的温度，并以 RLCD 固定作为最后阶段，评估同一个包含 119 个版本、240,458 条问答数据的金融问题测试集。

paragraphs.en: Across the three native BF16 RLCD runs, accuracy averaged 74.5647% with sample standard deviation 0.0067 percentage points and range 74.5586–74.5719%. Question-macro F1 averaged 38.3277% with sample standard deviation 0.1254 points and range 38.1829–38.4016% (Table S3). These repeats quantify continuation variability conditional on the common initialization, survey preparation and splits; the respondent bootstrap quantifies sample variation for a fixed checkpoint. The direct decision comparison in Table 4 evaluates the 6-round rlcd-2 checkpoint in MLX CUDA FP16 on the same shared test.
paragraphs.zh: 在三次原生 BF16 RLCD 运行中，准确率平均为 74.5647%，样本标准差为 0.0067 个百分点，范围为 74.5586–74.5719%。 问题宏平均 F1 平均为 38.3277%，样本标准差为 0.1254 个百分点，范围为 38.1829–38.4016%（表 S3）。 这些重复实验量化了在共同初始化、问卷准备和数据集划分条件下的续写变异性；受访者自助法（bootstrap）则量化了固定检查点下的样本变异性。 表 4 中的直接决策比较评估了在 MLX CUDA FP16 下、相同共享测试集上的 6 轮 rlcd-2 检查点。

sents.en: Question-macro F1 averaged 38.3277% with sample standard deviation 0.1254 points and range 38.1829–38.4016% (Table S3).
These repeats quantify continuation variability conditional on the common initialization, survey preparation and splits; the respondent bootstrap quantifies sample variation for a fixed checkpoint.
sents.zh: 这些重复实验量化了在共同初始化、问卷准备和数据集划分条件下的续写变异性；受访者自助法（bootstrap）则量化了固定检查点下的样本变异性。

sents.en: The direct decision comparison in Table 4 evaluates the 6-round rlcd-2 checkpoint in MLX CUDA FP16 on the same shared test.
sents.zh: 表 4 中的直接决策比较评估了在 MLX CUDA FP16 下、相同共享测试集上的 6 轮 rlcd-2 检查点。

paragraphs.en: Six human raters evaluate 100 processed survey-derived personas against the same 44 processed fields. Five dimensions assess accuracy (M1), avoidance of unsupported inference (M2), coverage (M3), internal consistency (M4) and overall fidelity (M5). The 3,000 scores average 4.570/5; 87.8% are 4 or 5. Coverage averages 4.985, with 591 of 600 ratings equal to 5. Nine predefined targets cover income, consumption, debt, budget status, risk preference, financial assets, insurance and income source (Figure 4; Table S4).
paragraphs.zh: 六名人类评估者对100个由调查数据生成的处理后画像，按照相同的44个处理后字段进行评估。 五个维度分别评估准确性（M1）、避免无依据推断（M2）、覆盖率（M3）、内部一致性（M4）和总体保真度（M5）。 3000个评分的平均值为4.570/5；其中87.8%的评分为4或5。 覆盖率平均为4.985，600个评分中有591个为5。 九个预定义目标涵盖收入、消费、债务、预算状况、风险偏好、金融资产、保险和收入来源（图4；表S4）。

sents.en: Six human raters evaluate 100 processed survey-derived personas against the same 44 processed fields.
sents.zh: 六名人类评估者对100个由调查数据生成的处理后画像，按照相同的44个处理后字段进行评估。

sents.en: Five dimensions assess accuracy (M1), avoidance of unsupported inference (M2), coverage (M3), internal consistency (M4) and overall fidelity (M5).
sents.zh: 五个维度分别评估准确性（M1）、避免无依据推断（M2）、覆盖率（M3）、内部一致性（M4）和总体保真度（M5）。

sents.en: The 3,000 scores average 4.570/5; 87.8% are 4 or 5.
sents.zh: 3000个评分的平均值为4.570/5；其中87.8%的评分为4或5。

sents.en: Coverage averages 4.985, with 591 of 600 ratings equal to 5.
sents.zh: 覆盖率平均为4.985，600个评分中有591个为5。

sents.en: Nine predefined targets cover income, consumption, debt, budget status, risk preference, financial assets, insurance and income source (Figure 4; Table S4).
sents.zh: 九个预定义目标涵盖收入、消费、债务、预算状况、风险偏好、金融资产、保险和收入来源（图4；表S4）。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy and consistency average 4.685 and 4.670; avoidance of unsupported inference and overall fidelity average 4.285 and 4.225. DeepSeek Flash and GLM Flash each score within one point of the six-rater mean on 94.0% of 500 persona-dimension comparisons. Relative to the human mean, AI scores are higher for avoidance of unsupported inference (M2, +0.705 and +0.715 points) and overall fidelity (M5, +0.775 points for both judges). Reevaluation with DeepSeek V4 Pro and GLM 5.3 gives 94.3% on 98 valid personas and 94.0% on 100, respectively. Supplementary Figure S3 gives the full human-score distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 准确性与一致性平均分为 4.685 和 4.670；避免无依据推断与总体忠实度平均分为 4.285 和 4.225。 DeepSeek Flash 和 GLM Flash 在 500 个人设维度比较中各有 94.0% 的评分与六位评分者均值的差距在一分以内。 相对于人类均值，AI 在避免无依据推断（M2，分别高出 0.705 分和 0.715 分）以及总体忠实度（M5，两位评审均高出 0.775 分）方面得分更高。 使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 GLM 5.3 重新评估，在 98 个有效人设上得到 94.3%，在 100 个有效人设上得到 94.0%。 补充图 S3 给出了完整的人类评分分布。

sents.en: Accuracy and consistency average 4.685 and 4.670; avoidance of unsupported inference and overall fidelity average 4.285 and 4.225.
sents.zh: 准确性与一致性平均分为 4.685 和 4.670；避免无依据推断与总体忠实度平均分为 4.285 和 4.225。

sents.en: DeepSeek Flash and GLM Flash each score within one point of the six-rater mean on 94.0% of 500 persona-dimension comparisons.
sents.zh: DeepSeek Flash 和 GLM Flash 在 500 个人设维度比较中各有 94.0% 的评分与六位评分者均值的差距在一分以内。

sents.en: Relative to the human mean, AI scores are higher for avoidance of unsupported inference (M2, +0.705 and +0.715 points) and overall fidelity (M5, +0.775 points for both judges).
sents.zh: 相对于人类均值，AI 在避免无依据推断（M2，分别高出 0.705 分和 0.715 分）以及总体忠实度（M5，两位评审均高出 0.775 分）方面得分更高。

sents.en: Reevaluation with DeepSeek V4 Pro and GLM 5.3 gives 94.3% on 98 valid personas and 94.0% on 100, respectively.
sents.zh: 使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 GLM 5.3 重新评估，在 98 个有效人设上得到 94.3%，在 100 个有效人设上得到 94.0%。

sents.en: Supplementary Figure S3 gives the full human-score distributions.
sents.zh: 补充图 S3 给出了完整的人类评分分布。

paragraphs.en: Perturbed personas test changed facts, unsupported additions, missing targets and contradictions. GLM lowers the intended score on 95.8–100% of valid pairs. DeepSeek’s response ranges from 8.3% for omissions to 76.0% for contradictions. For omitted targets, GLM lowers the intended score in all 24 valid pairs, whereas DeepSeek does so in 2 of 24. Scoring proximity and known-error sensitivity therefore measure different properties of these judges (Appendix Table S16). These evaluations assess reconstruction of processed survey fields.
paragraphs.zh: 扰动人格用于测试已更改的事实、无依据的补充内容、缺失的目标以及矛盾之处。 GLM 在 95.8%–100% 的有效配对上降低了预期评分。 DeepSeek 的响应比例介于 8.3%（针对遗漏）到 76.0%（针对矛盾）之间。 对于被遗漏的目标，GLM 在全部 24 个有效配对中都降低了预期评分，而 DeepSeek 仅在 24 个中的 2 个中如此。 因此，评分接近度与已知错误敏感性衡量的是这些评判者的不同属性（附录表 S16）。 这些评估考察的是对经过处理的调查字段的重构情况。

sents.zh: 扰动人格用于测试已更改的事实、无依据的补充内容、缺失的目标以及矛盾之处。

sents.en: GLM lowers the intended score on 95.8–100% of valid pairs.
sents.zh: GLM 在 95.8%–100% 的有效配对上降低了预期评分。

sents.en: DeepSeek’s response ranges from 8.3% for omissions to 76.0% for contradictions.

paragraphs.en: The shared contract passes a household state, a question and named alternatives to a policy adapter, which returns an option ID and available probabilities. The execution layer retains the state to which that choice applies. Figure 2 describes the Genese state-transition architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 共享契约将家庭状态、一个问题以及若干命名备选项传递给一个策略适配器，适配器返回一个选项 ID 和可用的概率。 执行层保留该选择所适用的状态。 图 2 描述了 Genese 的状态转换架构。

sents.en: The shared contract passes a household state, a question and named alternatives to a policy adapter, which returns an option ID and available probabilities.
sents.zh: 共享契约将家庭状态、一个问题以及若干命名备选项传递给一个策略适配器，适配器返回一个选项 ID 和可用的概率。

sents.en: The execution layer retains the state to which that choice applies.
sents.zh: 执行层保留该选择所适用的状态。

sents.en: Figure 2 describes the Genese state-transition architecture.
sents.zh: 图 2 描述了 Genese 的状态转换架构。

paragraphs.en: In the controlled Genese benchmarks, World owns authoritative state and Brain requests bounded decision partitions through pooled model connections. World validates the returned intents and applies registered effects. Numeric components use indexed NumPy arrays, Boolean activity masks and registered systems; a structural-command buffer defers entity changes to the transition boundary. The timed local adapter stores state, events and command results in a SQLite WAL transaction on memory-backed storage.
paragraphs.zh: 在受控的 Genese 基准测试中，World 拥有权威状态，Brain 通过池化的模型连接请求有界决策分区。 World 校验返回的意图并应用已注册的效果。 数值组件使用带索引的 NumPy 数组、布尔活动掩码和已注册的系统；一个结构性命令缓冲区将实体变更延迟到过渡边界再执行。 带计时的本地适配器将状态、事件和命令结果存储在基于内存的存储之上的 SQLite WAL 事务中。

sents.en: In the controlled Genese benchmarks, World owns authoritative state and Brain requests bounded decision partitions through pooled model connections.
sents.zh: 在受控的 Genese 基准测试中，World 拥有权威状态，Brain 通过池化的模型连接请求有界决策分区。

sents.en: World validates the returned intents and applies registered effects.
sents.zh: World 校验返回的意图并应用已注册的效果。

sents.en: Numeric components use indexed NumPy arrays, Boolean activity masks and registered systems; a structural-command buffer defers entity changes to the transition boundary.
sents.zh: 数值组件使用带索引的 NumPy 数组、布尔活动掩码和已注册的系统；一个结构性命令缓冲区将实体变更延迟到过渡边界再执行。

sents.en: The timed local adapter stores state, events and command results in a SQLite WAL transaction on memory-backed storage.
sents.zh: 带计时的本地适配器将状态、事件和命令结果存储在基于内存的存储之上的 SQLite WAL 事务中。

paragraphs.en: The static-task and monthly-decision runners call the policy service through bounded asynchronous requests and advance the assigned financial ledger. Monthly episodes retain cash, dated contracts and arrears, then form the next observation from updated state. The existing MAS scheduler overlaps input preparation, inference and accounting across independent episodes, with accepted responses and monthly continuation states indexed by ordinary task IDs.
paragraphs.zh: 静态任务与按月决策的运行器通过有界异步请求调用策略服务，并推进所分配的财务账本。 按月回合保留现金、带日期的合同与欠款，然后根据更新后的状态形成下一个观测。 现有的 MAS 调度器在相互独立的回合之间重叠输入准备、推理与记账，已接受的响应和按月延续状态由普通任务 ID 索引。

sents.en: The static-task and monthly-decision runners call the policy service through bounded asynchronous requests and advance the assigned financial ledger.
sents.zh: 静态任务与按月决策的运行器通过有界异步请求调用策略服务，并推进所分配的财务账本。

sents.en: Monthly episodes retain cash, dated contracts and arrears, then form the next observation from updated state.
sents.zh: 按月回合保留现金、带日期的合同与欠款，然后根据更新后的状态形成下一个观测。

sents.en: The existing MAS scheduler overlaps input preparation, inference and accounting across independent episodes, with accepted responses and monthly continuation states indexed by ordinary task IDs.
sents.zh: 现有的 MAS 调度器在相互独立的回合之间重叠输入准备、推理与记账，已接受的响应和按月延续状态由普通任务 ID 索引。

paragraphs.en: Full Genese inference uses the separately supplied runtime, model service and deployment configuration. The independent synthetic fixture exercises local decision recording and accounting. The 12M deployment follows the asynchronous HTTP service and independent-ledger path. The production PostgreSQL/outbox transaction remains the reference architecture described in Section 4.2; local benchmark measurements use the SQLite adapter.
paragraphs.zh: Full Genese 推理使用单独提供的运行时、模型服务和部署配置。 独立的合成测试装置用于演练本地决策记录与记账。 12M 部署采用异步 HTTP 服务和独立账本路径。 生产环境的 PostgreSQL/outbox 事务仍然是第 4.2 节所述的参考架构；本地基准测试测量使用 SQLite 适配器。

paragraphs.en: We time fixed-input framework benchmarks, the complete 12M one-shot workload, and the monthly shock extension separately. The shock-extension interval runs from the first request to the final accepted month and includes preparation, bank barriers, storage and recovery waits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别对固定输入框架基准测试、完整的 1200 万一次性工作负载以及月度冲击扩展进行计时。 冲击扩展区间从第一个请求运行到最后一个被接受的月份，包括准备、银行壁垒、存储与恢复等待。

paragraphs.en: The completed purchase-funding application comprises 2,400 disjoint work units of 5,000 households. Ordinary unit IDs cover the complete allocation, with 1,548 completed units on the eight-H100 pool and 852 on the six-A100 pool. Each household completes the two frozen T3 conditions once. The same FinL checkpoint, MLX CUDA FP16, tokenizer and semantic candidates serve both pools; service batches contain at most sixteen requests, with sixty-four bounded in-flight requests per endpoint. Preparing the next work unit overlaps current inference, CPU accounting and compressed trace writes.
paragraphs.zh: 已完成的购房资金申请包含2,400个互不重叠的工作单元，共5,000户。 普通单元ID覆盖完整的分配，其中1,548个已完成单元在八卡H100池上，852个在六卡A100池上。 每户完成一次两个冻结的T3条件。 同一个FinL检查点、MLX CUDA FP16、分词器和语义候选同时服务于两个池；服务批次最多包含十六个请求，每个端点的在途请求上限为六十四个。 准备下一个工作单元与当前推理、CPU核算和压缩轨迹写入重叠进行。

sents.en: Preparing the next work unit overlaps current inference, CPU accounting and compressed trace writes.
sents.zh: 准备下一个工作单元与当前推理、CPU核算和压缩轨迹写入重叠进行。

paragraphs.en: The common end-to-end interval starts with preparation of the first nested-pilot inputs and ends when the final work unit completes. It includes input transfer waits, subsequent preparation, tokenization, policy calls, twelve-month ledgers, trace persistence and recovery waits. Its 14,356.9775 seconds cover 24M choices and 12M paired households, giving 1,671.661 choices/s and 835.831 households/s. Actual nonpadding candidate input totals 12,719,522,472 tokens, or 885,947.092 tokens/s over the same interval. The discriminative service reports zero autoregressive output tokens. Table S33 separates this interval from batch-processing and summed forward-call wall measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 常见的端到端区间从准备第一个嵌套试运行输入开始，到最后一个工作单元完成为止。 它包括输入传输等待、后续准备、分词、策略调用、十二个月账本、痕迹持久化以及恢复等待。 其 14,356.9775 秒涵盖 2400 万次选择和 1200 万个配对家庭，即每秒 1,671.661 次选择和每秒 835.831 个家庭。 实际非填充候选输入共计 12,719,522,472 个词元，即在同一区间内每秒 885,947.092 个词元。 判别式服务报告自回归输出词元数为零。 表 S33 将该区间与批处理以及前向调用累计耗时测量区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The private compressed traces total 67,664,771,925 bytes. They retain full model inputs and state, semantic alternatives, selected options and available probabilities, ordinary household/condition/task/attempt IDs, model and service usage, preparation/inference/save timestamps, and each twelve-month cash, debt and payment ledger. All 24M requests have recorded responses and complete-input indicators; HTTP and response-validation errors are zero. Fourteen process/status finalization retries affect eleven already complete work units. Their saved summaries are adopted with the existing choices, preserving one forward result per logical request.
paragraphs.zh: 私有压缩轨迹总计 67,664,771,925 字节。 它们保留了完整的模型输入与状态、语义备选项、已选选项及可用概率、普通的家庭/条件/任务/尝试 ID、模型与服务使用情况、准备/推理/保存时间戳，以及每份十二个月的现金、债务与付款账簿。 所有 2400 万个请求均已记录响应和完整输入指示器；HTTP 错误和响应验证错误均为零。 十四次流程/状态定稿重试影响了十一个已完成的工单。 它们已保存的摘要连同现有选项一并采用，确保每个逻辑请求只保留一个前向结果。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-input benchmarks hold the agent task and upstream model allocation constant; immediate-response backends measure dispatch, storage and adapter overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 固定输入基准测试保持智能体任务与上游模型分配不变；即时响应后端则测量调度、存储和适配器的开销。

paragraphs.en: Each timed agent produces one model choice in one round. Round time includes accepted-answer writeback; initialization is measured separately. The immediate-response matrices comprise twenty randomized interleaved measured blocks per configuration at 100 and 1,000 agents, after one warm-up. All 280 measured rounds accept and write back every requested choice.
paragraphs.zh: 每个定时智能体在每一轮产生一个模型选择。 轮次时间包括被接受答案的回写；初始化单独测量。 即时响应矩阵在每个配置于100和1,000个智能体下，经过一次预热后，包含二十个随机化交错的测量块。 全部280个测量轮次都接受并回写每个请求的选择。

paragraphs.en: With FinL and three T4 model replicas, the 100-agent Genese round takes 0.517 seconds, compared with 0.683 for OneSim, 1.140 for OASIS and 1.403 for MiroFish. At 1,000 agents on one T4 replica, Genese takes 6.17 seconds, OASIS 7.45 and OneSim 7.70 (Figure 7a–b). The completed 1,000-agent immediate-backend matrix gives Genese default a median of 2.788 seconds and parallel partitions 2.743. The corresponding medians are 5.818 for AgentSociety, 6.223 for OneSim, 7.386 for OASIS, 11.255 for MiroFish and 1,062.153 for the parallel MatrAIx questionnaire adapter (Figure 7d). The 1,000-agent Jev API matrix reports 5.97 seconds for Genese and 8.21 for OASIS; OneSim completes neither of its two attempted runs (Figure 7c).
paragraphs.zh: 使用 FinL 和三个 T4 模型副本时，100 个智能体的 Genese 轮次耗时 0.517 秒，相比之下 OneSim 为 0.683 秒，OASIS 为 1.140 秒，MiroFish 为 1.403 秒。 在单个 T4 副本上运行 1,000 个智能体时，Genese 耗时 6.17 秒，OASIS 为 7.45 秒，OneSim 为 7.70 秒（图 7a–b）。 已完成的 1,000 智能体即时后端矩阵中，Genese 默认模式的中位数为 2.788 秒，并行分区为 2.743 秒。 相应的中位数为：AgentSociety 为 5.818 秒，OneSim 为 6.223 秒，OASIS 为 7.386 秒，MiroFish 为 11.255 秒，并行 MatrAIx 问卷适配器为 1,062.153 秒（图 7d）。 1,000 智能体的 Jev API 矩阵中，Genese 报告耗时 5.97 秒，OASIS 为 8.21 秒；OneSim 的两次尝试运行均未完成（图 7c）。

paragraphs.en: At 100 agents, Genese default and parallel partitions take 0.362 and 0.360 seconds (Supplementary Figure S6). The host has two Intel Xeon Platinum 8268 processors and 96 logical threads. Framework CPU50 and proxy CPUs60–63 have nonexclusive affinities during concurrent training; the isolated comparison directory is memory-backed. Initialization is timed separately: Genese default and parallel partitions have 1,000-agent medians of 0.400 and 0.405 seconds. Observed one-minute host load spans 18.87–66.69 in the 100-agent matrix and 4.19–31.89 at 1,000 agents. The immediate-response Genese arms use the local Brain–World adapter and a SQLite WAL commit store on tmpfs, with state, outbox and result committed in one transaction. The production PostgreSQL design is described in Section 4.2.
paragraphs.zh: 在 100 个智能体时，Genese 默认划分与并行划分分别耗时 0.362 秒和 0.360 秒（补充图 S6）。 主机配备两个 Intel Xeon Platinum 8268 处理器，共 96 个逻辑线程。 在并发训练期间，框架 CPU50 与代理 CPU60–63 拥有非独占的亲和性；隔离对比目录位于内存盘上。 初始化单独计时：Genese 默认划分与并行划分在 1,000 个智能体时的中位数分别为 0.400 秒和 0.405 秒。 在 100 个智能体的矩阵中，观测到的主机一分钟负载范围为 18.87–66.69；在 1,000 个智能体时为 4.19–31.89。 即时响应的 Genese 实验组使用本地 Brain–World 适配器以及 tmpfs 上的 SQLite WAL 提交存储，其中 state、outbox 和 result 在单个事务中提交。 生产级 PostgreSQL 设计在第 4.2 节中描述。

paragraphs.en: Tables S12–S14 compare Genese’s array-based state, batched decision requests and transactional state–event design with native action constraints, saved-state continuation and request-level controls in the other frameworks. These measurements cover the local SQLite adapter and application ledgers; they exclude production crash recovery and outbox delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 表 S12–S14 将 Genese 基于数组的 State、批量化的决策请求，以及带原生动作约束、已保存 State 续跑和请求级控制的事务性 State–事件设计，与其他框架中的相应机制进行了对比。 这些测量涵盖本地 SQLite 适配器与应用层账本，不包含生产环境的崩溃恢复与 Outbox 投递。

paragraphs.en: The 11 October 2026 deployment benchmark uses three fixed Chinese financial-choice cases: income loss, a payment plan and loan-product choice. FinL-bilingual is the released multilingual-base adaptation, evaluated in local PyTorch and as FinL-bilingual-mlx in MLX CUDA on one NVIDIA A100 PCIe 40GB. The third local arm is its original multilingual Laya base. The hosted arm requests Jev and records the returned version jev-1.13.0. Every arm receives three warm-ups and twenty timed repetitions per case, with batch size and concurrency one. The local models use FP16; Jev’s server hardware and precision are provider-managed.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年10月11日的部署基准测试使用三个固定的中文金融选择案例：收入损失、还款计划与贷款产品选择。 FinL-bilingual 是已发布的多语言基础适配版本，在本地 PyTorch 中评估，并以 FinL-bilingual-mlx 的形式在单张 NVIDIA A100 PCIe 40GB 上通过 MLX CUDA 评估。 第三个本地分支是其原始的多语言 Laya 基础模型。 托管分支请求 Jev 并记录返回的版本 jev-1.13.0。 每个分支对每个案例进行三次预热和二十次计时重复，批大小与并发数均为一。 本地模型使用 FP16；Jev 的服务器硬件与精度由提供商管理。

paragraphs.en: The timing interval covers input preparation, tokenization, synchronized prediction and response formatting. Jev includes its HTTPS round trip. The client does not cache responses; provider prompt caching is uncontrolled. The shared mmBERT tokenizer counts compact, sorted JSON requests without special tokens outside the timed interval. The three cases contain 218, 393 and 398 shared tokens, producing 20,180 tokens across sixty measured calls per arm. Input-token throughput is total shared tokens divided by total measured time; choice throughput is sixty divided by that time.
paragraphs.zh: 计时区间涵盖输入准备、分词、同步预测以及响应格式化。 Jev 包含其 HTTPS 往返耗时。 客户端不缓存响应；服务商的提示词缓存不受控制。 共享的 mmBERT 分词器对紧凑、排序的 JSON 请求进行计数，不含计时区间之外的特殊标记。 三种用例分别包含 218、393 和 398 个共享标记，在每组六十次测量调用中共产生 20,180 个标记。 输入标记吞吐量为共享标记总数除以总测量时间；选择吞吐量为六十除以该时间。

paragraphs.en: For income loss, payment planning and product choice respectively, FinL-bilingual-mlx reaches 26,177, 37,506 and 46,840 shared input tokens/s; Jev reaches 1,051, 1,888 and 1,944. Pooled throughputs are 36,955.47 and 1,626.63 tokens/s, a ratio of 22.72. The same-checkpoint PyTorch arm reaches 15,247.34 tokens/s, giving an MLX/PyTorch ratio of 2.42373. The MLX and PyTorch financial models agree on all 69 warm-up and timed choices, with maximum probability difference approximately 0.0006. Source aggregates contain per-case summaries, individual elapsed times and the common-token protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 在收入损失、支付规划和产品选择三个任务上，FinL-bilingual-mlx 分别达到 26,177、37,506 和 46,840 的共享输入 tokens/s；Jev 分别达到 1,051、1,888 和 1,944。 汇总吞吐量分别为 36,955.47 和 1,626.63 tokens/s，比值为 22.72。 使用相同检查点的 PyTorch 分支达到 15,247.34 tokens/s，由此得到 MLX/PyTorch 比值为 2.42373。 MLX 与 PyTorch 的金融模型在全部 69 次预热和计时选择上保持一致，最大概率差异约为 0.0006。 源数据汇总包含逐案例摘要、单个耗时以及共享 token 协议。

paragraphs.en: The eight task families cover income and consumption adjustment, medical funding, purchase funding, product terms, asset allocation, multiple-debt payments, restructuring and asset sale or refinancing. Each language contains 45,473 decision inputs: 22,736 complete baseline/intervention pairs and one additional T1 intervention input. Each pair retains the household while changing a designated condition. The suite uses financial-anchor income, spending, deposits, loan principal and scheduled payments, with adjustable spending assigned as 10–30% of usual spending. Table S27 defines the sampled conditions and the action-to-ledger mapping.
paragraphs.zh: 八个任务族涵盖收入与消费调整、医疗资金、购置资金、产品条款、资产配置、多笔债务偿还、重组以及资产出售或再融资。 每种语言包含 45,473 个决策输入：22,736 个完整的基线/干预配对，以及一个额外的 T1 干预输入。 每个配对保留同一家庭，仅改变一项指定条件。 该测试套件采用财务锚定的收入、支出、存款、贷款本金和计划还款，可调支出被设定为通常支出的 10–30%。 表 S27 定义了采样的条件以及行动到账本的映射。

paragraphs.en: Buffer-stock saving motivates joint measurement of consumption and cash [23] ; consumption commitments motivate harder-to-adjust and adjustable spending [24] . Household liquidity and income risk motivate comparing the response across financial states [32] . The 12M purchase-funding application assigns the following monetary amounts and contracts to constructed household records.
paragraphs.zh: 缓冲存货储蓄促使对消费与现金进行联合测量 [23]；消费承诺促使对难以调整和可调整的支出进行研究 [24]。 家庭流动性与收入风险促使比较不同财务状态下智能体的反应 [32]。 12M 购买资金应用为构建的家庭记录分配以下货币金额和合同。

sents.en: Buffer-stock saving motivates joint measurement of consumption and cash [23] ; consumption commitments motivate harder-to-adjust and adjustable spending [24] .
sents.zh: 缓冲存货储蓄促使对消费与现金进行联合测量 [23]；消费承诺促使对难以调整和可调整的支出进行研究 [24]。

sents.en: Household liquidity and income risk motivate comparing the response across financial states [32] .
sents.zh: 家庭流动性与收入风险促使比较不同财务状态下智能体的反应 [32]。

sents.en: The 12M purchase-funding application assigns the following monetary amounts and contracts to constructed household records.
sents.zh: 12M 购买资金应用为构建的家庭记录分配以下货币金额和合同。

paragraphs.en: Monetary brackets use their midpoints; an open upper bracket uses 1.25 times its lower bound. Annual income and consumption are divided by twelve. Missing annual income is assigned CNY 72,000, consumption 80% of income, assets one income month and debt CNY 50,000. Opening liquid cash is assigned 39.1% of financial assets and essential spending 70% of total spending. Mixed old debt is split equally between housing and other debt. Housing contracts use 5.42% annual interest and 240 remaining months; other debt uses 7.68% and 36 months, with rates referenced to March 2022 newly issued household lending [25] . These assignments are common within household pairs and retain initial budget deficits.
paragraphs.zh: 货币区间使用其中点值；无上界的开放区间使用下界的1.25倍。 年度收入和消费除以十二。 缺失的年度收入赋值为72,000元人民币，消费为收入的80%，资产为一个月收入，债务为50,000元人民币。 期初流动现金赋值为金融资产的39.1%，必要支出为总支出的70%。 混合旧债务在住房债务和其他债务之间平均分摊。 住房合同采用5.42%的年利率和240个剩余月份；其他债务采用7.68%的年利率和36个月，利率参考2022年3月新发放的住户贷款[25]。 这些赋值在智能体对内部是通用的，并保留初始预算赤字。

sents.zh: 货币区间使用其中点值；无上界的开放区间使用下界的1.25倍。

sents.zh: 年度收入和消费除以十二。

sents.en: Missing annual income is assigned CNY 72,000, consumption 80% of income, assets one income month and debt CNY 50,000.
sents.zh: 缺失的年度收入赋值为72,000元人民币，消费为收入的80%，资产为一个月收入，债务为50,000元人民币。

sents.zh: 期初流动现金赋值为金融资产的39.1%，必要支出为总支出的70%。

sents.en: Mixed old debt is split equally between housing and other debt.
sents.zh: 混合旧债务在住房债务和其他债务之间平均分摊。

sents.zh: 住房合同采用5.42%的年利率和240个剩余月份；其他债务采用7.68%的年利率和36个月，利率参考2022年3月新发放的住户贷款[25]。

sents.zh: 这些赋值在智能体对内部是通用的，并保留初始预算赤字。

paragraphs.en: Opening debt in the 12M application is assigned from the selected 500M record’s debt-principal category. The no-debt category assigns zero; finite positive brackets assign their midpoint; the open bracket above CNY 5 million assigns CNY 6.25 million; and an unknown category assigns CNY 50,000. Debt type selects the housing or other-debt contract, with mixed housing debt split equally between the two. The two conditions share these opening amounts, scheduled payments and remaining terms.
paragraphs.zh: 12个月申请中的期初债务取自所选500万记录的债务本金类别。 无债务类别赋值为零；有限正数区间赋值为其中点；500万元以上的开放区间赋值为625万元；未知类别赋值为5万元。 债务类型选择住房或其他债务合同，混合的住房债务在两者之间平均分摊。 这两个条件共享这些期初金额、计划还款额和剩余期限。

sents.en: Opening debt in the 12M application is assigned from the selected 500M record’s debt-principal category.
sents.zh: 12个月申请中的期初债务取自所选500万记录的债务本金类别。

sents.en: The no-debt category assigns zero; finite positive brackets assign their midpoint; the open bracket above CNY 5 million assigns CNY 6.25 million; and an unknown category assigns CNY 50,000.
sents.zh: 无债务类别赋值为零；有限正数区间赋值为其中点；500万元以上的开放区间赋值为625万元；未知类别赋值为5万元。

sents.zh: 这两个条件共享这些期初金额、计划还款额和剩余期限。

paragraphs.en: Each household faces a deferrable purchase goal of CNY 20,000 or 30,000 and a tied approved borrowing limit equal to that goal. Both conditions permit financing. Options defer the purchase, finance half, or finance its full amount. Borrowed funds purchase the good at disbursement. The assigned contract has a 5% annual nominal rate, 24 monthly installments, no fee and its first payment in month 1. Both arms share the profile, opening cash, existing obligations and income; the goal and tied approved amount change jointly. The twelve-month ledger begins on 1 November 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 每个家庭面临一个 2 万元或 3 万元的可推迟购买目标，以及一个与该目标相等、与之绑定的已批准借款额度。 两种条件均允许融资。 选项包括推迟购买、融资一半或全额融资。 借入的资金在放款时用于购买该商品。 指定的合同年名义利率为 5%，分 24 期按月偿还，无手续费，首期付款在第 1 个月。 两个分组共享相同的画像、期初现金、既有负债和收入；目标与绑定的已批准额度联动变化。 十二个月的账簿从 2026 年 11 月 1 日开始。

paragraphs.en: Income arrives before current-month spending. Routine essential and selected adjustable consumption precede dated bank payments; oldest dues are paid first and interest before principal. Integer-cent cash remains nonnegative, unmet selected spending remains a gap, and unpaid obligations stay in arrears. Default records bank dues of at least CNY 1 remaining over ninety calendar days overdue, retaining an event after cure. Exposure at first default includes outstanding principal and accrued unpaid interest. A 24-month loan can retain debt at the end of the twelve-month observation window. Table S32 reports mean total, purchase and routine consumption, cash, payments, interest, debt and risk.
paragraphs.zh: 收入先于当月支出到达。 例行必要消费和选定的可调整消费先于有到期日的银行付款；最早到期的欠款先支付，且先付利息后付本金。 整数分现金保持非负，未被满足的选定消费保持为缺口，未偿还的债务保持拖欠状态。 违约记录的是剩余金额不低于 1 元人民币且逾期超过九十天的银行欠款，在补救后仍保留违约事件。 首次违约时的风险敞口包括未偿本金和累计未付利息。 一笔 24 个月的贷款在十二个月观察期结束时仍可能存在未偿债务。 表 S32 报告了总消费、购买消费和例行消费、现金、付款、利息、债务和风险的均值。

paragraphs.en: Options A, B and C defer the purchase, purchase half the goal and purchase the full goal. The baseline-to-intervention transition contributions to purchases are CNY 0, 15,000, 30,000, − 10,000 -10,000 , 5,000, 20,000, − 20,000 -20,000 , − 5,000 -5,000 and 10,000 for A → \to A, A → \to B, A → \to C, B → \to A, B → \to B, B → \to C, C → \to A, C → \to B and C → \to C, respectively. Weighting these amounts by group transition frequencies exactly reconstructs the purchase response. A → \to B and A → \to C form the deferral-to-purchase channel; B → \to B and C → \to C capture amount increases under an unchanged partial- or full-purchase choice. Adding the routine-consumption response gives the total consumption response. Table S46 applies this decomposition after the same age–income standardization.

paragraphs.en: The fixed monthly panel contains 10,000 households selected to cover initial one-shot consumption responses in the 12M cohort. Groups use the twelve-month total-consumption difference, CNY 30k minus 20k: negative, zero, positive up to CNY 5,000, and above CNY 5,000. Their final counts are 420, 4,740, 5 and 4,835. A 100,000-household roster retains all 3,641 negative and five low-positive records and 48,177 financial-cell prototypes from each larger group. Prototype cells cross income quintile, cash-buffer quartile and debt-service quartile. The monthly panel retains 196 development households and selects the other 9,804 by seeded sampling without replacement through a 20,000-household staging panel, with uniform draws within its execution shards. Panel means use equal household weights and a denominator of 10,000; the response-group mixture differs from that of the 12M cohort. The same household IDs, opening states and dated obligations enter all twelve route–goal worlds; paired contrasts are averaged within this fixed panel. Only the nonreplenishing purchase goal changes, from CNY 20,000 to 30,000. Both conditions use a CNY 30,000 ceiling on outstanding new bank principal, a 5% annual nominal rate, 24 installments, no fee and a CNY 100 minimum draw. Previous contracts continue on their dated terms.
paragraphs.zh: 固定的月度面板包含 10,000 户家庭，这些家庭经挑选用于覆盖 12 个月组群中的初始一次性消费反应。 分组采用十二个月总消费差额（人民币 3 万元减 2 万元）：负值、零、正值至人民币 5,000 元以内，以及超过人民币 5,000 元。 各组的最终数量分别为 420、4,740、5 和 4,835。 一份 100,000 户家庭名册保留了全部 3,641 条负值记录和 5 条低正值记录，以及来自每个较大组的 48,177 个财务单元格原型。 原型单元格跨越收入五分位、现金缓冲四分位和偿债四分位。 月度面板保留 196 户开发家庭，并通过一个 20,000 户家庭的暂存面板，以带种子的无放回抽样选取其余 9,804 户，其执行分片内采用均匀抽取。 面板均值使用等家庭权重且分母为 10,000；其反应组混合构成与 12 个月组群不同。 相同的家庭 ID、初始状态和带日期的债务义务进入全部十二个路线—目标世界；配对对比在该固定面板内取平均。 只有非补充型购买目标发生变化，从人民币 20,000 元变为 30,000 元。 两个条件均采用人民币 30,000 元的未偿新增银行本金上限、5% 的年名义利率、24 期分期、无手续费以及人民币 100 元的最低提款额。 先前的合同按其既有带日期的条款继续执行。

sents.en: The fixed monthly panel contains 10,000 households selected to cover initial one-shot consumption responses in the 12M cohort.
sents.zh: 固定的月度面板包含 10,000 户家庭，这些家庭经挑选用于覆盖 12 个月组群中的初始一次性消费反应。

sents.en: Groups use the twelve-month total-consumption difference, CNY 30k minus 20k: negative, zero, positive up to CNY 5,000, and above CNY 5,000.
sents.zh: 分组采用十二个月总消费差额（人民币 3 万元减 2 万元）：负值、零、正值至人民币 5,000 元以内，以及超过人民币 5,000 元。

sents.en: Their final counts are 420, 4,740, 5 and 4,835.
A 100,000-household roster retains all 3,641 negative and five low-positive records and 48,177 financial-cell prototypes from each larger group.
sents.zh: 一份 100,000 户家庭名册保留了全部 3,641 条负值记录和 5 条低正值记录，以及来自每个较大组的 48,177 个财务单元格原型。

sents.en: Prototype cells cross income quintile, cash-buffer quartile and debt-service quartile.
sents.zh: 原型单元格跨越收入五分位、现金缓冲四分位和偿债四分位。

sents.en: The monthly panel retains 196 development households and selects the other 9,804 by seeded sampling without replacement through a 20,000-household staging panel, with uniform draws within its execution shards.
sents.zh: 月度面板保留 196 户开发家庭，并通过一个 20,000 户家庭的暂存面板，以带种子的无放回抽样选取其余 9,804 户，其执行分片内采用均匀抽取。

sents.en: Panel means use equal household weights and a denominator of 10,000; the response-group mixture differs from that of the 12M cohort.
sents.zh: 面板均值使用等家庭权重且分母为 10,000；其反应组混合构成与 12 个月组群不同。

sents.en: The same household IDs, opening states and dated obligations enter all twelve route–goal worlds; paired contrasts are averaged within this fixed panel.
sents.zh: 相同的家庭 ID、初始状态和带日期的债务义务进入全部十二个路线—目标世界；配对对比在该固定面板内取平均。

sents.en: Only the nonreplenishing purchase goal changes, from CNY 20,000 to 30,000.
sents.zh: 只有非补充型购买目标发生变化，从人民币 20,000 元变为 30,000 元。

sents.en: Both conditions use a CNY 30,000 ceiling on outstanding new bank principal, a 5% annual nominal rate, 24 installments, no fee and a CNY 100 minimum draw.
sents.zh: 两个条件均采用人民币 30,000 元的未偿新增银行本金上限、5% 的年名义利率、24 期分期、无手续费以及人民币 100 元的最低提款额。

sents.en: Previous contracts continue on their dated terms.
sents.zh: 先前的合同按其既有带日期的条款继续执行。

paragraphs.en: R0 keeps original income and needs throughout. R1 assigns 70% of original income in months 7–9 and restores it in month 10. R2 multiplies income by 0.9 in each of months 7, 8 and 9, then maintains 72.9% of original income through month 24. R3 adds necessary spending equal to 90% of one original month’s income in month 10. R4 combines R1 and R3. R5 multiplies income by 1.1 in each of months 7, 8 and 9, maintaining 133.1% thereafter. Three-step income paths are announced in month 7; future shocks are not revealed before their event. Amounts are rounded to cents at each step.
paragraphs.zh: R0 在全程保持原始收入和需求不变。 R1 在第 7–9 个月分配原始收入的 70%，并在第 10 个月恢复原始收入。 R2 在第 7、8、9 个月中每个月将收入乘以 0.9，然后直到第 24 个月维持原始收入的 72.9%。 R3 在第 10 个月增加相当于原始一个月收入 90% 的必要支出。R4 结合 R1 和 R3。 R5 在第 7、8、9 个月中每个月将收入乘以 1.1，此后维持 133.1%。 三阶段收入路径在第 7 个月公布；未来冲击在其发生前不予披露。 每一步的金额都四舍五入到分。

sents.zh: R5 在第 7、8、9 个月中每个月将收入乘以 1.1，此后维持 133.1%。

sents.en: Three-step income paths are announced in month 7; future shocks are not revealed before their event.
sents.zh: 三阶段收入路径在第 7 个月公布；未来冲击在其发生前不予披露。

sents.en: Amounts are rounded to cents at each step.
sents.zh: 每一步的金额都四舍五入到分。

paragraphs.en: Every monthly observation includes the complete persona, income and resources, current shock information, all previous executed monthly records in a compact numeric table, all dated contracts with rates, installments and arrears, the current offer and the remaining purchase goal. The monthly service uses an 8,192-token total input budget, a 1,024-token question/options allocation and up to 192 tokens per option. The action menu combines zero, half-normal or normal adjustable consumption with deferral, cash funding or partial/full financing. The ledger executes the selected feasible purchase first, then necessary and adjustable spending, then dated debt payments from remaining cash; unmet needs and arrears carry forward. A zero adjustable-spending choice leaves necessary-spending execution active. Remaining purchase need falls by executed purchases.
paragraphs.zh: 每次月度观测都包含完整的人物画像、收入与资源、当期冲击信息、此前所有已执行月度记录的紧凑数值表、所有带利率、分期和欠款条款的日期化合同、当前报价以及剩余购买目标。 月度服务使用总计 8,192 个 token 的输入预算，其中问题/选项分配 1,024 个 token，每个选项最多 192 个 token。 行动菜单将零、半正态或正态的可调消费与延期、现金注资或部分/全额融资相结合。 账本首先执行所选的可行购买，其次是必要支出和可调支出，然后从剩余现金中支付日期化债务；未满足的需求和欠款结转至下期。 可调支出选择为零时，必要支出的执行仍保持激活。 剩余购买需求随已执行购买而下降。
