paragraphs.en: Individual offer capacity uses the preceding three months’ mean income and existing scheduled debt payments. A new monthly payment budget is the positive part of half the income remaining after base necessary needs, less existing scheduled installments. The offer is the smaller of the principal supported by that budget and the remaining product ceiling. Material thirty-day arrears in the previous three months freeze the new offer. Each world’s portfolio factor uses its last three completed months: repayment coverage c c is actual bank payments divided by payable obligations including arrears, capped at one; d d is the material thirty-day-arrears share of active borrower-months. The factor is min ⁡ ( 1 , max ⁡ ( 0.25 , 1 − 0.5 ​ ( 1 − c ) − 2 ​ d ) ) \min(1,\max(0.25,1-0.5(1-c)-2d)) , rounded to basis points. It multiplies individual offer capacity. Initial coverage and factor equal one. These assigned simulation rules link liquidity and repayment stress to subsequent credit capacity. The 0.25 floor retains a quarter of individual capacity after the portfolio adjustment, with recent-arrears freezes applied before scaling and the CNY 100 minimum draw applied afterward. For the offer decomposition, let A j A_{j} be mean individual capacity after freezes and g j g_{j} its world factor for goal j j . The exact difference is Δ ​ O ¯ = g ¯ ​ Δ ​ A + A ¯ ​ Δ ​ g + Δ ​ r \Delta\bar{O}=\bar{g}\,\Delta A+\bar{A}\,\Delta g+\Delta r , where bars over g g and A A average the two goal worlds and r r contains cent rounding and the minimum-draw rule. Individual capacity is further split into capacity before the arrears freeze and capacity removed by that freeze. Table S50 reports the resulting accounting components.
paragraphs.zh: 个人可贷额度使用前三个月的平均收入与既有的定期债务还款。 新的月度还款预算，是收入扣除基本必要开支后剩余部分的一半减去既有定期分期付款后的正数部分。 可贷额度为该预算所能支持的本金与剩余产品上限两者中的较小者。 前三个月内存在重大的三十天逾期将冻结新的可贷额度。 每个世界的组合因子使用其最近三个已完结月份：还款覆盖度 c c 为银行实际还款额除以应付义务（含逾期款项），上限为一；d d 为活跃借款人-月份中重大三十天逾期的占比。 该因子为 min ⁡ ( 1 , max ⁡ ( 0.25 , 1 − 0.5 ​ ( 1 − c ) − 2 ​ d ) ) \min(1,\max(0.25,1-0.5(1-c)-2d))，并四舍五入至基点。 该因子与个人可贷额度相乘。 初始覆盖度与因子均为一。 这些指定的模拟规则将流动性与还款压力与随后的信贷能力联系起来。 0.25 的下限确保组合调整后仍保留四分之一的个人额度，其中近期逾期冻结在缩放之前应用，最低 100 元人民币提款在缩放之后应用。 对于可贷额度分解，令 A j A_{j} 为冻结后的平均个人额度，g j g_{j} 为其对应目标 j j 的世界因子。 精确差值为 Δ ​ O ¯ = g ¯ ​ Δ ​ A + A ¯ ​ Δ ​ g + Δ ​ r \Delta\bar{O}=\bar{g}\,\Delta A+\bar{A}\,\Delta g+\Delta r，其中 g g 与 A A 上方的横线表示两个目标世界的平均值，r r 包含分位四舍五入与最低提款规则。 个人额度进一步拆分为逾期冻结前的额度与因该冻结而被移除的额度。 表 S50 报告了由此得到的核算组成部分。

sents.zh: 可贷额度为该预算所能支持的本金与剩余产品上限两者中的较小者。

It multiplies individual offer capacity.

sents.zh: 精确差值为 Δ ​ O ¯ = g ¯ ​ Δ ​ A + A ¯ ​ Δ ​ g + Δ ​ r \Delta\bar{O}=\bar{g}\,\Delta A+\bar{A}\,\Delta g+\Delta r，其中 g g 与 A A 上方的横线表示两个目标世界的平均值，r r 包含分位四舍五入与最低提款规则。

paragraphs.en: All 10,000 households in a world complete a month before its aggregate feedback sets the next month’s offers. Worlds differ only in the assigned shock path and goal; the bank rule remains common. FinL-mlx uses the same frozen checkpoint and complete-input protocol throughout. Identical complete household inputs within the same month reuse their saved response by ordinary task ID. Changed inputs receive a new choice. Exact-panel means and within-household goal differences describe this constructed panel; Tables S34–S36 retain financial and execution summaries.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个世界中，全部 10,000 个家庭在下月的聚合反馈设定下月的要约之前完成当月任务。 各世界仅在分配到的冲击路径与目标上有所不同；银行规则保持通用。 FinL-mlx 在全程使用同一个冻结检查点和完整输入协议。 同一月份内完全相同的家庭输入会通过普通任务 ID 复用其已保存的响应。 发生变化的输入会获得新的选择。 精确面板均值与家庭内部目标差异用于描述这一构建的面板；表 S34–S36 保留金融与执行摘要。

sents.en: All 10,000 households in a world complete a month before its aggregate feedback sets the next month’s offers.
sents.zh: 在一个世界中，全部 10,000 个家庭在下月的聚合反馈设定下月的要约之前完成当月任务。

sents.en: Worlds differ only in the assigned shock path and goal; the bank rule remains common.
sents.zh: 各世界仅在分配到的冲击路径与目标上有所不同；银行规则保持通用。

sents.en: FinL-mlx uses the same frozen checkpoint and complete-input protocol throughout.
sents.zh: FinL-mlx 在全程使用同一个冻结检查点和完整输入协议。

sents.en: Identical complete household inputs within the same month reuse their saved response by ordinary task ID.
sents.zh: 同一月份内完全相同的家庭输入会通过普通任务 ID 复用其已保存的响应。

sents.en: Changed inputs receive a new choice.
sents.zh: 发生变化的输入会获得新的选择。

sents.en: Exact-panel means and within-household goal differences describe this constructed panel; Tables S34–S36 retain financial and execution summaries.
sents.zh: 精确面板均值与家庭内部目标差异用于描述这一构建的面板；表 S34–S36 保留金融与执行摘要。

paragraphs.en: For the initial-resource group analysis, annual income equals twelve times assigned first-month income; cash and debt are opening stocks. Cash exhaustion is the first completed month ending at zero cash; default uses the ledger’s cumulative material-delinquency indicator. All opening cash balances are positive. Month-24 bank feedback uses months 21–23. For each resource partition and world w w , group g g contributes pressure P g , w = 0.5 ​ ( U g , w − A g , w ) / U w + 2 ​ D g , w / B w P_{g,w}=0.5(U_{g,w}-A_{g,w})/U_{w}+2D_{g,w}/B_{w} , where U U denotes payable obligations, A A actual payments, D D material thirty-day-arrears borrower-months and B B active borrower-months. Group pressures sum to the portfolio pressure before the factor is clipped. A group’s share of the persistent-loss pressure increase is ( P g , R ​ 2 − P g , R ​ 0 ) / ( P R ​ 2 − P R ​ 0 ) (P_{g,R2}-P_{g,R0})/(P_{R2}-P_{R0}) . Table S48 applies these definitions to the saved R0/R2 household-month records.
paragraphs.zh: 对于初始资源组分析，年收入等于指派首月收入的十二倍；现金与债务为期初存量。 现金耗尽指以零现金结束的首个完整月份；违约使用账本中的累计实质性逾期指标。 所有期初现金余额均为正。 第24个月的银行反馈使用第21至23个月。 对每个资源分组和世界 w w，组 g g 贡献的压力为 P g , w = 0.5 ​ ( U g , w − A g , w ) / U w + 2 ​ D g , w / B w P_{g,w}=0.5(U_{g,w}-A_{g,w})/U_{w}+2D_{g,w}/B_{w}，其中 U U 表示应付义务，A A 表示实际支付，D D 表示实质性三十天逾期的借款人月数，B B 表示活跃借款人月数。 各组压力相加即为投资组合压力，随后才对系数进行截断。 某组在持续性损失压力增量中所占份额为 ( P g , R ​ 2 − P g , R ​ 0 ) / ( P R ​ 2 − P R ​ 0 ) (P_{g,R2}-P_{g,R0})/(P_{R2}-P_{R0})。 表S48将这些定义应用于保存的 R0/R2 家庭—月度记录。

sents.en: For the initial-resource group analysis, annual income equals twelve times assigned first-month income; cash and debt are opening stocks.
sents.zh: 对于初始资源组分析，年收入等于指派首月收入的十二倍；现金与债务为期初存量。

sents.en: Cash exhaustion is the first completed month ending at zero cash; default uses the ledger’s cumulative material-delinquency indicator.
sents.zh: 现金耗尽指以零现金结束的首个完整月份；违约使用账本中的累计实质性逾期指标。

sents.en: All opening cash balances are positive.
sents.zh: 所有期初现金余额均为正。

sents.en: Month-24 bank feedback uses months 21–23.

sents.en: For each resource partition and world w w , group g g contributes pressure P g , w = 0.5 ​ ( U g , w − A g , w ) / U w + 2 ​ D g , w / B w P_{g,w}=0.5(U_{g,w}-A_{g,w})/U_{w}+2D_{g,w}/B_{w} , where U U denotes payable obligations, A A actual payments, D D material thirty-day-arrears borrower-months and B B active borrower-months.
sents.zh: 对每个资源分组和世界 w w，组 g g 贡献的压力为 P g , w = 0.5 ​ ( U g , w − A g , w ) / U w + 2 ​ D g , w / B w P_{g,w}=0.5(U_{g,w}-A_{g,w})/U_{w}+2D_{g,w}/B_{w}，其中 U U 表示应付义务，A A 表示实际支付，D D 表示实质性三十天逾期的借款人月数，B B 表示活跃借款人月数。

sents.en: A group’s share of the persistent-loss pressure increase is ( P g , R ​ 2 − P g , R ​ 0 ) / ( P R ​ 2 − P R ​ 0 ) (P_{g,R2}-P_{g,R0})/(P_{R2}-P_{R0}) .
sents.zh: 某组在持续性损失压力增量中所占份额为 ( P g , R ​ 2 − P g , R ​ 0 ) / ( P R ​ 2 − P R ​ 0 ) (P_{g,R2}-P_{g,R0})/(P_{R2}-P_{R0})。

paragraphs.en: Indexed action and partition lookups replace quadratic scans with linear work. Shared action descriptors are decoded once per request. Connection pools scale with concurrency; parallel partitions retain bounded queues. State, events and command results use one durable transaction. The optimization study reduces 1,000-agent rounds from 7.37 to 3.10 seconds and 5,000-agent rounds from 90.14 to 16.66 seconds. At 100 agents, durable and in-memory paths take 0.349 and 0.345 seconds, respectively (Table S11).
paragraphs.zh: 索引化的动作与分区查找以线性工作量取代了二次方扫描。 共享的动作描述符在每个请求中只解码一次。 连接池随并发度扩展；并行分区保持有界队列。 状态、事件与命令结果使用同一个持久化事务。 该优化研究将 1,000 个智能体的回合时间从 7.37 秒降至 3.10 秒，将 5,000 个智能体的回合时间从 90.14 秒降至 16.66 秒。 在 100 个智能体的情况下，持久化路径与内存路径分别耗时 0.349 秒和 0.345 秒（表 S11）。

sents.en: Indexed action and partition lookups replace quadratic scans with linear work.
sents.zh: 索引化的动作与分区查找以线性工作量取代了二次方扫描。

sents.en: Shared action descriptors are decoded once per request.
sents.zh: 共享的动作描述符在每个请求中只解码一次。

sents.en: Connection pools scale with concurrency; parallel partitions retain bounded queues.
sents.zh: 连接池随并发度扩展；并行分区保持有界队列。

sents.en: State, events and command results use one durable transaction.
sents.zh: 状态、事件与命令结果使用同一个持久化事务。

sents.en: The optimization study reduces 1,000-agent rounds from 7.37 to 3.10 seconds and 5,000-agent rounds from 90.14 to 16.66 seconds.
sents.zh: 该优化研究将 1,000 个智能体的回合时间从 7.37 秒降至 3.10 秒，将 5,000 个智能体的回合时间从 90.14 秒降至 16.66 秒。

sents.en: At 100 agents, durable and in-memory paths take 0.349 and 0.345 seconds, respectively (Table S11).
sents.zh: 在 100 个智能体的情况下，持久化路径与内存路径分别耗时 0.349 秒和 0.345 秒（表 S11）。

paragraphs.en: Capability labels describe the inspected native execution paths. Yes means the framework implements the defined mechanism, including through a configurable native module. Partial means only part of that function is implemented, and N/D means the mechanism is not documented. Array-based ECS requires indexed numeric component arrays. Synchronized state persistence requires a database transaction or explicit synchronized writes protecting saved state. OneSim’s enabled PostgreSQL path qualifies. State saving and restart support are evaluated separately from synchronization and whole-world atomicity.
paragraphs.zh: 能力标签描述的是被检查的原生执行路径。 「是」表示该框架实现了所定义的机制，包括通过可配置的原生模块实现。 「部分」表示只实现了该功能的一部分，「未记录」表示该机制没有文档说明。 基于数组的 ECS 需要带索引的数值组件数组。 同步状态持久化需要数据库事务或显式的同步写入来保护已保存的状态。 OneSim 启用的 PostgreSQL 路径符合要求。 状态保存与重启支持是独立于同步和整个世界原子性进行评估的。

sents.en: Capability labels describe the inspected native execution paths.
sents.zh: 能力标签描述的是被检查的原生执行路径。

sents.en: Yes means the framework implements the defined mechanism, including through a configurable native module.
sents.zh: 「是」表示该框架实现了所定义的机制，包括通过可配置的原生模块实现。

sents.en: Partial means only part of that function is implemented, and N/D means the mechanism is not documented.
sents.zh: 「部分」表示只实现了该功能的一部分，「未记录」表示该机制没有文档说明。

sents.en: Array-based ECS requires indexed numeric component arrays.
sents.zh: 基于数组的 ECS 需要带索引的数值组件数组。

sents.en: Synchronized state persistence requires a database transaction or explicit synchronized writes protecting saved state.
sents.zh: 同步状态持久化需要数据库事务或显式的同步写入来保护已保存的状态。

sents.en: OneSim’s enabled PostgreSQL path qualifies.
sents.zh: OneSim 启用的 PostgreSQL 路径符合要求。

sents.en: State saving and restart support are evaluated separately from synchronization and whole-world atomicity.
sents.zh: 状态保存与重启支持是独立于同步和整个世界原子性进行评估的。

paragraphs.en: Native action-rule enforcement requires programmatic execution constraints on business state, permissions or spatial movement. OASIS and MiroFish enforce platform business rules; AgentSociety enforces permissions and workspace boundaries. Event registration or answer-format checks alone receive Partial. Policy-intent/world-effect separation requires the engine to resolve a proposed intent before applying authoritative effects. Atomic state–event commit couples world state, outbox and command result. The combined isolation/rollback row receives Partial for AgentSociety’s independent agent tasks and MatrAIx’s independent trials, which isolate failures without rolling back the complete world step.
paragraphs.zh: 原生动作规则执行需要对业务状态、权限或空间移动进行程序化执行约束。 OASIS 和 MiroFish 强制执行平台业务规则；AgentSociety 强制执行权限与工作区边界。 仅具备事件注册或答案格式校验的系统只能获得 Partial。 策略意图/世界效果分离要求引擎在应用权威效果之前先解析所提议的意图。 原子化的状态-事件提交将世界状态、outbox 与命令结果耦合在一起。 组合的隔离/回滚一行对 AgentSociety 的独立智能体任务与 MatrAIx 的独立试验给予 Partial，因为它们隔离了故障，但不会回滚完整的世界步骤。

sents.en: The combined isolation/rollback row receives Partial for AgentSociety’s independent agent tasks and MatrAIx’s independent trials, which isolate failures without rolling back the complete world step.

paragraphs.en: Recovery/resume requires a native restart path from saved state or completed-task progress: AgentSociety checkpoints and MatrAIx job progress qualify. Execution/connection pooling includes framework-managed reusable workers, connections or model instances; OneSim’s connection pools and AgentSociety’s Ray workers qualify. Task admission/flow control requires waiting for execution capacity or reducing admission under overload. OASIS and MiroFish gate LLM calls, AgentSociety uses local adaptive admission, and MatrAIx gates trials. Decision/trial concurrency control requires a configured or adaptive execution allowance. OneSim’s event queues and distributed coordination receive Partial because the inspected decision path launches tasks without such an allowance. Local admission does not establish a globally bounded waiting queue.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复/重启需要基于已保存状态或已完成任务进度的原生重启路径：AgentSociety 的检查点和 MatrAIx 的作业进度符合条件。 执行/连接池化包括由框架管理的可复用工作进程、连接或模型实例；OneSim 的连接池和 AgentSociety 的 Ray 工作进程符合条件。 任务准入/流控需要等待执行容量或在过载时减少准入。 OASIS 和 MiroFish 对大模型调用进行门控，AgentSociety 使用本地自适应准入，MatrAIx 对试验进行门控。 决策/试验并发控制需要已配置的或自适应的执行配额。 OneSim 的事件队列和分布式协调获得部分符合，因为所检查的决策路径在没有此类配额的情况下启动任务。 本地准入并不能建立一个全局有界的等待队列。

paragraphs.zh: 交付的消费者-银行读取器按分片顺序从其文档所述的 1 亿父集中选择前 10,000,000 个不同的行。 选择需要已知的金融资产区间、债务金额、债务类型、投资活动和一般信托。 单独的 5 亿扩展应用了额外的校准，并作为一个群体资源进行评估。

sents.en: The delivered consumer-bank reader selects the first 10,000,000 distinct rows in shard order from its documented 100M parent.
sents.zh: 交付的消费者-银行读取器按分片顺序从其文档所述的 1 亿父集中选择前 10,000,000 个不同的行。

sents.en: Selection requires known financial-asset bracket, debt amount, debt type, investment activity and general trust.
sents.zh: 选择需要已知的金融资产区间、债务金额、债务类型、投资活动和一般信托。

paragraphs.en: SFT minimizes cross-entropy against the observed answer or coded target. Native Laya RLCD adds a policy-gradient term over four zero-mean Gaussian logit perturbations to this cross-entropy [37] . Proper scoring rules motivate its probability-based rewards [40] . Choice examples receive a clipped log-score and spherical-score reward, with spherical weight 0.75. Each example’s sample rewards are centered, their advantages are standardized, and those advantages weight the perturbed logits’ Gaussian log-density. Noise decreases linearly from 0.4 to 0.1. The ranked-probability reward is used for Score-typed targets; the survey examples use Choice targets.
paragraphs.zh: SFT 最小化针对观测答案或编码目标的交叉熵。 原生 Laya RLCD 在此交叉熵基础上，对四个零均值高斯 logit 扰动添加了一个策略梯度项 [37]。 适当评分规则为其基于概率的奖励提供了依据 [40]。 Choice 类样例获得截断的对数评分（log-score）与球面评分（spherical-score）奖励，球面权重为 0.75。 每个样例的样本奖励被中心化，其优势被标准化，这些优势用于对扰动 logits 的高斯对数密度加权。 噪声从 0.4 线性下降至 0.1。 排序概率奖励用于 Score 类型的目标；调查类样例使用 Choice 目标。

sents.en: SFT minimizes cross-entropy against the observed answer or coded target.
sents.zh: SFT 最小化针对观测答案或编码目标的交叉熵。

sents.en: Native Laya RLCD adds a policy-gradient term over four zero-mean Gaussian logit perturbations to this cross-entropy [37] .
sents.zh: 原生 Laya RLCD 在此交叉熵基础上，对四个零均值高斯 logit 扰动添加了一个策略梯度项 [37]。

sents.en: Proper scoring rules motivate its probability-based rewards [40] .
sents.zh: 适当评分规则为其基于概率的奖励提供了依据 [40]。

sents.en: Choice examples receive a clipped log-score and spherical-score reward, with spherical weight 0.75.
sents.zh: Choice 类样例获得截断的对数评分（log-score）与球面评分（spherical-score）奖励，球面权重为 0.75。

sents.en: Each example’s sample rewards are centered, their advantages are standardized, and those advantages weight the perturbed logits’ Gaussian log-density.
sents.zh: 每个样例的样本奖励被中心化，其优势被标准化，这些优势用于对扰动 logits 的高斯对数密度加权。

sents.en: Noise decreases linearly from 0.4 to 0.1.
sents.zh: 噪声从 0.4 线性下降至 0.1。

sents.en: The ranked-probability reward is used for Score-typed targets; the survey examples use Choice targets.
sents.zh: 排序概率奖励用于 Score 类型的目标；调查类样例使用 Choice 目标。

paragraphs.en: Training uses AdamW, weight decay 0.01, gradient-norm clipping at 1.0, 5% linear warm-up and cosine decay to 5% of the initial learning rate. Separate encoder and head rates, batch sizes and stage seeds appear in Table S19 and Table S21. Option order is shuffled during training. Checkpoint temperatures are fitted on the independent calibration split. Development question-macro negative log-likelihood records checkpoint selection before test evaluation; the released 6-round model is final rlcd-2.

paragraphs.en: The QA training encoding uses 512 total tokens, a 256-token question/options allocation and up to 48 tokens per option. One-shot financial deployment uses a 2,048-token complete input, a 1,024-token question/options allocation and up to 192 tokens per option so that monetary paths and repayment terms remain in the model input. The monthly shock extension uses the 8,192-token service budget specified in M11. The original option markers, weights, probability calibration and decoder are retained. The 12M purchase-funding application processes a mean 529.98 actual nonpadding candidate input tokens per choice.
paragraphs.zh: 问答训练编码共使用 512 个词元，其中问题/选项分配为 256 个词元，每个选项最多 48 个词元。 一次性金融部署使用 2,048 个词元的完整输入，问题/选项分配为 1,024 个词元，每个选项最多 192 个词元，以确保资金路径和还款条款保留在模型输入中。 月度冲击扩展使用 M11 中规定的 8,192 个词元的服务预算。 原有的选项标记、权重、概率校准和解码器均予以保留。 12 个月购债融资应用中，每个选择平均处理 529.98 个实际非填充候选输入词元。

paragraphs.en: Two independent full continuation replicas repeated the 6-round recipe from the same completed 3-round initialization. Each processed 2,925,263 training QA in one SFT pass and one RLCD pass, using six cards, effective batch 768 and 3,809 optimizer updates per stage. Stage-specific temperatures were fitted on the fixed calibration split. All three runs evaluated the same 119-version, 240,458-QA financial-question test with RLCD fixed as the final stage.

paragraphs.en: A separate controlled behavioral study contains 1,120 decisions with DeepSeek Flash as actor. Twenty personas drawn from a 1,000-persona parent cohort complete four financial tasks under two conditions. Single-pass choice (SP), candidate generation with self-check (SC), and multi-agent planning, constraint checking and execution use one, two and three model calls per decision. All 480 workflow decisions return legal options (Table S23).
paragraphs.zh: 一项独立的受控行为研究包含1,120个以DeepSeek Flash作为智能体的决策。 从一个包含1,000个人设的母群组中抽取的20个人设，在两种条件下完成四项金融任务。 单次通过选择（SP）、带自检的候选生成（SC）以及多智能体规划、约束检查与执行，每次决策分别使用一次、两次和三次模型调用。 全部480个工作流决策均返回合法选项（表S23）。

sents.en: A separate controlled behavioral study contains 1,120 decisions with DeepSeek Flash as actor.
sents.zh: 一项独立的受控行为研究包含1,120个以DeepSeek Flash作为智能体的决策。

sents.en: Single-pass choice (SP), candidate generation with self-check (SC), and multi-agent planning, constraint checking and execution use one, two and three model calls per decision.

sents.en: All 480 workflow decisions return legal options (Table S23).
sents.zh: 全部480个工作流决策均返回合法选项（表S23）。

paragraphs.en: Strict adherence requires all hard ledger constraints and the assigned persona goal. Across 160 decisions per workflow, adherence is 67.5% for SP, 81.9% for SC and 86.9% for multi-agent workflow. Hard-constraint violations are 23.1%, 14.4% and 6.9%. Multi-agent workflow improves adherence over SP by 19.4 percentage points, with a persona-clustered exploratory 95% bootstrap interval of 13.1–25.0; the multi-agent workflow–SC difference is 5.0 points, with an interval of -1.9 to 11.9 (Supplementary Figure S7a).
paragraphs.zh: 严格遵守要求需满足所有硬性账本约束及所分配的角色目标。 在每个工作流 160 个决策中，SP 的遵守率为 67.5%，SC 为 81.9%，多智能体工作流为 86.9%。 硬性约束的违反率分别为 23.1%、14.4% 和 6.9%。 多智能体工作流的遵守率比 SP 高 19.4 个百分点，以角色为聚类的探索性 95% bootstrap 区间为 13.1–25.0；多智能体工作流与 SC 的差异为 5.0 个百分点，区间为 -1.9 至 11.9（补充图 S7a）。

sents.en: Strict adherence requires all hard ledger constraints and the assigned persona goal.
sents.zh: 严格遵守要求需满足所有硬性账本约束及所分配的角色目标。

sents.en: Across 160 decisions per workflow, adherence is 67.5% for SP, 81.9% for SC and 86.9% for multi-agent workflow.
sents.zh: 在每个工作流 160 个决策中，SP 的遵守率为 67.5%，SC 为 81.9%，多智能体工作流为 86.9%。

sents.en: Hard-constraint violations are 23.1%, 14.4% and 6.9%.
sents.zh: 硬性约束的违反率分别为 23.1%、14.4% 和 6.9%。

sents.en: Multi-agent workflow improves adherence over SP by 19.4 percentage points, with a persona-clustered exploratory 95% bootstrap interval of 13.1–25.0; the multi-agent workflow–SC difference is 5.0 points, with an interval of -1.9 to 11.9 (Supplementary Figure S7a).
sents.zh: 多智能体工作流的遵守率比 SP 高 19.4 个百分点，以角色为聚类的探索性 95% bootstrap 区间为 13.1–25.0；多智能体工作流与 SC 的差异为 5.0 个百分点，区间为 -1.9 至 11.9（补充图 S7a）。

paragraphs.en: Borrowing-amount adherence rises from 22.5% with SP to 77.5% with SC and 90.0% with multi-agent workflow. Consumption adjustment rises from 57.5% to 65.0% and 80.0%. Risk allocation stays near 95%; debt-payment allocation is 95.0%, 87.5% and 82.5%. Additional decision steps are most useful for borrowing and consumption in this task set (Supplementary Figure S7c).
paragraphs.zh: 借款金额遵循率从使用SP时的22.5%提高到使用SC时的77.5%，以及使用多智能体工作流时的90.0%。 消费调整率从57.5%提高到65.0%和80.0%。 风险配置保持在95%左右；偿债配置分别为95.0%、87.5%和82.5%。 在本任务集中，额外的决策步骤对借款和消费最为有用（补充图S7c）。

sents.zh: 借款金额遵循率从使用SP时的22.5%提高到使用SC时的77.5%，以及使用多智能体工作流时的90.0%。

Risk allocation stays near 95%; debt-payment allocation is 95.0%, 87.5% and 82.5%.
sents.zh: 风险配置保持在95%左右；偿债配置分别为95.0%、87.5%和82.5%。

paragraphs.en: A second study fixes ledger and options while changing one goal at a time in 20 constructed personas. Four axes, two polarities, two workflows and two repeats produce 640 decisions and 160 pairs per workflow. Multi-agent workflow changes choices in 96.2% of pairs, compared with 77.5% for SC. Both ends satisfy their goals in 66.2% and 58.1% of pairs. Persona-clustered exploratory intervals are 15.0–22.5 points for the 18.8-point response difference and 1.2–15.0 for the 8.1-point attainment difference (Supplementary Figure S7b).
paragraphs.zh: 第二项研究固定账本和选项，在20个构建的人设上一次改变一个目标。 四个轴、两个极性、两个工作流和两次重复产生640个决策和每个工作流160个配对。 多智能体工作流在96.2%的配对中改变了选择，而SC为77.5%。 双方在66.2%和58.1%的配对中实现了各自的目标。 按人设聚类的探索性区间对于18.8个百分点的回应差异为15.0–22.5，对于8.1个百分点的达成差异为1.2–15.0（补充图S7b）。

sents.en: A second study fixes ledger and options while changing one goal at a time in 20 constructed personas.
sents.zh: 第二项研究固定账本和选项，在20个构建的人设上一次改变一个目标。

sents.en: Four axes, two polarities, two workflows and two repeats produce 640 decisions and 160 pairs per workflow.
sents.zh: 四个轴、两个极性、两个工作流和两次重复产生640个决策和每个工作流160个配对。

sents.en: Multi-agent workflow changes choices in 96.2% of pairs, compared with 77.5% for SC.
sents.zh: 多智能体工作流在96.2%的配对中改变了选择，而SC为77.5%。

sents.en: Both ends satisfy their goals in 66.2% and 58.1% of pairs.
sents.zh: 双方在66.2%和58.1%的配对中实现了各自的目标。

sents.en: Persona-clustered exploratory intervals are 15.0–22.5 points for the 18.8-point response difference and 1.2–15.0 for the 8.1-point attainment difference (Supplementary Figure S7b).
sents.zh: 按人设聚类的探索性区间对于18.8个百分点的回应差异为15.0–22.5，对于8.1个百分点的达成差异为1.2–15.0（补充图S7b）。

paragraphs.en: On the borrowing-versus-purchase axis, multi-agent workflow changes choices in 87.5% of pairs and attains both targets in 60.0%; SC reaches 10.0% for both metrics. On the loss-cap axis, both workflows change every choice, while two-end attainment is 10.0% for multi-agent workflow and 22.5% for SC. Goal sensitivity and successful goal attainment capture different aspects of persona-conditioned financial behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 在借贷与购买这一维度上，多智能体工作流改变了 87.5% 的配对选择，并在 60.0% 的情况下同时达成两个目标；SC 在两项指标上均达到 10.0%。 在损失上限这一维度上，两种工作流都改变了所有选择，而两端达成率分别为多智能体工作流 10.0%、SC 22.5%。 目标敏感性与成功达成目标刻画了角色设定条件下金融行为的不同方面。

sents.en: On the borrowing-versus-purchase axis, multi-agent workflow changes choices in 87.5% of pairs and attains both targets in 60.0%; SC reaches 10.0% for both metrics.
sents.zh: 在借贷与购买这一维度上，多智能体工作流改变了 87.5% 的配对选择，并在 60.0% 的情况下同时达成两个目标；SC 在两项指标上均达到 10.0%。

sents.en: On the loss-cap axis, both workflows change every choice, while two-end attainment is 10.0% for multi-agent workflow and 22.5% for SC.
sents.zh: 在损失上限这一维度上，两种工作流都改变了所有选择，而两端达成率分别为多智能体工作流 10.0%、SC 22.5%。

sents.en: Goal sensitivity and successful goal attainment capture different aspects of persona-conditioned financial behavior.
sents.zh: 目标敏感性与成功达成目标刻画了角色设定条件下金融行为的不同方面。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Figure S7 — DeepSeek financial workflows and counterfactual goal response. DeepSeek Flash is the actor in both experiments. a, Strict adherence requires every hard financial constraint and persona goal. The workflow experiment uses 20 personas, four tasks and two conditions, yielding 160 choices for each of SP, SC and multi-agent workflow, with one, two and three model calls per choice. b, The counterfactual experiment changes one goal while holding the ledger and options fixed. It uses 20 constructed personas, four goal axes, two polarities and two repeats: 320 choices and 160 pairs per workflow. Choice response means the selected option changes; two-end attainment means both choices satisfy their respective goals. c, The four-task breakdown locates gains in consumption and borrowing decisions and shows the variation in risk and debt-payment tasks. Percentages are the deterministic-rule summaries; persona-clustered exploratory confidence intervals for paired differences are reported in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 补充图 S7 — DeepSeek 金融工作流与反事实目标响应。 DeepSeek Flash 在两个实验中均为行动者。a，严格遵循要求满足每一个硬性金融约束和角色目标。 工作流实验使用 20 个角色、四个任务和两种条件，为 SP、SC 和多智能体工作流各产生 160 次选择，每次选择分别对应一次、两次和三次模型调用。b，反事实实验在保持账本和选项不变的情况下改变一个目标。 它使用 20 个构建的角色、四个目标维度、两种极性和两次重复：每个工作流共 320 次选择和 160 个配对。 选择响应指所选选项发生变化；两端达成指两次选择均满足各自的目标。c，四任务分解将收益定位于消费和借款决策，并展示了风险和还款任务中的差异。 百分比为确定性规则的汇总结果；配对差异的角色聚类探索性置信区间在正文中报告。

paragraphs.en: Actor: DeepSeek Flash; 20 personas, four tasks and two conditions. Strict adherence requires all hard and soft persona goals. paragraphs.en: The 50,000-example training set is nested in the 200,000-example set. The fixed checkpoint-selection development set contains 20,000 examples and 829 question versions; the method-selection partition contains all 412,873 development examples and the same 829 versions. The final shared test contains 240,458 examples, 119 question versions and 8,275 respondent groups. Both accuracy and question-macro F1 retain the entire test denominator. Candidate-class F1 includes every defined answer class, including classes absent from predictions, and versions receive equal weight. All ten formal test versions have zero invalid predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 由 5 万条样本构成的训练集嵌套于 20 万条样本的集合之中。 用于固定检查点选择的开发集包含 20,000 条样本和 829 个问题版本；用于方法选择的划分包含全部 412,873 条开发样本以及相同的 829 个版本。 最终的共享测试集包含 240,458 条样本、119 个问题版本和 8,275 个受访者组。 准确率和问题级宏 F1 都保留完整的测试分母。 候选类别 F1 涵盖所有已定义的答案类别，包括未出现在预测中的类别，并且各版本权重相等。 所有十个正式测试版本的无效预测均为零。

sents.zh: 由 5 万条样本构成的训练集嵌套于 20 万条样本的集合之中。

sents.en: The final shared test contains 240,458 examples, 119 question versions and 8,275 respondent groups.
sents.zh: 最终的共享测试集包含 240,458 条样本、119 个问题版本和 8,275 个受访者组。

sents.en: Both accuracy and question-macro F1 retain the entire test denominator.
sents.zh: 准确率和问题级宏 F1 都保留完整的测试分母。

sents.zh: 所有十个正式测试版本的无效预测均为零。

paragraphs.en: Qwen candidate contexts independently encode the full state, question and alternatives, with the candidate under evaluation marked explicitly. The final nonpadding representation is converted to FP32, L2-normalized and scored by one shared bias-free scalar projection followed by candidate softmax. Head-only training freezes the backbone and reuses cached features; its learning rate is 0.003, batch size 4,096 and early-stopping patience three epochs, from a maximum of twenty. LoRA rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 and zero dropout updates adapters together with the same head under candidate-classification cross-entropy. AdamW uses weight decay 0.01, adapter/head rates of 10 − 4 / 10 − 3 10^{-4}/10^{-3} , 3% warm-up and linear decay to zero, gradient clipping 1.0 and seed 20261018. One pass uses eight ranks, microbatch one and accumulation four: global batch 32. Qwen3.5-4B-Base and Qwen3.5-9B are different upstream initializations. The complete development comparison selected LoRA for 9B; training budgets and methods were fixed before the final test.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen 候选上下文独立编码完整状态、问题和备选项，并显式标记当前评估的候选项。 最后一个非填充表示被转换为 FP32、做 L2 归一化，然后由一个共享的无偏置标量投影打分，再进行候选项 softmax。 仅训练头（Head-only）冻结主干并复用缓存特征；其学习率为 0.003，批大小为 4,096，早停耐心值为三个 epoch，最大训练二十个 epoch。 LoRA 秩 16、α = 32 \alpha=32 且 dropout 为零，在候选项分类交叉熵下与同一个头一起更新适配器。 AdamW 使用权重衰减 0.01，适配器/头的学习率为 10 − 4 / 10 − 3 10^{-4}/10^{-3}，3% 预热并线性衰减至零，梯度裁剪为 1.0，随机种子为 20261018。 单次训练使用八个卡（rank），微批大小为 1，梯度累积为 4：全局批大小为 32。 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 和 Qwen3.5-9B 是不同的上游初始化。 完整的开发集对比为 9B 选择了 LoRA；训练预算和方法在最终测试之前已固定。

sents.en: Qwen candidate contexts independently encode the full state, question and alternatives, with the candidate under evaluation marked explicitly.
sents.zh: Qwen 候选上下文独立编码完整状态、问题和备选项，并显式标记当前评估的候选项。

sents.en: The final nonpadding representation is converted to FP32, L2-normalized and scored by one shared bias-free scalar projection followed by candidate softmax.
sents.zh: 最后一个非填充表示被转换为 FP32、做 L2 归一化，然后由一个共享的无偏置标量投影打分，再进行候选项 softmax。

sents.en: Head-only training freezes the backbone and reuses cached features; its learning rate is 0.003, batch size 4,096 and early-stopping patience three epochs, from a maximum of twenty.
sents.zh: 仅训练头（Head-only）冻结主干并复用缓存特征；其学习率为 0.003，批大小为 4,096，早停耐心值为三个 epoch，最大训练二十个 epoch。

sents.en: LoRA rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 and zero dropout updates adapters together with the same head under candidate-classification cross-entropy.
sents.zh: LoRA 秩 16、α = 32 \alpha=32 且 dropout 为零，在候选项分类交叉熵下与同一个头一起更新适配器。

sents.en: AdamW uses weight decay 0.01, adapter/head rates of 10 − 4 / 10 − 3 10^{-4}/10^{-3} , 3% warm-up and linear decay to zero, gradient clipping 1.0 and seed 20261018.
sents.zh: AdamW 使用权重衰减 0.01，适配器/头的学习率为 10 − 4 / 10 − 3 10^{-4}/10^{-3}，3% 预热并线性衰减至零，梯度裁剪为 1.0，随机种子为 20261018。

sents.en: One pass uses eight ranks, microbatch one and accumulation four: global batch 32.
sents.zh: 单次训练使用八个卡（rank），微批大小为 1，梯度累积为 4：全局批大小为 32。

sents.en: Qwen3.5-4B-Base and Qwen3.5-9B are different upstream initializations.
sents.zh: Qwen3.5-4B-Base 和 Qwen3.5-9B 是不同的上游初始化。

sents.en: The complete development comparison selected LoRA for 9B; training budgets and methods were fixed before the final test.
sents.zh: 完整的开发集对比为 9B 选择了 LoRA；训练预算和方法在最终测试之前已固定。

paragraphs.en: Native SFT and its RLCD/CE continuations preserve ModernBERT-large, the upstream two-layer Transformer decision head, tokenizer and option-marker scoring interface. The two SFT parents selected their terminal 50,000- and 200,000-exposure checkpoints. Continued stages reset AdamW and the scheduler, use the same seed and input order, and allow one complete additional pass with global batch 768 over eight ranks. Encoder and head learning rates are 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} and 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , respectively; warm-up occupies 5% of updates followed by cosine decay. Native RLCD uses four noisy samples, Gaussian logit noise annealed from 0.4 to 0.1 and spherical-reward weight 0.75. The general objective’s ranked-probability weight is 1, but that term is inactive for the Choice-typed examples used here. The RLCD loss includes cross-entropy. It perturbs discriminative option logits using target-answer rewards; financial ledger outcomes do not enter training.
paragraphs.zh: 原生 SFT 及其 RLCD/CE 续训版本保留了 ModernBERT-large、上游的两层 Transformer 决策头、分词器以及选项标记评分接口。 两个 SFT 母模型分别选取了其 50,000 次和 200,000 次曝光的最终检查点。 续训阶段重置 AdamW 和调度器，使用相同的随机种子和输入顺序，并允许以全局批大小 768 在八个排名（rank）上进行一次完整额外遍历。 编码器与决策头的学习率分别为 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} 和 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5}；预热占更新的 5%，随后进行余弦衰减。 原生 RLCD 使用四个噪声样本、从 0.4 退火到 0.1 的高斯 logit 噪声以及 0.75 的球形奖励权重。 总体目标的排序概率权重为 1，但该项对于此处使用的 Choice 类型示例不起作用。 RLCD 损失包含交叉熵。 它使用目标答案奖励对判别性选项 logits 进行扰动；财务账本结果不参与训练。

sents.en: Native SFT and its RLCD/CE continuations preserve ModernBERT-large, the upstream two-layer Transformer decision head, tokenizer and option-marker scoring interface.
sents.zh: 原生 SFT 及其 RLCD/CE 续训版本保留了 ModernBERT-large、上游的两层 Transformer 决策头、分词器以及选项标记评分接口。

sents.en: The two SFT parents selected their terminal 50,000- and 200,000-exposure checkpoints.
sents.zh: 两个 SFT 母模型分别选取了其 50,000 次和 200,000 次曝光的最终检查点。

sents.en: Continued stages reset AdamW and the scheduler, use the same seed and input order, and allow one complete additional pass with global batch 768 over eight ranks.
sents.zh: 续训阶段重置 AdamW 和调度器，使用相同的随机种子和输入顺序，并允许以全局批大小 768 在八个排名（rank）上进行一次完整额外遍历。

sents.en: Encoder and head learning rates are 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} and 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , respectively; warm-up occupies 5% of updates followed by cosine decay.
sents.zh: 编码器与决策头的学习率分别为 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} 和 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5}；预热占更新的 5%，随后进行余弦衰减。

sents.en: Native RLCD uses four noisy samples, Gaussian logit noise annealed from 0.4 to 0.1 and spherical-reward weight 0.75.
sents.zh: 原生 RLCD 使用四个噪声样本、从 0.4 退火到 0.1 的高斯 logit 噪声以及 0.75 的球形奖励权重。

sents.en: The general objective’s ranked-probability weight is 1, but that term is inactive for the Choice-typed examples used here.
sents.zh: 总体目标的排序概率权重为 1，但该项对于此处使用的 Choice 类型示例不起作用。

sents.en: The RLCD loss includes cross-entropy.
sents.zh: RLCD 损失包含交叉熵。

sents.en: It perturbs discriminative option logits using target-answer rewards; financial ledger outcomes do not enter training.
sents.zh: 它使用目标答案奖励对判别性选项 logits 进行扰动；财务账本结果不参与训练。

paragraphs.en: All native child checkpoints are selected on the same fixed development rule as their parents. RLCD200 and CE continuation each process the same additional 200,000-example pass, but their development-best checkpoints occur at different points: 200,000 and 50,688 additional exposures. The selected cumulative downstream exposures are therefore 400,000 and 250,688, respectively; cumulative unique examples remain 200,000 in both cases. Exposure counts cover the recorded downstream stages.
paragraphs.zh: 所有原生子检查点均按照与其父级相同的固定开发规则进行选择。 RLCD200 与 CE 续训各自处理相同的额外 200,000 个样本的一轮训练，但它们开发集最优检查点出现的时点不同：分别为额外 200,000 次和 50,688 次样本暴露。 因此，所选的累计下游暴露次数分别为 400,000 和 250,688；两种情况下的累计不重复样本数均为 200,000。 暴露次数统计涵盖所记录的下游阶段。

sents.en: All native child checkpoints are selected on the same fixed development rule as their parents.
sents.zh: 所有原生子检查点均按照与其父级相同的固定开发规则进行选择。

sents.en: RLCD200 and CE continuation each process the same additional 200,000-example pass, but their development-best checkpoints occur at different points: 200,000 and 50,688 additional exposures.
sents.zh: RLCD200 与 CE 续训各自处理相同的额外 200,000 个样本的一轮训练，但它们开发集最优检查点出现的时点不同：分别为额外 200,000 次和 50,688 次样本暴露。

sents.en: The selected cumulative downstream exposures are therefore 400,000 and 250,688, respectively; cumulative unique examples remain 200,000 in both cases.
sents.zh: 因此，所选的累计下游暴露次数分别为 400,000 和 250,688；两种情况下的累计不重复样本数均为 200,000。

sents.en: Exposure counts cover the recorded downstream stages.
sents.zh: 暴露次数统计涵盖所记录的下游阶段。

paragraphs.en: Table S24 records every formal run. Elapsed times are trainer-reported wall times, including in-stage validation and saving; allocated GPU-hours multiply this duration by eight H100 GPUs. Head-only time includes frozen feature preparation and small-head fitting under the reported run allocation. Inference is performed on six A100 40GB GPUs for the four 4B adaptations and two SFT controls, and on eight H100 80GB GPUs for 9B, native continuations and the original native reference.
paragraphs.zh: 表 S24 记录了每一次正式运行。 耗时是训练器报告的实际运行时间，包括阶段内验证和保存；分配的 GPU 小时数用该时长乘以八块 H100 GPU 计算。 仅头部训练的时间包括在所报告的运行分配下冻结特征的准备和小型头部的拟合。 推理在四项 4B 适配和两个 SFT 对照上使用六块 A100 40GB GPU 进行，而在 9B、原生延续模型和原始原生参考模型上使用八块 H100 80GB GPU 进行。

sents.en: Table S24 records every formal run.
sents.zh: 表 S24 记录了每一次正式运行。

sents.en: Elapsed times are trainer-reported wall times, including in-stage validation and saving; allocated GPU-hours multiply this duration by eight H100 GPUs.

paragraphs.en: Each paired interval resamples 8,275 respondent groups 1,000 times, carrying all question records from a selected group together. Accuracy and F1 differences use the same full 240,458-record test and candidate-class definitions. The six native comparisons distinguish initial SFT adaptation, the added RLCD stage, and equal added-budget CE continuation. A seventh direct comparison carries the same 200k-example test pairing across Qwen4B and Qwen9B LoRA, with 200,000 selected exposures and 6,250 updates each. Its 4B-Base and 9B post-trained initializations retain different upstream histories. Table S25 gives pointwise percentile 95% intervals without adjustment for multiple comparisons. Full-data FinL serves as a separate system reference, with different cumulative supervision and MLX FP16 inference.
paragraphs.zh: 每个配对区间对8,275个受访者组进行1,000次重采样，并将所选组的所有问题记录一并保留。 准确率和F1差异使用相同的完整240,458条记录的测试集以及相同的候选类别定义。 六项原生对比区分了初始SFT适配、新增的RLCD阶段以及等新增预算的CE续训。 第七项直接对比在Qwen4B与Qwen9B LoRA之间进行相同的200k样本测试配对，各自使用200,000次选定曝光和6,250次更新。 其4B-Base和9B的后训练初始化保留了不同的上游历史。 表S25给出了逐点的95%百分位区间，未对多重比较进行调整。 全数据FinL作为单独的系统参照，其累计监督和MLX FP16推理均有所不同。

paragraphs.en: The static task suite samples household–parameter combinations within the conditions in Table S27. Each task contains 2,842 baseline/intervention pairs. paragraphs.en: For the completed T3 grid, FinL’s intervention response differs from original Laya by lower consumption, less additional debt and less erosion of cash: a smaller financed-purchase response. Increasing the purchase need within FinL still raises closing debt, debt payments, accrued interest and unmet routine needs. The Chinese response is materially smaller than the default response.
paragraphs.zh: 对于已完成的 T3 网格，FinL 的干预反应与原始 Laya 不同，表现为消费更低、新增债务更少、现金侵蚀更少：即融资购买反应更小。 在 FinL 中提高购买需求仍会提高期末债务、债务偿付、应计利息和未满足的日常需求。 中文反应明显小于默认反应。

paragraphs.en: This application samples two million constructed households uniformly without replacement from the 10M experimental bank. Each household selects one plan under unavailable and available credit, producing four million one-shot choices and 64 million monthly ledger records over months 0–15. Both conditions share the same initial household state and an income reduction of 20% in months 0–2, with full recovery from month 3. The available product has a CNY 20,000 limit, 7.68% annual rate, twelve installments due in months 1–12 and zero fees (Table S37). A selected plan governs the full ledger path.
paragraphs.zh: 本应用从1000万实验银行中无放回均匀抽样两百万个构造家庭。 每个家庭分别在无信贷与有信贷条件下选择一个方案，产生四百万次单期选择和第0至15个月共六千四百万条月度账本记录。 两种条件共享相同的初始家庭状态，且第0至2个月收入减少20%，自第3个月起完全恢复。 可用产品的额度为2万元人民币，年利率7.68%，第1至12个月需偿还十二期，无任何费用（表S37）。 所选方案决定完整的账本路径。

sents.zh: 本应用从1000万实验银行中无放回均匀抽样两百万个构造家庭。

sents.en: Each household selects one plan under unavailable and available credit, producing four million one-shot choices and 64 million monthly ledger records over months 0–15.

sents.en: A selected plan governs the full ledger path.
sents.zh: 所选方案决定完整的账本路径。

paragraphs.en: C0 adjusts spending to preserve cash; C1 uses reserves to sustain consumption. Credit options combine partial financing with half-normal adjustable spending or seek to sustain normal spending while preserving reserves. The ledger applies necessary spending, dated debt payments and adjustable spending with integer-cent cash constraints. Unfunded needs and unpaid obligations remain explicit. The selected adjustable-spending target defines the corresponding execution shortfall.
paragraphs.zh: C0 通过调整支出来保全现金；C1 使用储备来维持消费。 信贷选项将部分融资与半正态可调支出相结合，或在保留储备的同时寻求维持正常支出。 账本在整数美分的现金约束下应用必要支出、有到期日的债务还款和可调支出。 未获资金支持的需求和未偿付的义务保持显式记录。 选定的可调支出目标定义了相应的执行缺口。

sents.en: C0 adjusts spending to preserve cash; C1 uses reserves to sustain consumption.
sents.zh: C0 通过调整支出来保全现金；C1 使用储备来维持消费。

sents.en: Credit options combine partial financing with half-normal adjustable spending or seek to sustain normal spending while preserving reserves.
sents.zh: 信贷选项将部分融资与半正态可调支出相结合，或在保留储备的同时寻求维持正常支出。

sents.en: The ledger applies necessary spending, dated debt payments and adjustable spending with integer-cent cash constraints.
sents.zh: 账本在整数美分的现金约束下应用必要支出、有到期日的债务还款和可调支出。

sents.en: Unfunded needs and unpaid obligations remain explicit.

paragraphs.en: Across the full panel, available minus unavailable credit yields CNY 293.76 less cumulative consumption, CNY 311.50 more closing cash and CNY 17.74 more closing old debt (Table S38). Reduced consumption and lower actual debt payments jointly fund the cash difference. Within the realized fully funded plans, 90,667 households increase consumption and 220,427 preserve cash; these are outcome-defined subsets of the full cohort (Table S39). Cash reaches zero in at least one month for 317,879 households without available credit and 265,770 with it, comprising 62,326 avoided events and 10,217 added events.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个面板中，可用额度减去不可用额度后，累计消费减少293.76元，期末现金增加311.50元，期末旧债增加17.74元（表S38）。 消费减少与实际偿债支出降低共同构成了这一现金差异的来源。 在已实现的完全资金充足方案中，90,667户家庭增加消费，220,427户家庭保留现金；这些是按结果界定的全队列子集（表S39）。 有317,879户无可用额度的家庭和265,770户有可用额度的家庭至少有一个月现金降为零，其中包括62,326个被避免的事件和10,217个新增的事件。

sents.en: Across the full panel, available minus unavailable credit yields CNY 293.76 less cumulative consumption, CNY 311.50 more closing cash and CNY 17.74 more closing old debt (Table S38).
sents.zh: 在整个面板中，可用额度减去不可用额度后，累计消费减少293.76元，期末现金增加311.50元，期末旧债增加17.74元（表S38）。

sents.en: Reduced consumption and lower actual debt payments jointly fund the cash difference.

paragraphs.en: Controls on 2,000 households from this sixteen-month application compare learned selections with fixed plans and separate information, menu and budget changes. Under the available full menu, FinL selects fully funded plans for 87.00% of households, compared with 79.30% for original Laya and 88.05% for always selecting the restrained-consumption plan C0. Relative to C0, FinL executes CNY 1,146.60 more consumption (95% interval 1,007.92–1,314.65) and retains CNY 1,115.34 less cash. A matched information/menu comparison gives CNY 199.88 more consumption when credit availability is stated with the common menu, followed by CNY 447.98 less when financing alternatives are added. In the matched recovery-versus-persistent-income comparison, both paths lose 20% of income in months 0–2; one recovers from month 3 and the other remains lower through month 15. The CNY 4,043.31 consumption reduction comprises 3,998.78 from executing the recovery-selected plan under the changed budget and 44.53 from plan reselection.
paragraphs.zh: 来自这项为期十六个月应用的2,000户对照组将学到的选择与固定计划进行比较，并单独改变了信息、菜单和预算。 在可用的完整菜单下，FinL为87.00%的家庭选择了全额资助的计划，而原始Laya为79.30%，始终选择约束消费计划C0则为88.05%。 相对于C0，FinL多执行了1,146.60元消费（95%区间为1,007.92–1,314.65），并少保留了1,115.34元现金。 在匹配的信息/菜单比较中，当信用可用性以共同菜单表述时，消费多出199.88元；而加入融资替代方案后，消费减少447.98元。 在匹配的收入恢复与持续低收入比较中，两条路径在0–2月的收入均损失20%；一条路径从第3个月起恢复，另一条则在直至第15个月期间保持较低水平。 4,043.31元的消费减少中，3,998.78元来自在改变的预算下执行恢复路径所选的计划，44.53元来自计划的重新选择。

paragraphs.en: Each pair gives the CNY 20k / 30k purchase goals in the same 10,000-household monthly panel. Income, cash and debt are separate complete partitions. paragraphs.en: Table S50 — Individual capacity and portfolio factors explain offer-gap reversals

paragraphs.en: Offer differences and contributions are CNY per household, 30k minus 20k; portfolio factors are dimensionless. Individual capacity reflects payment-budget and remaining-principal limits and recent-arrears freezes. For goal condition j j , let A j A_{j} be mean capacity after freezes, g j g_{j} the portfolio factor and r j r_{j} the rounding/minimum-draw residual. The decomposition is Δ ​ O ¯ = g ¯ ​ Δ ​ A + A ¯ ​ Δ ​ g + Δ ​ r \Delta\bar{O}=\bar{g}\,\Delta A+\bar{A}\,\Delta g+\Delta r , with bars over g g and A A denoting averages across the two goal conditions. The individual-capacity, portfolio-factor and rounding/minimum columns give the three terms, which sum to the offer difference before display rounding. Portfolio factors use the preceding three completed months; the configured floor is 0.25. M11 defines coverage, arrears, freezes and individual affordability.
